{
  "chapterId": "chap_2a6eafd1",
  "title": "Arts And Crafts",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "b96b2766-6dd8-462d-a524-baa5b162aec1",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "CHAPTER 10: ARTS AND CRAFTS",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e4379267-8e36-4f97-95a6-e4c7c4ba03ac",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Overview — Art and Craft of Kashmir",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9a2077b5-13bc-41b2-b8c1-a5729755b775",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir ko kai intellectuals aur historians \"Heaven on Earth\" (jannat) kehte hain, sirf uski scenic beauty ke liye nahi balki uske delicate arts and crafts ke liye bhi. Kashmir ke traditional handicrafts mein purani traditions aur artistic skill ki strong impression milti hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f0b76c04-04be-473f-a7d0-5facfc1ece74",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir ke artisans dwara banaye gaye items mein walnut wood crafts, trays, fruit bowls, table plates, picture frames, wooden boxes, furniture aur embroidery jaise products shamil hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a4d6b38e-712c-41b2-aad6-ff5308bb3cf3",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Important Points",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0f076dbd-cb5c-46d4-9b6e-934099d5c2ed",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Walnut wood craft Kashmir ke famous traditional crafts mein se ek hai.\nWooden boxes aur furniture par extensive carving ki jaati hai.\nKashmir ki embroidery bhi important craft hai.\nEmbroidery ka use Firans (traditional long loose gowns), Jackets, Ponchos, aur Shawls mein hota hai.\nKashmir ke traditional crafts par old traditions ka strong influence milta.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "50e51213-d5b9-4b22-9001-def82eaea383",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Shawls",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6453e2fa-6334-4f47-bd5e-7e4b5c1d6b6d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir ke textile industry mein shawls ka bahut important position hai. Sabse celebrated shawl Pashmina (fine cashmere wool) shawl hai. Iske alawa ring shawl aur Jamawar shawl bhi important varieties hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a186abf0-8e44-4d6b-a9a5-056dfa5a1485",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Types of Kashmiri Shawls",
      "nodes": [
        "Shawl Types",
        "Pashmina",
        "Ring",
        "Jamawar"
      ],
      "rawContent": "[Shawl Types]\n     \/    |     \\\n    \/     |      \\\n[Pashmina] [Ring] [Jamawar]"
    },
    {
      "id": "729a0dcc-84e8-4ea1-a9fd-e6daf0e6cb50",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Pashmina Shawl",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "de1774ef-287e-49d0-a033-e85f6cb4a2fb",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Pashmina shawl ka fabric goat ke smooth fleece wool se extract kiya jata hai. Isko handloom artisans, jo generally women hoti hain, prepare karti hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8e56418c-08c1-4f91-8215-1c06a7a328fc",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Ring Shawl",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6816f34b-bc88-42e5-8be5-a798316af104",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir ka celebrated Ring Shawl bahut fine aur smooth fabric se bana hota hai. Fabric itna sleek aur smooth hota hai ki ring ke through easily pass ho sakta hai. Isi characteristic ki wajah se ise Ring Shawl kaha jata hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4ba20df8-0cbb-4759-a533-11830f6cda8c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Jamawar Shawl",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "74e09963-1f40-48d0-bcc6-6f986c3aa156",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Jamawar shawl doosri shawls se different hai. Ismein warp (longitudinal threads) aur weft (transverse threads) ke threads weaving se pehle dyed kiye jaate hain. Is famous shawl ka special charm colour schemes, architectural figures, mythological figures, aur landscape designs ke combination se aata hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "639c4084-dc4f-4c09-955d-29442bc44bea",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Shawl Industry and Mughals",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "34b56056-eaf4-4d10-ab1c-b214b312d34b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Mughals ne Kashmir ki shawl industry ko reorganise kiya. Akbar aur uske successors ne Kashmir ke shawls ko patronage (support and sponsorship) diya. Kashmir ki fine shawl industry ko elsewhere successfully reproduce nahi kiya ja saka. British period mein India aur Britain mein is industry ko reproduce karne ke attempts hue, lekin successfully reproduce nahi ho payi.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9bc20838-d928-44be-9ebb-6991165afa8c",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Carpets and Floor Coverings",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5bd25a90-ea63-45a3-9f52-d830f28a9b08",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir mein carpets aur floor coverings ki kai varieties milti hain. Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin ne carpet industry ko valley mein introduce kiya tha. Weaving ke point of view se carpets ko do classes mein divide kiya jata hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1d45f12c-c3bf-441f-be32-ab53ffe1798c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Namda\nGabba\nChain-stitch Rug\nPile Carpets (Kalins)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eeb00cb1-70c3-4ef1-b66a-2d214673ccb4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Namda",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ff313db7-24d2-48ac-a7bd-f6a07f84f26c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Namda beaten wool se banaya gaya felt rug hai, jiske upar embroidery ki jaati hai. Ye Kasida (traditional Kashmiri embroidery) industry ka important branch hai. Namda industry ke old woollens se different forms aur designs ke floor coverings banaye jaate hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d4d53060-5a36-4326-b5dd-28bfbd514023",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Gabba",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "69f96cda-178f-4a28-aa69-060d1e6df406",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Gabba ek unique type ka floor covering hai jo old woollens se prepare kiya jata hai aur various forms aur designs mein banaya jata hai. Anantnag mein iska manufacture important hai, jabki Baramulla printed gabbas ke liye specialised hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3b5b9799-b210-495e-bb43-04ec19337cf5",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Chain-stitch Rug",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "235cd7f1-6246-4901-91b8-67701c58dd24",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Chain-stitch rug, Gabba carpet jaisa dikhta hai aur ise economically manufacture kiya jata hai. Iska base Hessian cloth (coarse jute fabric) aur coarse wool hota hai, jis par floral aur other motifs work kiye jaate hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "548ededd-026b-4cb4-a468-e4754dcb9d3e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Pile Carpets (Kalins)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2be2b06b-6c27-4c1a-ac87-cfc194d3f14b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Pile carpets ko Kalins bhi kaha jata hai. Muslim rule ke time Kashmir mein pile carpets ne great perfection attain ki. Floral aur other designs ke saath hand-woven pile carpet Kashmir ka national craft ban gaya.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "36c7d44b-c32b-4a44-9c3b-f3a3efccf2c6",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Carpet Classification",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "523caeaa-9781-48a9-a673-afdfdc58e7b8",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Carpet Classification by Weaving",
      "nodes": [
        "Carpet Classes",
        "Smooth-faced",
        "Pile Carpets"
      ],
      "rawContent": "       [Carpet Classes]\n          \/        \\\n         \/          \\\n[Smooth-faced]    [Pile Carpets]"
    },
    {
      "id": "3b309b51-f10f-4861-b0bc-8e845f4226e8",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Carpet Designs",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "efd50fd3-93a5-402f-8b9d-c016ec9add17",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir ke carpets par different regions aur cultures (Kashmir, Central Asia, aur Iran) ke influence ko represent kiya gaya hai. In regions ki flora (plants) aur fauna (animals) ko Kashmir ke carpets par depict kiya jata hai. Ye designs Kashmir ki diverse cultures ke traditional synthesis ko symbolically represent karte hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7293beaf-1153-4d87-8dd4-166fbaf38480",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Embroidery",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "46169730-4bdc-4b5b-8172-a746abd89174",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir ki embroidery ko Kasida (traditional Kashmiri embroidery) kaha jata hai aur ye world famous hai. Kasida apne rich colours, variation, elaborate details, aur exquisite execution ke liye famous hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "af5422c9-8044-4e79-a980-012a65531ea1",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Kasida — Important Features",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "214cfee9-1e95-4b0f-b162-0e67bc1a270c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kasida patterns generally Naqqash (pattern designer) dwara freely drawn kiye jaate hain. Naqqash aksar patterns memory se draw karta hai. Chain-stitch bhi extensively used hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "00b80341-457b-44d9-8e9b-5c42791868f7",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Kasida se banne wale products",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "13f69b96-764c-4dc0-9d59-27fff0c0a9c9",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Chain-stitch aur embroidery ka use various articles ke liye hota hai, jaise bags, screens, cushion covers, shawls, saris, aur wearing apparel.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a558dcc1-78d3-4abf-ad91-81e5a6c5b9fc",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Market and Embroiderers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65d5ce0f-46b3-41e5-98d3-7e2be9ce1fcf",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Embroidered shawls aur saris ka domestic demand hai, aur is craft ka foreign\/export market bhi hai. Modern houses ke liye household linen aur upholstery jaise products ki demand bhi hai. Kashmir ke embroiderers current demand ke prati highly sensitive hain aur market ki requirement ke according goods produce karte hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "68533088-cb09-45ba-a475-9c3911074d95",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Wood Carving",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "55035f38-b88a-4c87-8e43-6a305dc014a9",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir mein Walnut aur Chinar wood abundant hain. Ye woods wood carving industry ke liye important raw material provide karte hain. Wood carving Kashmir ki best-known cottage industries mein se ek hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6e3a50c-78cb-4e19-bbf2-eef864ef8beb",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Wood Carving Products",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f6104fa6-ac20-48e6-91b7-ddd413c5af65",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Excellent furniture aur household articles banaye jaate hain, jaise chairs, cabinets, writing tables, dining tables, jewellery boxes, aur ornamental caskets. Ye products highly appreciated hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a28e138-f4d8-4c08-a03c-7a1dd2d46988",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Walnut Wood Products",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6a9b5b31-85ec-4605-9a4f-de2304fd3825",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Walnut wood se banne wale kuch important products mein cigar boxes, trays, table-tops, handkerchief boxes, aur collar boxes shamil hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "314ab565-a336-43a8-ba4a-8ecb0eb3076b",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Designs",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d1f3cdfd-1269-4cd4-8eff-e02dea4bed8f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Products ko delicately carve kiya jata hai. Floral designs bahut common hain aur almost every conceivable variety ke floral designs mil sakte hain. Work chased work (embossed decoration) aur raised work ke form mein hota hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "76d8f4fc-98b4-4809-8a3a-438218c2a7f3",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Khatam Band and Other Woodworks",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9db72830-af76-47aa-8ba5-8b4ebbe20c72",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Khatam Band Kashmir ki specialised woodwork hai jismein rooms ki ceilings ko decorate kiya jata hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ffd5fafd-7652-4f5c-9d56-f6ad58925614",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Construction",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b2dc8bbf-8d6d-4f1d-b2de-d048a1ec15bd",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Thin pine wood ke panels use hote hain jinhe geometrical designs mein cut kiya jata hai. Ye traditional Kashmiri interior decoration ka important form hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3e7cc561-1471-443e-9722-c9b272d80d2e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Important Example",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6a885f03-23f3-4cb5-b2fb-24f607b6aab8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Khwaja Naqshband ki shrine, jo Srinagar ki Jamia Masjid ke paas hai, Khatam Band craft ka best example present karti hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "be004b35-72ba-486b-9dca-6d9e848cb8a9",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Kashmiri Carpentry and Wicker Work",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "21c685c1-57de-4c87-bc8d-f99669f68bab",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmiri carpentry aur wicker work (woven flexible twigs) industries bhi notable hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "578a8fde-c51a-43c3-a470-00f1681091c4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Kangri",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "205527af-fee0-4cc7-b154-2818da9f52ff",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kangri Kashmiri craft tradition ka ek important item hai. Ye ek earthen bowl hota hai jise wicker work se encase kiya jata hai, wicker ring se ornament kiya jata hai, aur coloured mica se bhi decoration ki jaati hai. Ye ek important traditional Kashmiri artefact hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "adb1cdee-be41-4adc-bdf8-d9ab14bcf5cd",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Silver and Copperware",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5cea9b76-50e4-4ec5-83e4-3d9d1790d6c8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmir mein plain aur engraved silver work dono milte hain. Buyers ki different tastes ko cater karne ke liye silverware ki wide range available hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f4517c96-411e-4186-bb02-23547a3e3a2d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Silverware Products and Designs",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "10004c27-d438-4168-9bb5-1dc284c5cafa",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Silverware products mein silver tea sets, flower vases, toilet sets, scent chests, ornamental picture frames, cigar cases, aur tumblers shamil hain. Popular designs mein Chinar leaves aur lotus shamil hain. Lace\/flower designs bhi silver mein work kiye jaate hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6ff91b28-d29b-4513-a9de-99bd91baa68f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Copperware",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9966ca9f-11a4-4ef8-a490-a2a931cf209e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kashmiri artisans excellent copperware bhi produce karte hain. Important products mein cooking pots, samovars, sundry household articles, aur mantelpiece articles shamil hain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cf752d57-8bd7-44cd-adff-cc3045752577",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Samovar",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "72c5b15b-d65e-4185-afa7-6e8d5df697ab",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Samovar Russian-origin tea kettle hai aur Kashmir ke copperware tradition ka important product hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "83d0b31f-70d7-41a1-a2c5-c890d1e3ea30",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Walnut + Copper Combination",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0780056e-eff6-4067-bd44-4f41b37435d6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Copper trays ko carved walnut wood tables mein inlay kiya jata hai. Is work mein carpenter aur coppersmith dono ki skill ka combination hota.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "39fb17c4-3e03-4ccd-8c51-214dca95ceef",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Enamelled Silver Work",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7627ae1b-57bf-41ed-a374-c138f2b8f416",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Enamelled silver work (meenakari) bhi Kashmir ke attractive craft products mein shamil hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c999bdb7-a34a-4834-8edd-7c01d23288ae",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Papier-Mache",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9d0bebcd-c3f1-45db-9dd6-c9c342cd985d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Papier-mache craft Kashmir ki distinctive craft traditions mein se ek hai. Is craft ko valley mein Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin ke time introduce kiya gya tha, jinhe \"great monarch\" aur \"Akbar of Kashmir\" ke naam se bhi refer kiya gaya hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d6665a5-7510-4529-b498-911b0ff26acd",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Papier-Mache Process",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0713f816-d07e-415b-a53d-2d9946b54d21",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Papier-Mache Manufacturing Process",
      "nodes": [
        "Prepare Pulp",
        "Soak in Water",
        "Pound Pulp",
        "Mix with Adhesive",
        "Apply to Moulds",
        "Dry",
        "Paint & Decorate"
      ],
      "rawContent": "[Prepare Pulp] -> [Soak in Water] -> [Pound Pulp] -> [Mix with Adhesive] -> [Apply to Moulds] -> [Dry] -> [Paint & Decorate]"
    },
    {
      "id": "16ed6ecf-8a29-4493-8c32-060371c0239d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Decoration and Motifs",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "def42b5e-cd0f-4213-865e-4d709cd12b0d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Papier-mache artwork mein wide variety ke designs aur colours use hote hain. Price largely depend karti hai material used aur artwork ko decorate karne ke colours\/designs par. Common motifs natural Kashmiri scenery se inspired hote hain jaise green fields, snow-capped mountains, mountain streams, rounded rocks, shikara (traditional wooden boat), aur blooming lotus flowers.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "51b6a6ac-9018-4ace-a97e-733b23fe973f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Modern Development",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d4f7a5f9-5118-4136-b4e7-b1b8a0f079b7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Craftsmen ne new style ke papier-mache goods ke liye brass aur metal patterns bhi introduce kiye hain. Isse products ko more durable and useful banane ka effort kiya gaya hai.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9b5ad95a-3ff1-4c1b-b46c-8e86d3596822",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Revision",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8eb7e9e3-e11c-4e06-97af-a562977b871d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Pashmina Shawl: Goat ke smooth fleece wool se banaya jata hai.\nRing Shawl: Ring ke through pass ho sakta hai.\nJamawar Shawl: Warp & weft weaving se pehle dyed kiye jaate hain.\nNamda: Beaten wool ka felt rug hai.\nGabba: Old woollens se floor covering banayi jaati hai.\nGabba manufacturing: Anantnag iska main center hai.\nPrinted Gabba: Baramulla printed gabbas ke liye specialised hai.\nKasida: Kashmir ki world-famous embroidery hai.\nPile Carpet: Kalin ke naam se jana jata hai.\nCarpet Industry introduced by: Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin.\nNational Craft of Kashmir: Hand-woven pile carpet.\nWood carving wood: Walnut & Chinar wood use hoti hai.\nKhatam Band: Thin pine wood + geometric designs ka use hota hai.\nBest Khatam Band example: Shrine of Khwaja Naqshband, near Jamia Masjid, Srinagar.\nKangri: Earthen bowl encased in wicker work.\nSilver designs: Chinar leaves & lotus designs popular hain.\nSamovar: Russian-origin tea kettle hai.\nPapier-Mache: Paper pulp + adhesive + mould + painting process se banta hai.\nPapier-Mache introduced by: Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin.\nPapier-Mache motifs: Green fields, mountains, streams, shikara, aur lotus.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "chapterId": "chap_a2dd2a38",
  "title": "Tourism: Profile of the State",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "734ef072-172b-4065-af14-c487cf10157d",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "Chapter 9 — Tourism: Profile of the State",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b0a62c1e-2817-46e1-8c75-75dde5d112ab",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Overview",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65537be0-6353-4225-bc3b-8fef8505ad22",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The natural beauty of the Kashmir Valley has received great praise from travellers since ancient times. The valley attracted travellers from different parts of the world because of its scenic beauty, mountains, lakes, gardens and pleasant climate.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8c5435b3-1697-4039-9d43-839fa280e3af",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Chinese traveller Hiuen Tsang visited Kashmir in the 7th century AD and was greatly impressed by the valley.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "22645c1f-b45e-4c85-8c60-727cf9f98a78",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Ou-Kong, another Chinese traveller, visited Kashmir in AD 759 and stayed for about four years.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "98fd6b24-481f-474c-88b0-113c6fb6ba37",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Kalhana, in his famous work Rajatarangini (a historical chronicle of Kashmir), described Kailasa as one of the best places in the three worlds and the Himalayas as the best part of Kailasa.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "77ef7a2c-7351-479d-a8b1-88962f684cb3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Jahangir loved Kashmir greatly and considered it exceptionally beautiful.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ad0ad99d-4b3f-4690-b8c1-37b0618f1afa",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The first European known to have visited Ladakh was the Jesuit father Hippolyte Desideri (AD 1715), who left a detailed account of the places he visited.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1a8c1107-b044-45b7-908d-bfaa02816df3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "G.T. Vigne, a lawyer-writer from England, described the Pir Panjal range as a fitting boundary for the noblest valley in the world.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e2e9b433-0d1e-4c1b-9cfa-8492d7b1c689",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Banihal Cart Road was opened in AD 1918.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "788260c3-0c24-47e9-96e9-7f7e52f94dfe",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The opening of the Banihal Cart Road facilitated the entry of motor vehicles into the Kashmir Valley and gradually displaced the earlier Tongas and Ekkas (traditional horse-drawn carriages) operating on the Jammu–Jhelum valley road.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,

    {
      "id": "b6830e30-8625-45f5-8931-30da5a98b785",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Tourism has emerged as one of the major industries of the state.\nTourism contributes significantly to the state's economy.\nAbout one-sixth of the total labour force in the state earns its employment directly or indirectly from tourism.\nThe government has kept tourism in the priority sector.\nLeisure tourism has an assured clientele.\nSpecial attention has been given to the development of adventure tourism.",

      "isItalic": false,

    {
      "id": "a68660e2-c927-4f02-a42e-a98a42ab0798",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Historical Tourism",
      "isBold": false,

    {
      "id": "83b4f671-4070-4555-857c-285018b98afa",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Hiuen Tsang visited Kashmir in the 7th century AD.\nOu-Kong visited Kashmir in AD 759.\nHippolyte Desideri was the first European known to visit Ladakh in AD 1715.\nBanihal Cart Road opened in AD 1918.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cd6a4348-53f2-4cac-9808-295362332509",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Tourism Development",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "011ef4c4-091a-43e5-a9e5-a99c51428a76",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "JKTDC was established on 13 February 1970.\nJKTDC is a fully owned company of the Jammu and Kashmir Government.\nMain functions include managing hotels, catering, transport facilities, and tourism promotion.\nTourism is designated as a priority sector of the state.\nAdventure tourism has been given special attention.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c3eeb64d-06c6-4a1c-9d25-72521811aec8",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Chapter Revision",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e0b590eb-2869-4300-85dd-c65bfc59cfd4",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Tourism is an important industry and contributes significantly to the economy of Jammu and Kashmir.\nKashmir's natural beauty has attracted travellers since ancient times.\nHiuen Tsang visited Kashmir in the 7th century AD.\nOu-Kong visited Kashmir in AD 759 and stayed for about four years.\nKalhana described Kashmir and the Himalayas in his Rajatarangini.\nJahangir was greatly impressed by the beauty of Kashmir.\nHippolyte Desideri was the first European known to visit Ladakh in AD 1715.\nBanihal Cart Road was opened in AD 1918.\nThe Banihal Cart Road facilitated the entry of motor vehicles into Kashmir.\nTourism provides direct and indirect employment to about one-sixth of the state's total labour force.\nMarch–April: Flower season.\nMay–June: Fruit season and carpets of flowers.\nJune–July: Swimming, sunbathing, surfing and trekking.\nAugust–September: Trout fishing and Mahseer fishing.\nSeptember–October: Game and autumn tourism.\nDecember–February: Winter tourism and trekking, especially in Gulmarg.\nTourism is a priority sector of the state.\nJKTDC was established on 13 February 1970.\nJKTDC is a fully government-owned company.\nJKTDC manages government hotels and catering establishments.\nJKTDC provides tourism-related services and facilities.\nJammu and Kashmir has three major tourist regions: Jammu, Kashmir Valley and Ladakh.\nThe three regions differ in natural features, customs, faith and climate.\nMata Vaishno Devi: Major pilgrimage destination in Jammu.\nBahu Fort: Historic fort in Jammu.\nMansar Lake: Important lake and tourist destination of Jammu.\nGulmarg: Famous for skiing and winter tourism.\nPahalgam: Famous for its valley, Lidder River and trekking.\nSonamarg: Famous mountain and glacier tourism destination.\nDal Lake: Famous for shikaras and houseboats.\nWular Lake: Major freshwater lake of Kashmir.\nAmarnath Cave: Major pilgrimage destination.\nMartand-Sun Temple: Important ancient heritage site near Anantnag.\nLeh: Major tourist centre of Ladakh.\nNubra Valley: Famous high-altitude valley.\nHemis Monastery: Major Buddhist monastery of Ladakh.\nAlchi Monastery: Famous for its ancient Buddhist art and paintings.\nTsomoriri: High-altitude lake of Ladakh.\nZanskar: Remote mountainous region known for adventure and monasteries.\nJammu: Mainly known for pilgrimage, temples, forts and hill destinations.\nKashmir: Mainly known for lakes, gardens, valleys, shrines and scenic tourism.\nLadakh: Mainly known for high-altitude landscapes, monasteries, lakes and adventure tourism.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "chapterId": "chap_62cf8cda",
  "title": "Energy Resources",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "b5289156-743d-45cd-a1c0-9544e68275d6",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "CHAPTER 8: ENERGY RESOURCES",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b3ab5a78-d3e1-4432-a03b-f3160b6a3171",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Energy Resources — Overview",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9921bb89-c50d-47fb-9bef-d5c6438b59e2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Jammu and Kashmir is one of the energy starved states of the country despite having tremendous hydro-power potential, estimated at over 20,000 MW. Out of this, hardly 10 per cent has been harnessed till date. With a view to tapping the available hydel potential, the State Government is exploring the possibility of attracting private local and foreign capital. Currently, the state generates just 25 per cent of the actual demand for electricity. Power transmission and distribution losses were over 58.82 per cent in 2016.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5eb36d54-1fe2-44bf-ab25-1b4b825658aa",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Hydro-power Potential",
      "content": "The capacity to generate electricity from flowing water."
    },
    {
      "id": "631e7e99-5082-40d4-831d-b4e043759ad7",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Power Transmission and Distribution Losses",
      "content": "Energy lost as electricity travels through cables."
    },
    {
      "id": "b8b3c986-8cbb-4145-be00-1605b8150d3d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "One of the major constraints in tapping hydro-power in the state, besides shortage of resources, is the Indus Water Treaty, to which both India and Pakistan are signatories. The treaty prohibits reservoir storage of water on major rivers of Jammu and Kashmir, restricting the scope of generating electricity from stored hydro power to run-of-the-river projects.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2317ff61-d809-44dd-af4b-5f34aaeaae43",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Run-of-the-River Projects",
      "content": "Generating electricity from natural river flow without large dams."
    },
    {
      "id": "a1a72897-fe10-4dcb-b28b-53f53ed5dae5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The topography of the state (Jammu being the only rail link) together with remote and far-flung villages across the landscape compounds the energy crisis. Transmission of power to these areas is not only un-economical, but difficult as well. Population density in some villages is still worse, where households and habitations are dispersed. In such geographical locations, electrification by laying long transmission and distribution lines becomes practically impossible.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2c1f44eb-0372-4e9d-a913-1e4ece205eab",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Consumption of Power",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d98cd73-7717-4ee6-9b2a-f1e0a4a90b09",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Consumption of power increased from 3188 MW in 2022, during 2006-07. The domestic sector has been the biggest consumer followed by agriculture and industry. Domestic consumption showed an increase of 65 per cent during the same period, followed by an increase of 13.84 per cent in agriculture and 59.39 per cent in industrial consumption.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d1e129a3-cd7e-4e4d-9ede-f307ac02eec0",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Power Consumption Sectors in Jammu and Kashmir",
      "nodes": [
        "Power Sectors",
        "Domestic",
        "Agriculture",
        "Industry"
      ],
      "rawContent": "[Power Sectors]\n       |\n+------+------+\n|      |      |\n[Domestic] [Agriculture] [Industry]"
    },
    {
      "id": "1ecefa94-28ea-4bc1-baaa-f4e76bc0f400",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Domestic Sector",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "76cb10b5-6d86-49be-b197-425988001fd8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The domestic sector has been the biggest consumer. Domestic consumption showed an increase of 65 per cent during the same period.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "30db1006-72e2-45aa-a58e-6a16e963e837",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Agricultural Sector",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a1bb2fe-089f-4b13-aa09-f6e1caa29ef6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Agriculture is the second consumer. Agricultural consumption showed an increase of 13.84 per cent during the same period.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "095b67fb-684a-4ed0-9705-040c99810bdc",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Industrial Sector",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "49edc855-757e-4936-9ab7-879050ec35cb",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Industrial consumption showed an increase of 59.39 per cent in industrial consumption during the same period. The state is dependent on external sources to fill the wide gap between the demand and supply of power.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "369f343a-99c0-4af8-8c06-06203a099361",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Rural Electrification",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e02f494e-3e3d-4a03-b901-74a4611d732c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "By the end of 2005-06, there were 102 unelectrified villages of the total of 6417 (2001 Census) inhabited villages in the state, according to a 2019 report. Due to declining interest of the State Electricity Board in raising interest bearing loans from the REC (Rural Electrification Corporation) for the Village Electrification Programme, village electrification was made a part of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana of 2015. The funds for this programme now flow to the state in the form of central assistance.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "567426fd-f404-4c58-8773-543c82555c47",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Hydro Power",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0f29d57c-e27e-482d-ac06-bdb87626a1d6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The hydro power sector in India in general, and Jammu and Kashmir in particular, has faced problems for reasons besides project-specific issues. As demand for power grows and concerns on the environmental impact of thermal power and its sufficiency grows, as also the investment climate improves, there is a greater realisation that increased reliance needs to be placed on benign sources of energy such as hydro power.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d262bd77-4a4a-488a-9049-b1d3918f6d63",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Jammu and Kashmir has abundant water resources and great potential for hydro power, estimated at over 20,000 MW. Of this, less than 10% has been exploited and efforts are being made to effectively tap and harness the untapped hydro-power potential of the state.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3bf03f58-376b-4848-9d6b-9a5c259c733d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Despite the significant potential of hydro power and its benefits, it has still not been harnessed in a meaningful way due to long gestation periods for hydro-power projects, unavailability of reliable hydrological data under projects offered, skewed tariff profile, instability in the political environment of the state, and remoteness from large consumption centres.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "751b4009-4e10-44d0-b286-e9c53f4b2570",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Gestation Period",
      "content": "The time between planning a project and it becoming operational."
    },
    {
      "id": "3edbe907-75e1-47a0-a1b3-2d32e867771a",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "National Hydro Power Corporation — NHPC",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f7a98713-3518-46cb-a01c-1dcfb4d2c40e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The National Hydro Power Corporation (NHPC), which is a Central Public Sector Undertaking (CPSU) [government-owned corporation], has the mandate of developing hydro power in the entire country.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "273deb62-d14b-43ac-9ddc-feb4f4d5055a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In the state of Jammu and Kashmir also, NHPC has developed and is developing large-scale hydro-power projects and the power so generated on these projects is transmitted and pooled in the Northern Grid of the country, which caters to the electricity demand of the adjoining states of the country.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0d573435-4647-493c-a082-68622719baf7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "However, the power so imported from the Northern Grid by the respective states is based on the tariff fixed by the regulatory authority from time-to-time. For the power generated by the NHPC on the rivers of the Jammu and Kashmir State, the NHPC provides a royalty of 12 per cent of the power generated.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eda3b97a-d75f-42e7-8cc1-e2a24e1471e2",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Royalty",
      "content": "A payment made for the use of an asset."
    },
    {
      "id": "e21ad9ef-f9f8-49b1-88a8-968ab440bb44",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Small Hydro Power Potential in the State",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bdc15bc6-f4c9-4994-b320-de9785cc9195",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In the state of Jammu and Kashmir, the State Power Development Corporation (SPDC) is the nodal agency for development of SHP (Small Hydro Power). The SPDC has developed a number of power projects in the state and has also the mandate of identification of potential sites, preparation of pre-feasibility reports, detailed project reports and execution of such projects.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "99e05326-bb95-4908-b3e7-1e5476ca7d0a",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Nodal Agency",
      "content": "The primary organization responsible for coordinating a specific program."
    },
    {
      "id": "fb719f0c-a9ae-4fd3-b156-8a5c529846d9",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The corporation has both the infrastructure as well as expertise to handle small, medium and large hydro projects in the state. The power generated from the projects developed by SPDC is being consumed in the state, for which the State Power Development Department (SPDD) has the necessary power evacuation facilities, transmission and distribution network and other related infrastructure in terms of technical manpower etc.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1bce268a-3a0c-468c-bdef-1052e5b29f56",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Power Evacuation Facilities",
      "content": "Infrastructure used to transport electricity from power plants to the grid."
    },
    {
      "id": "c55c543e-867a-4ffb-81d7-b55f3a9ceed4",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Jammu and Kashmir State Power Development Corporation Limited (JKSPDCL)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2e69ed62-5bb1-48a8-9190-28884f460c5c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Jammu and Kashmir State Power Development Corporation Limited (JKSPDCL) has been incorporated as Private Limited Company on 16th February, 1995. The corporation was incorporated to take over, execute, complete, operate and maintain all power stations and power projects of the state.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b49e1eb4-e79d-4528-beca-084a2a95c091",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Main Functions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8e22c28-40e7-4981-a4ce-9a2386b6f81d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The assets of all the power projects in the state, both existing and under implementation, were transferred to the corporation.\nTo plan, promote and organise an integrated and efficient development of electric power in all its aspects.\nTo investigate, research, design and preparation of preliminary feasibility and detailed project reports.\nConstruction, generation, operation and maintenance of power stations and sale of power thereof.\nConstruction of transmission lines and ancillary works for timely and coordinated supply of power.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b3d48331-2e4f-4b62-9108-3bc735434f4c",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Strategy for Future Development",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "060c976f-40a2-49fb-8d9b-755c40aaf624",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Micro-Hydro Projects",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "914c433a-e143-497e-80df-29c31a501ad9",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Though hydel power has a large potential in the state, most of the unexploited potential is located in difficult\/inaccessible areas. In such areas, the role that small and medium hydro projects can play in meeting the local power requirements by tapping water streams and rivers of small discharge cannot be overlooked. Moreover, the development of this source of power would also avoid the necessity for using other expensive fuels for which the state has to depend on external sources. This would not only increase the availability of power to meet the increasing demand of the consumers, but also reduce the loss of generating power.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6e0ec072-8f28-4d48-887f-cc32b214a67c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Renewable Energy (Non-Conventional)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d868c53b-0d17-4ead-be28-836a9bf54f6b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Renewable energy (non-conventional energy sources like solar, wind, and geothermal) can also play an important role in meeting the increasing demand for energy in the state.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "508876db-61ee-4153-925d-374dab781544",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Solar Energy",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2fc5bb9c-bfeb-4df6-9e7f-a815bd6d40f8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Solar energy can be an important source, especially for Ladakh, which presently gets electricity either through its hydel projects or through diesel sets. Ladakh is not connected to the grid and the villages in the region usually depend on diesel sets. The hydel power plants remain closed for months during winters due to freezing of water and in summers due to high siltation (the accumulation of sand and clay in water systems).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "177064b7-d4ed-4711-9d46-375e42e4431e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In addition, the topographical conditions are such that villages are scattered over long distances. Due to this, a central generating and evacuating system with large transmission and distribution network does not seem to be feasible. The power solution for the region lies in the dual strategy of concentrated generating system for pockets where population is concentrated and decentralized system for less populated areas.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1e7b249a-4519-4453-8c50-47bfb458d954",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Decentralized System",
      "content": "Local power generation close to where it is consumed."
    },
    {
      "id": "eb5e207e-1db1-4fca-b6e8-a453e31fd271",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Inadequate and erratic supply of electricity through the existing hydel projects and diesel sets, absence of conventional fuels like coal and lignite along with the environmental hazards of energy based on these resources make the option of solar energy attractive. More than 300 days in a year are sunny and dry, increasing demand for energy provides both the need as well as opportunity to use renewable sources of solar energy. It has the added advantage of widespread use, non-polluting nature and inexhaustible supply over other fuels.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ca8e3ec4-7887-49a1-a847-72815eacf5d4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In the case of diesel sets, the fuel has to be transported from the plains. Due to the region's remoteness and inaccessibility, the cost of transportation, operation and maintenance as well as cost of generation per unit is very high. The cost of generation per unit is around ₹10 to ₹12.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "17a3636f-5e45-4fa6-b1d0-26ab1b2e2fa1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Solar energy can be put to use for various purposes like:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ce9d99ba-5915-432d-aad7-a2d56ffeed4d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Home and street lighting\nCooking\nWater and space heating\nWater pumping",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ba37e812-2ddc-4bed-b010-1d0cc829c2f0",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Solar Energy Mission",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "44f20047-b3ec-4a01-957e-6d46f0924272",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Solar Energy Mission has provisions for entrepreneurs. The mission will give incentives to investors and reduce the cost for the use of solar panels on a large scale. This gives small and medium sized entrepreneurs an opportunity to enter the market which is fairly untapped. The state has great potential for the development of solar energy and the government is giving opportunities to players in the sector to enter the market.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "68f269c5-641f-4ed1-bbed-4c1c796b480c",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Solar Photovoltaic Technology",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8635c8e6-8ba1-4cf5-b5b2-5929957c4d92",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Solar Photovoltaic Technology (SPV) enables direct conversion of sunlight into electricity without any moving parts and without causing pollution.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e9be691a-f083-4d6a-901b-bb1fb3aac9ad",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Solar Photovoltaic Technology (SPV)",
      "content": "Technology that converts sunlight directly into electricity."
    },
    {
      "id": "04bd7cb6-64fa-4132-aaa1-04a6550b4c37",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The SPV device has, of late, emerged as useful in providing energy for lighting purpose and operation of various gadgets like hospital equipment and solar water pumping for agriculture and related uses. SPV is being used in the state for:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6c78f8fc-48b1-4f48-a2c5-5939d599484b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Domestic light\nStreet lights\nSolar lanterns\nAgriculture and related uses\nSolar water pumping",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eab68346-38ad-4bcd-935b-2acc806099c8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Ministry of Non-Conventional Energy Sources, Government of India, has been providing subsidy to the users to promote use of SPV. The state has also set targets to electrify the remaining unelectrified villages by non-conventional energy mode. A 40 kW solar power plant has been installed in Ladakh and 500 households are being provided electricity through this plant. It has been a success, having reduced the consumption of diesel to provide power.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "70c85d7b-983b-432a-aad8-a051f2690a58",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Geo-Thermal Energy",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b0bff602-63a7-417d-a1bd-481cec073785",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Puga Valley in Ladakh has a high potential for geo-thermal energy. The Geological Survey of India has done a preliminary survey of the valley by drilling at various spots. Its results are awaited. However, it is estimated that around 40 MW of power can be obtained from this source and exploitation of the same can further ease the power situation in the region.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "be491b46-f5f5-441b-b77d-2d46176303e4",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Geo-Thermal Energy",
      "content": "Heat energy generated and stored in the Earth."
    },
    {
      "id": "b865409a-06f6-47e7-913d-34effc1e0976",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Developing renewable energy projects needs technical expertise plus a lot of financial and administrative support by way of getting clearances at various stages and awareness generation about the advantages of using renewable energy. The government is expected to play a larger role with or without the help of private participants.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4b1f7bc9-24f4-4f81-bcc8-16bc83e7a95a",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Jammu and Kashmir — First Wind Power Project at Reasi",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6eb5a4c0-8b78-457e-9c82-28be5315541b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Jammu and Kashmir will have its first Wind Power Project in the state, and a site in Reasi's mountainous district has been found suitable for it. The Reasi mountains have a wind potential of about 336 W\/sq m at 50 m height. A project of around 10 MW could be developed in the first stage. The project is developed by the Jammu and Kashmir Energy Development Department.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2ad18832-9eb3-48b4-bee9-94d26a9f03bd",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The 9 MW Mohra Hydro Electric Plant, among the first of its kind in the sub-continent, was developed as early as 1905.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "29c59094-ec7e-4ae9-abf6-7ea22066d0e5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Jammu and Kashmir is the first state in India to award the 690 MW Ratle (HEP) Mega Hydro Power Project on BOOT (Build, Own, Operate and Transfer) basis through a tariff-based competitive bidding process.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bdf3e355-9da4-4019-ac92-b5368c8c20b0",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "BOOT",
      "content": "Build, Own, Operate and Transfer"
    },
    {
      "id": "9e8ec5f0-9ef8-4723-8c78-1f9c8f7c7793",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The JKSPDCL is also pursuing the development of a Geo-thermal Project in Puga Valley, at Leh (Ladakh).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5c276087-8209-439f-9444-2ea3ceeffdc6",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Important Data",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
