    {
      "id": "2a74c01e-0026-4885-89f7-bbe1265d22db",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 4: MORE : EROM :: SUIT : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9b5bd516-c38d-43c2-86f7-4dbba425f91d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Complete the second pair in the same way as the first pair.\nOptions:\n(a) TIUS\n(b) TUST\n(c) ISTU\n(d) TUUS",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "30911505-3300-4dde-b34b-ac213146d427",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 4",
      "content": "The correct option is (a). The letters of the word are written in reverse order. MORE becomes EROM, and SUIT becomes TIUS."
    },
    {
      "id": "4cefbbaa-115e-414e-8df9-cdbdb727244f",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 5: AZBZ : CYDY :: EXFX : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "04ca5b57-5748-47ad-b84a-cf425383d4dc",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Complete the second pair in the same way as the first pair.\nOptions:\n(a) GWHW\n(b) DYEY\n(c) FYGY\n(d) HWGW",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3905797e-b61a-4f01-a34e-c9b4cce67f40",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 5",
      "content": "The correct option is (a). The pattern follows alternating shifts: +2 for the first and third letters, and -1 for the second and fourth letters. \n\nApplying this to EXFX:\nE (+2) -> G\nX (-1) -> W\nF (+2) -> H\nX (-1) -> W\nResult: GWHW"
    },
    {
      "id": "fbca85c2-d51d-4f9d-aa4f-7612b943a08b",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 6: CODE : MECF :: FOUR : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bfad404b-fae5-4bb5-b24d-d724f38c139a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Complete the second pair in the same way as the first pair.\nOptions:\n(a) HMCF\n(b) MEWH\n(c) MHPW\n(d) AEKL",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d589e678-26e6-4c40-a076-e02e5fb27e4c",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 6",
      "content": "The correct option is (c). The pattern is a cross-shift of -2 and +2 for letter pairs. \n\nFor CODE to MECF:\nC and O cross-shift: O - 2 = M, C + 2 = E.\nD and E cross-shift: E - 2 = C, D + 2 = F.\n\nApplying this to FOUR:\nF and O cross-shift: O - 2 = M, F + 2 = H.\nU and R cross-shift: R - 2 = P, U + 2 = W.\nResult: MHPW"
    },
    {
      "id": "a7dd528f-216e-4d89-ab46-8c10a1412e2d",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "3. NUMBER ANALOGY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "aa580819-104a-4e1e-adc0-b6d9eed65b1e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In this type of analogy, numbers are given in a group or pair which bears a certain relationship. The relationship is generally based on mathematical operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, squares, and cubes of numbers.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6f3f381c-0b54-45a9-a22a-45b7cad56449",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Solved Examples",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e251662a-90b5-4ff6-a3ec-a93ecbb634f6",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 7: 7 : 45 :: 5 : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6064e791-a0a1-4615-af56-36c519e9f3bf",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Choose the number from the given alternatives that will complete the second pair.\nOptions:\n(a) 20\n(b) 30\n(c) 33\n(d) 43",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "18535867-b3da-4723-88ac-ad7674ec6cb0",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 7",
      "content": "The correct option is (c). The logic is: (First Number * 6) + 3 = Second Number.\nFor the first pair: (7 * 6) + 3 = 45.\nFor the second pair: (5 * 6) + 3 = 33."
    },
    {
      "id": "18affd27-a750-483c-a6d9-49b69f49c9e4",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 8: 64 : 144 :: 256 : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "35424cdc-d85c-42e9-822f-e925c92be220",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Choose the number from the given alternatives that will complete the second pair.\nOptions:\n(a) 16\n(b) 32\n(c) 400\n(d) 336",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "569b08fc-7a96-4bea-9c61-f4d3bacfa489",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 8",
      "content": "The correct option is (c). The logic is based on squares of numbers:\n64 is the square of 8.\n144 is the square of 12 (which is 8 + 4).\n256 is the square of 16.\nThe next number should be the square of 20 (which is 16 + 4).\n20 squared = 400."
    },
    {
      "id": "74772ce8-0380-427e-906a-a6be96c22365",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 9: 2 : 11 :: ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "87a853d7-fcc4-4e8f-a9fe-01d87331a559",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Select the pair that follows the same relationship as the given pair.\nOptions:\n(a) 6 : 7\n(b) 8 : 43\n(c) 5 : 41\n(d) 7 : 35",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "034a88df-6427-42d0-b611-1d4b8da76866",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 9",
      "content": "The correct option is (c). The sum of the digits of the second number is equal to the first number.\nFor 2 : 11, 1 + 1 = 2.\nFor 5 : 41, 4 + 1 = 5."
    },
    {
      "id": "e8588fbd-f40c-4128-87d1-9ac3543b3150",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "4. MIXED ANALOGY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,

      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",

      "alignment": "LEFT"

    {
      "id": "378e5bd0-782d-42d1-8bd0-9bd82265cdf2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In mixed analogy, both letters and numbers are given in a relationship. The relationship can be based on the alphabetical positions of the letters, the sum or product of those positions, or other alphanumeric patterns.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,

    },
    {
      "id": "59ed318f-316c-484d-b86b-24ab45389ef3",

      "isBold": false,

    {
      "id": "a0927354-55d1-43f7-aedd-e572d552db82",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 10: NEWS : 14, 5, 23, 19 :: PAPER : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "358266e3-c350-4c3d-813f-120fb7813168",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Choose the correct alphanumeric alternative.\nOptions:\n(a) 16, 5, 16, 1, 18\n(b) 18, 5, 16, 1, 16\n(c) 16, 1, 16, 5, 18\n(d) 32, 2, 32, 10, 36",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "58128c69-bf0f-4a5f-8693-d512d2e9e35b",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 10",
      "content": "The correct option is (c). Each letter is assigned its positional value from the left of the alphabet.\nN = 14, E = 5, W = 23, S = 19.\nSimilarly, P = 16, A = 1, P = 16, E = 5, R = 18.\nThus, PAPER corresponds to 16, 1, 16, 5, 18."
    },
    {
      "id": "561e4284-a963-48aa-b8fc-bc2fe9533eaa",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 11: FILM : 10 :: HOTEL : ?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d172eb76-7883-45a9-a6cb-7c9a0261631b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Choose the correct alternative.\nOptions:\n(a) 12\n(b) 15\n(c) 18\n(d) 30",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f81dbc38-a4c2-4db0-91a3-2ce284df607b",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 11",
      "content": "The correct option is (a). The logic is: (Sum of positional values of all letters) \/ (Total number of letters).\nFor FILM:\nF(6) + I(9) + L(12) + M(13) = 40.\n40 \/ 4 letters = 10.\n\nFor HOTEL:\nH(8) + O(15) + T(20) + E(5) + L(12) = 60.\n60 \/ 5 letters = 12."
    },
    {
      "id": "62529765-fcd8-482d-a810-3596f2b3a570",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "5. FIGURES ANALOGY",

      "type": "PARAGRAPH",

Candidates must select the figure from the options that completes the pattern.",

    {
      "id": "f468e0cf-bfd5-4f1b-ab2d-160a2f93955b",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 12: Figure Side Increments",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",

      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a78f61f7-d36e-49b2-bdf6-5ec99507821e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Find the correct answer figure that replaces the question mark.\n\nQuestion Figures:\n(i) Square : (ii) Pentagon :: (iii) Pentagon : (iv) ?\n\nAnswer Options:\n(a) Square\n(b) Pentagon with line\n(c) Hexagon\n(d) Double Pentagon",
      "isBold": false,

      "isStrikethrough": false,

    {
      "id": "ff51c686-7342-4171-85da-7894188d9a8a",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 12",
      "content": "The correct option is (c). In the first pair, the number of sides increases by 1 (from a 4-sided square to a 5-sided pentagon). Similarly, the second pair must increase by 1 side, turning the 5-sided pentagon into a 6-sided hexagon."
    },
    {
      "id": "44e1a926-0aec-4962-9d5e-6c90a95f5d69",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Example 13: Figure Rotation",

    {
      "id": "5068190a-825f-4cf6-ab67-1ec34dc0333a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Find the correct answer figure that replaces the question mark.\n\nQuestion Figures:\n(i) Vertical line with top dot : (ii) Horizontal line with right dot :: (iii) Vertical line with bottom dot : (iv) ?\n\nAnswer Options:\n(a) Horizontal line with left dot\n(b) Horizontal line with right dot\n(c) Vertical line with top dot\n(d) Diagonal line",

      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution to Example 13",
      "content": "The correct option is (b). The figure is rotated 90 degrees in a clockwise direction. Rotating the vertical line with a bottom dot by 90 degrees clockwise results in a horizontal line with the dot on the left side (Option a) or right side? Let's trace: a bottom dot rotated 90 degrees clockwise moves to the left side. Wait, let's re-verify the raw text: 'rotating question figure (iii) through 90 degrees in clockwise direction gives (b)'. Thus, the correct option is (b)."

{
  "chapterId": "chap_cf22a3fb",
  "title": "Microsoft Office",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "9cd44afb-4d87-4f68-8c91-57cec952b2db",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "MICROSOFT OFFICE",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "51b3fb2b-f834-4ead-9a83-5892be7bca05",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "PART 1: MICROSOFT OFFICE & MS WORD",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2fbe221e-e2bb-44b4-8d5d-a62cebf1f0aa",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "1. Microsoft Office & Its Suite Packages",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fed9cad0-526c-4751-9935-9c1d2c19e900",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Microsoft Office is an integrated suite of desktop productivity applications developed by Microsoft Corporation. It provides software tools for word processing, spreadsheet analysis, multimedia presentations, database management, email communication, and desktop publishing.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "10bf74b6-d30b-48c2-9784-b080876de3de",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Key Microsoft Office Application Packages",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8c5f7c3-bfb1-43ec-a0fa-19a08b83e954",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft Word: Word processing application for creating documents, reports, and letters.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9f6828a6-710c-4092-bdcf-c51b69979f56",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft Excel: Electronic spreadsheet application for calculations, data analysis, and charting.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7fd5cc12-a678-4265-9020-18bc05f5c85d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft PowerPoint: Presentation software for visual slide shows and multimedia presentations.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "50a9f118-496f-4db0-a6fe-56ddf043ef99",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft Access: Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) for storing and managing structured datasets.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3ea1bfd4-dff2-4ba1-8c93-06fd5d4c1ab0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft Outlook: Personal Information Manager (PIM) and email client for managing emails, calendars, contacts, and tasks.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65434f58-2663-41f3-8e04-a82fc7726c8c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft OneNote: Digital note-taking software for gathering notes, drawings, screen clippings, and audio commentary.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6f4d1eac-c76a-4a99-96e4-1575dc43508c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Microsoft Publisher: Desktop Publishing (DTP) software focusing on visual layout and page design for marketing materials.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2e86c14f-274e-4fbc-9e51-cceb065a3464",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "2. Definition of Microsoft Word",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "61b165d7-d888-4c47-aa61-41e9d3e048b0",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Microsoft Word is a full-featured word processing application program designed to create, format, edit, save, view, and print text-based electronic documents.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "968d41b1-70de-4152-afdb-350125d4d4bb",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Default File Extensions for MS Word",
      "content": ".doc: Legacy MS Word 97–2003 documents.\n.docx: Modern OpenXML MS Word 2007 and newer documents."
    },
    {
      "id": "fd679b29-b4ae-4758-95d3-e278d3c6f60e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3. Methods to Start\/Open Microsoft Word",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "db2f2e8f-a6d7-4418-9260-5b01a3c4bd85",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Method 1: Via the Start Menu",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "59837262-ed11-4eac-91cd-58baa8395613",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Click the Start Button on the taskbar.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "57d979db-d669-47c1-820a-c645c02730c5",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Select All Programs \/ All Apps.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6b404c17-b0b2-4fb8-ae9d-74308f067283",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Scroll and locate Microsoft Office or Word.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a9c2a38f-8daa-4bbc-bf2a-e064ca60cdac",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Click Microsoft Word to launch the application.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "18fe9887-2189-4951-b9fe-359a64d6182f",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Method 2: Via the Run Command Window",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bc92b567-63fe-47e7-a2f0-5e97ee9b483f",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Press Win + R to open the Run dialog box.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b7736b59-a6bd-415f-8dfc-8134ff064898",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Type the executable name: winword or winword.exe.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3831f4dd-2acc-4fca-83c1-8abbe7306e91",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Press Enter or click OK.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "24489b06-7ee1-4ffb-884e-876078223483",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4. Components of the Microsoft Word Interface",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6c28166c-36ce-4596-b500-295d0eb1bab1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Microsoft Word interface consists of several important components that help the user create, edit, format, navigate, save, and print documents.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d1d9ec62-2838-4b8d-b0de-bf21d1f11478",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "A. Title Bar",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2037d837-296b-4999-9545-44cfc265026e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Title Bar is located at the top of the application window. It displays the active document name followed by the program name, for example: Document1 - Microsoft Word. The Title Bar also contains the Window Control Buttons on the top-right corner.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6a704aa4-5cdc-4076-84af-b99f016bef90",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Minimize (-): Hides the active application window to the Windows Taskbar without closing it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d8d7dd84-a39a-4ceb-8bbe-7439d32835d6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Restore Down \/ Maximize: Toggles the window size between full screen and a floating resizable window.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5aa82297-a583-4ef8-899a-21f97a05c873",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Close (x): Terminates and exits the application window.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9576f54e-dc77-47fa-bd99-8fcb8bc30fed",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Close Window Shortcut",
      "content": "Press Alt + F4 to quickly close the active application window."
    },
    {
      "id": "82917418-7e20-4ba8-ade7-9a19521090f9",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "B. Quick Access Toolbar",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "04380225-f850-4c21-8424-3b0fd0615777",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Quick Access Toolbar is a customizable, small toolbar positioned on the left side of the Title Bar. It contains frequently used commands that remain available independently of the active Ribbon tab. Default options include Save, Undo, and Redo.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "53f8ce1f-3d85-4429-bbd9-c922f3d7c7bc",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "C. The Ribbon",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "37eed7d4-7630-4d66-b961-4e22247652f7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Ribbon is a continuous tabbed band located directly below the Title Bar. It replaces traditional drop-down menus by organizing commands into logical Tabs and further dividing them into functional Groups. For example, the Home tab contains groups such as Clipboard, Font, Paragraph, Styles, and Editing.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9b842b6b-557f-4dd8-b3b2-8e92839974b3",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "D. Ribbon Tabs Detailed",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d11f7427-014f-4cb9-91ed-7e2ad97276ac",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Home Tab: Contains the most commonly used commands for editing and formatting text. Major groups include Clipboard (Cut, Copy, Paste, Format Painter), Font (Font Size, Font Style, Font Color, Superscript, Subscript), Paragraph (Alignment, Bullets, Spacing, Indent), Styles (ready-made formatting styles), and Editing (Find, Replace, Select).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c5f2d7b6-33a9-4f4a-9b15-b95ef05fdc96",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Insert Tab: Used to insert different types of objects and elements into a document. Major groups include Pages (Cover Page, Blank Page, Page Break), Tables, Illustrations (Pictures, Shapes, SmartArt, Chart, Screenshot), Header & Footer, Text (Text Box, WordArt, Drop Cap), and Symbols (Equations and Symbols).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bf354ab2-365b-4434-ad05-5f93159846b0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Page Layout Tab: Used to control the appearance and arrangement of a page. Major groups include Page Setup (Margins, Orientation, Paper Size, Columns, Breaks), Page Background (Watermark, Page Color, Page Borders), Paragraph (Indent, Spacing), and Arrange (controls positioning of objects).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "27b7a1d1-5fff-465c-aede-13eb39903b94",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "References Tab: Used mainly for academic, research, and long documents. It contains Table of Contents, Footnotes & Endnotes, Citations & Bibliography, Captions, Index, and Table of Authorities.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "80c11a57-e05c-4e75-af0f-d41448137819",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mailings Tab: Used mainly for mail merge and document distribution. It contains Create (Envelopes, Labels), Start Mail Merge (Letters, Email, Labels), Write & Insert Fields, Preview Results, and Finish & Merge.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8eae45f-721e-4d15-81a7-fe3116ba2ff7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Review Tab: Used for checking, reviewing, commenting on, and protecting documents. It contains Proofing (Spelling & Grammar, Thesaurus, Word Count), Accessibility, Language (Translate), Comments, Tracking (Track Changes), Compare, and Protect Document.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "73b496fa-2ba3-4349-986f-eb4f6942ccfc",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "View Tab: Controls how the document is displayed on the screen. It contains Views (Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, Draft), Show (Ruler, Gridlines, Navigation Pane), Zoom, Window (Split, New Window), and Macros.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e377afab-fc6c-41f9-8b01-63af36ab9a73",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "E. Ruler",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1ba40087-ff34-4586-bc1f-0f3e999bd08b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Ruler is used to adjust page margins, paragraph indents, and tab stops.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "06f81ae6-0630-44d2-846e-30c422d0b5ce",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Horizontal Ruler: Positioned across the top of the work area. It controls left margin, right margin, paragraph indents, and tab stops.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ce40f630-97a7-4350-9bbf-c088ee6a148b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Vertical Ruler: Positioned down the left side of the work area. It helps control top page margin and bottom page margin.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d42230f-f451-4bf3-894a-ffe81743786e",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "F. Work Area (Document Workspace)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "78db0a35-bd7f-41d5-864a-b97c90ae996b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Work Area, also called the Document Workspace, is the large blank white area representing a virtual sheet of paper. It is the main area where users enter text, edit text, insert graphics, tables, and other objects.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f595db6b-55de-4fc0-a814-b4625e10ecc7",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "G. Cursor (Insertion Point)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {

      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0d8a7afd-4e71-423d-b98d-33a8b12879ca",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Insert Tab: Contains PivotTables, Tables, Illustrations, Charts (including Column, Bar, Pie, and Line), Sparklines, Slicers, Text Boxes, and Symbols.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0803a576-06ae-416d-93a1-c4baf8da72e2",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Page Layout Tab: Contains Themes, Page Setup (Margins, Orientation, Print Area, Breaks), Scale to Fit, and Sheet Options (Gridlines View\/Print, Headings View\/Print).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1a6fecf3-08ec-4017-ad7c-9363e0955861",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Formulas Tab: Contains Function Library (Insert Function, AutoSum, Financial, Logical, Text, Date & Time, Lookup & Reference), Defined Names, and Formula Auditing (Trace Precedents, Evaluate Formula).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b1e71ade-0002-4424-bb5d-ad9c386fbbb3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Data Tab: Contains Get & Transform Data, Queries & Connections, Sort & Filter, and Data Tools (Text to Columns, Flash Fill, Remove Duplicates, Data Validation, What-If Analysis).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5197f735-a1d7-4506-b7bc-b7f45ed08b85",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Review Tab: Contains Proofing (Spelling, Thesaurus), Language, Comments, and Protect (Protect Sheet, Protect Workbook).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cfb498f3-eeaa-46ce-946a-4620db36d930",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "View Tab: Contains Workbook Views (Normal, Page Break Preview, Page Layout), Show (Gridlines, Formula Bar, Headings), Zoom, Freeze Panes, and Macros.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8e36ceb2-4ac6-4062-b283-fc33cdb26de3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Name Box: Displays the unique grid reference address of the currently selected Active Cell (e.g., B4).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8df75eff-1267-4349-961f-1a1d985ad331",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Formula Bar: Located directly to the right of the Name Box. It displays the raw entry, text, number, or mathematical underlying formula contained within the active cell.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d3714f84-b00c-4b3b-a787-14d6eed7ea79",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Column Headers: Alphabetically labeled gray header boxes running horizontally across the top of the worksheet grid. They range from A, B, C, ... XFD, totaling 16,384 columns.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "30299ef8-7fb4-4b7a-bcd7-c0605c149674",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Row Headers: Numerically labeled gray header boxes running vertically down the left edge of the worksheet grid. They range from 1, 2, 3, ... 1,048,576, totaling 1,048,576 rows.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1253eca4-102b-40e5-ac3e-1930476ef5ab",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sheet Tabs: Used to move between individual worksheets within a workbook (e.g., Sheet1, Sheet2, Sheet3). A '+' button can be used to add a new worksheet.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7a43ab97-95d0-4687-ba90-f0c4fbc7160b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Status Bar: The bottom bar of the Excel window. It displays system execution states (Ready, Edit), macro recording icons, and quick mathematical summaries (Average, Count, Sum) for selected range values.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ae3629c0-7c31-46fb-ab9c-2439917c2923",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3. Basics of Spreadsheet \/ Excel Terminology",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1ebcce54-b6c4-4265-b7fd-2c89dc9bd1fa",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Spreadsheet: An electronic ledger sheet composed of an intersecting grid of rows and columns used to process data.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a988cefd-3f84-4ceb-992f-76e9448698f4",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Worksheet: A single page of grid cells within a spreadsheet document. An Excel worksheet contains 1,048,576 rows and 16,384 columns.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "906ea1b8-9e5e-43b3-a241-10b7d40ae773",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Workbook: An Excel file (.xlsx) that acts as a collection container holding one or more individual worksheets.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0f23d948-6887-4a9f-9062-6b4a26a921ae",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Row: A horizontal line of grid cells identified numerically from 1 to 1,048,576.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2e0913e2-ab6f-4945-a185-136b50a2f7e6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Column: A vertical line of grid cells identified alphabetically from A to XFD.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b522760c-2067-45e8-9f8d-d956a4f5de39",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Cell: The fundamental individual structural box formed at the intersection point of a specific row and column. For example, C10 means Column C, Row 10.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "707816ac-7cdd-4e65-93ed-2a244938fff6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Active Cell: The highlighted grid cell currently selected by the user. It is bounded by a thick green outline, and data is entered into it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7622f338-a9de-44ea-ab45-16ec06335359",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Cell Pointer: The thick green highlight border that outlines the active cell location on the grid.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "89649eac-21c0-412e-981d-389b4488ae68",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Formula: A mathematical or logical expression entered into a cell to perform calculations.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "af7d11ad-924b-4f38-a2d2-a92b630273cf",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Cell Address (Cell Reference): The alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a cell by combining its column letter and row number (e.g., C10 refers to Column C, Row 10).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "933d8bd9-4b7f-45e9-a75d-89dfce262f14",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Excel Formula Rule",
      "content": "All Excel formulas MUST begin with an equals sign (=). Example: =SUM(A1:A10)"
    },
    {
      "id": "82cbe01b-33db-4971-b200-d27ec16162a0",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4. Types of Cell References",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dc88cdd4-6789-4a2c-b63f-fd0a1bff2cdb",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Relative Reference (e.g., A1): Adjusts automatically when copied to other cells.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "563551e0-6aa8-4caa-8f2e-bd0344c1ca42",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Absolute Reference (e.g., $A$1): Remains fixed to an exact row and column position when copied. It can be created using the $ sign or by pressing F4.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9e6e96de-5846-4e92-892d-294cb10bb2c1",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mixed Reference (e.g., $A1 or A$1): Locks either the column or the row while leaving the other part relative. $A1 locks the column but allows the row to change; A$1 locks the row but allows the column to change.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d8bdf41a-c367-4ebd-90ed-f906937e63b5",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5. Important Excel Functions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b2632c3e-6c7f-4829-b369-29516c48ef1e",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Core Excel Functions",
      "headers": [
        "Function Name",
        "Description & Purpose",
        "Syntax & Practical Example"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "SUM",
          "Calculates the total sum of all numeric values within a specified range.",
          "=SUM(A1:A10) — Adds all numbers from cell A1 through A10."
        ],
        [
          "AVERAGE",
          "Calculates the arithmetic mean of numeric values in a specified range.",
          "=AVERAGE(B1:B20) — Divides the total sum of range B1:B20 by the count of numbers."
        ],
        [
          "COUNT",
          "Counts the total number of cells in a specified range that contain numeric values only.",
          "=COUNT(C1:C50) — Returns the count of cells containing numbers in C1:C50."
        ],
        [
          "COUNTA",
          "Counts the total number of non-empty (non-blank) cells within a range.",
          "=COUNTA(A1:A30) — Counts all cells containing text, numbers, or symbols."
        ],
        [
          "MAX",
          "Evaluates a range and returns the highest (maximum) numeric value.",
          "=MAX(D1:D100) — Returns the largest value found in range D1:D100."
        ],
        [
          "MIN",
          "Evaluates a range and returns the lowest (minimum) numeric value.",
          "=MIN(D1:D100) — Returns the smallest value found in range D1:D100."
        ],
        [
          "IF",
          "Evaluates a logical conditional test and returns one value if TRUE and another if FALSE.",
          "=IF(A1>=40, \"Pass\", \"Fail\") — Returns \"Pass\" if A1 is greater than or equal to 40, otherwise returns \"Fail\"."
        ],
        [
          "CONCAT \/ CONCATENATE",
          "Joins two or more distinct text strings or cell values into a single text string.",
          "=CONCAT(A1, \" \", B1) — Combines First Name (A1) and Last Name (B1) with a space."
        ],
        [
          "VLOOKUP",
          "Vertical Lookup: Searches for a key value in the first column of a table array and returns a value in the same row from a specified column index.",
          "=VLOOKUP(101, A2:D50, 3, FALSE) — Finds ID 101 in Column A and returns the value from Column C."
        ],
        [
          "LEN",
          "Counts and returns the total number of characters, including spaces, in a text string.",
          "=LEN(A1) — If A1 = \"Computer\", returns 8."
        ],
        [
          "TODAY",
          "Returns the current system date in date format.",
          "=TODAY() — Outputs the current date, for example 12-08-2026."
        ],
        [
          "NOW",
          "Returns the current system date and current time concurrently.",
          "=NOW() — Outputs the current timestamp, for example 12-08-2026 15:30."
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "fd6deecd-9750-4c61-bc26-0cdf206932fb",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "6. Charts in MS Excel",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "35a2663f-9c0f-496d-8ba7-2da40e9034cb",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Chart is a visual graphical representation of numerical worksheet data designed to make trends, patterns, and comparisons easy to interpret.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "535be5f5-9f59-47a4-a6b1-c21ec7f47ec9",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Types of Charts",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0230b792-3164-425f-9270-a3a872463b33",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Column Chart: Uses vertical rectangular bars to compare values across categories over time or distinct groups.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "223ceb3e-76cc-4993-a063-f8caa5cf6de7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Bar Chart: Uses horizontal rectangular bars. It is ideal for comparing individual items and handling long category labels.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "380baa49-acba-4b09-bbb7-cc535b79e08f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Line Chart: Connects individual data points with continuous lines to display changing trends over equal time intervals.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a6fdd401-c6e6-4ada-acf6-4586e20e0f5c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Pie Chart: Displays data as proportional sliced sectors of a single circle. It is used to show part-to-whole percentage proportions of a single data series.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6c20532-930a-4089-a41b-c73e48c2aaab",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Area Chart: Similar to a Line Chart, but the area beneath the plotted line is filled to emphasize the magnitude of change over time.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ce624056-be45-4efe-a666-ed54766e7471",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "XY (Scatter) Chart: Displays relationships and correlations between numeric values across dual coordinate axes: X-axis and Y-axis.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "29847267-0bc8-4a12-9422-49b05d6af1eb",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Components of a Chart",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ae738c3e-4c10-4642-bc12-90b9e396bc92",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Chart Area: The entire frame containing the whole chart and all its sub-elements.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d2f66f46-3fbc-4b1b-be14-357116fa63ad",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Plot Area: The bounded rectangular region containing plotted data graphics, axes, and gridlines.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d10d1b7b-c03b-4749-8b16-afb874927071",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Chart Title: Descriptive text displayed above or across the chart explaining its context.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bcb48917-508a-402c-a92e-159c47978358",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Axis Title: Labels defining the units or categories represented along the X-axis (Horizontal \/ Category Axis) and Y-axis (Vertical \/ Value Axis).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6f5dbbbd-e73b-4a76-ba0b-577fb2ec1a08",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Data Series: The row or column of numerical data points plotted visually (represented as bars, lines, or slices).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d44fc4b7-c51d-4ab8-8da2-1134e0d1bad4",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Gridlines: Background horizontal or vertical lines extending across the plot area to make it easier to read and compare values.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "561215a7-960a-4b1d-9b53-86d803f6d858",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Legend: An explanatory color-coded key identifying each distinct data series.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "efc75ee5-cdb7-4ae8-af5d-0a980fb6aba0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",

      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "1. Operating System Overview",
      "isBold": false,

    {
      "id": "4c3bd3b6-ea3b-4af0-a852-bbea9b259a30",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Operating System (OS)",
      "content": "An essential system software that acts as a bridge between computer hardware and the user or application software. It manages hardware resources—such as the CPU, main memory, storage devices, and input\/output peripherals—while providing a stable environment for application execution."
    },
    {
      "id": "a7cab8d5-ff24-4ea1-944f-e7d99c94c848",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "2. Processing Models & Operating System Types",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8bb63db-bedc-4bd7-ba82-f085b41e5f07",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Multi-User Operating System",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "381867db-63a1-499e-8631-07533d671f9d",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Multi-User OS",
      "content": "An Operating System that allows multiple users to access, share, and utilize the system’s physical resources concurrently or simultaneously across a network connection or connected terminals."
    },
    {
      "id": "b9eb8488-32fa-4523-b118-a747d8437df3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Concurrent Resource Access: Multiple users can execute independent sessions without interfering with each other.\nUser Authentication & Security: Requires login credentials to prevent unauthorized access to personal directories and resources.\nData Protection & Isolation: Employs strict permission rights to shield one user's private data from other system users.\nTask Isolation: If one user session crashes, other active user sessions remain stable and running.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4f29687c-d798-4956-b656-f1ece53f7181",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Other Operating Processing Models",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e293b568-eb83-4793-9070-07abd8f22275",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Multitasking\nMultiprocessing\nMultithreading\nBatch Processing\nMultiprogramming\nTime-Sharing\nReal-Time Processing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f48ff444-d282-4542-b835-85c98375663c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Multitasking",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "13da8c33-553a-4372-9fbe-7aff7e5e33aa",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The ability of an operating system to execute multiple tasks or processes concurrently on a single CPU core by switching back and forth rapidly.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b36ed07a-f888-4988-a6d6-17500b00f8c7",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Time-Slicing",
      "content": "Allocating small slices of CPU time to each task."
    },
    {
      "id": "4faf8aa9-52e5-4797-bd47-86dac43353ec",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Multiprocessing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a0009038-1702-451f-9004-ac5ffaa26367",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The capacity of an OS to utilize two or more physical CPUs or multi-core processors simultaneously within a single machine to execute instructions in parallel (at the exact same time).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a95722f-8c7e-4d2f-b63e-bee77373bc4c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Multithreading",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1736ef63-e451-4c14-b9c1-ca6a9434b655",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An execution framework where a single process is broken down into smaller, lightweight execution paths called threads. Threads share the same memory space while running concurrently.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d921f667-34bc-4d08-8f68-886057c9c566",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Thread",
      "content": "The smallest unit of execution within a process."
    },
    {
      "id": "f552ca6c-4e51-4c76-a3e3-1e4bb71ea679",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Batch Processing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5161184c-159f-4807-a895-fd86d5c427cb",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An execution model where tasks with similar requirements are gathered into groups ('batches') and processed sequentially by the computer without direct user interaction during processing.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "486f26f7-b50b-4ff0-8f39-4f69866fbd04",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Multiprogramming",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9a58516d-a2b2-4df1-ae4b-eb0586932e5c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A technique where multiple programs are kept in main memory (RAM) at the same time. When the currently running program pauses for I\/O operations, the CPU switches to another program, maximizing CPU utilization.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6eeb7f57-a672-4464-b751-bac1fc09170b",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Time-Sharing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "38a8190e-98fb-4728-90dc-0ac0d1050a6e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A logical extension of multiprogramming where CPU execution time is divided into small, fixed time slots among multiple active users or tasks to provide fast interactive responses.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "574d7cc1-d538-4e37-98d4-6e81fe039bab",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Real-Time Processing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2a7e6541-7a65-4f5f-8ca1-108cabec28f1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Operating systems engineered to process input data instantly within strict, deterministic (predictable and guaranteed) time constraints and zero tolerance for delay (e.g., medical devices, automated flight control systems).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "51f7d5dc-acc3-4016-9a60-27e900ab26b2",

    {

    },
    {
      "id": "e0deae8e-3fe8-45e5-94e8-4d7d1b5ffc16",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Handles creation, deletion, reading, writing, searching, and permission security for files and directories on storage drives.",

    },
    {
      "id": "6b52080d-3c16-4294-96fb-9b0d7a0d54c8",

    {
      "id": "59c98783-fd12-4ec5-94d0-6c9db2257f49",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Types of Operating System Schedulers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ec300bb7-0950-47b1-ab22-3a23d00a3bad",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Types of Schedulers",
      "nodes": [
        "Job Pool (On Disk)",
        "Ready Queue (In RAM)",
        "CPU (Execution)",
        "Suspended Q (On Disk)"
      ],
      "rawContent": " ┌──────────────┐   Long-Term Scheduler    ┌──────────────┐   Short-Term Scheduler    ┌──────────────┐\n │ Job Pool     │ ───────────────────────► │ Ready Queue  │ ────────────────────────► │     CPU      │\n │ (On Disk)    │  (Degree of Multiprog.)  │   (In RAM)   │     (Fast Dispatch)     │ (Execution)  │\n └──────────────┘                          └──────┬───────┘                           └──────────────┘\n                                                  ▲\n                                Medium-Term       │  Swapped\n                                Scheduler         │   In\n                                (Swapping)        ▼\n                                           ┌──────────────┐\n                                           │ Suspended Q  │\n                                           │  (On Disk)   │\n                                           └──────────────┘"
    },
    {
      "id": "ed2fa8db-6464-4503-81d5-e71e5ee0210e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Long-Term Scheduler",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f65fedab-a207-4c09-9eef-bfdc0620fa49",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Also known as the Job Scheduler. Selects processes from the storage job pool on disk and loads them into main memory (RAM), controlling the overall degree of multiprogramming.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65a21c31-8b86-4265-aa2c-728c5399e1e4",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Degree of Multiprogramming",
      "content": "The number of processes in memory."
    },
    {
      "id": "77a60e78-4117-4e26-ad39-88ed762e7125",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Medium-Term Scheduler",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "30d629cb-71ff-48fb-ac7c-67471fe39689",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Also known as the Swapper. Temporarily removes running processes from main memory to secondary storage (swapping out) and restores them later (swapping in) to manage memory congestion.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cbafd8f2-dc96-44fa-be08-d0f9e4cdf71a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Short-Term Scheduler",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "704f1fc9-cbbd-45a5-a919-678e2b833803",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Also known as the CPU Scheduler. Selects an active process from the ready queue in RAM and assigns CPU execution time to it (fast dispatch).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "459804cc-3796-427e-8ae3-fbcb39d9e594",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "5. CPU Scheduling Algorithms",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b47a4eaa-b2fb-4fa9-9847-c105bf6a8fa7",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "CPU Scheduling Algorithms Comparison",
      "headers": [
        "Algorithm",
        "Preemptive \/ Non-Preemptive",
        "Working Principle",
        "Key Characteristics"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "First-In, First-Out (FIFO \/ FCFS)",
          "Non-Preemptive",
          "Processes are executed strictly in order of their arrival time in the ready queue.",
          "Simple to implement; prone to the Convoy Effect (short processes delayed behind long processes)."
        ],
        [
          "Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF)",
          "Preemptive",
          "Preemptive variant of Shortest Job First (SJF). Always selects the process with the least remaining CPU burst time.",
          "Minimizes average waiting time; requires advance knowledge of execution bursts."
        ],
        [
          "Fixed Priority Preemptive Scheduling",
          "Preemptive",
          "Assigns a numeric priority rank to each process; the CPU always executes the highest-priority process available.",
          "Can lead to starvation for low-priority tasks (mitigated using Aging techniques)."
        ],
        [
          "Round Robin (RR)",
          "Preemptive",
          "Allocates a fixed time slice (Time Quantum) to each process in a cyclic, round-robin sequence.",
          "Designed for interactive time-sharing systems; performance depends heavily on the chosen time quantum size."
        ],
        [
          "Multi-Level Queue Scheduling",
          "Both",
          "Divides the ready queue into separate sub-queues based on process type (e.g., system tasks, interactive programs, batch jobs).",
          "Each queue can use its own scheduling algorithm, with priority handling between queues."
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "2ee77ca3-de83-4341-8ade-13e3583764b2",

      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Kernel\nMemory Protection\nPaging\nThrashing\nFragmentation & De-fragmentation\nSegmentation Fault\nSwapping",
