      "id": "adbe7e41-eea3-401a-ab6a-06261148771f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The electronic purchase and sale of consumer goods, services, and digital products via merchant websites and mobile applications.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c662b82d-2ad8-4a09-be50-7965751f200b",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Social Networking",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c19205f4-5d87-47f9-a2e4-a5a257291120",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Web-based platforms and mobile apps that enable users to create public or semi-public profiles, interact with connections, share content, and form communities based on shared interests.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8c3b7ec2-1fc3-408f-a545-911aebf3178a",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "8. Information Technology (IT) & Role of IT",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5872a4f5-956b-419d-b493-ba973cd7a92c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Information Technology (IT) refers to the development, management, maintenance, and processing of computer systems, networks, software, and hardware to store, retrieve, transmit, and protect data across personal, enterprise, and public domains.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "73806286-767c-4cd8-a719-34af884ab2f3",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Role in Education",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "58289e90-4641-4e0b-9f89-0f35e06ca5e5",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Enables remote digital e-learning, virtual online classrooms, and Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs).\nProvides online access to digital textbooks, academic research journals, and educational databases.\nUtilizes interactive simulations, educational software, and automated assessment systems to enhance learning outcomes.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bcff1f47-4d4e-4aaf-94d5-391e93fe4b1f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Role in Health Care",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "917dc172-a4fb-4792-a376-fe45b0f32895",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Maintains Electronic Health Records (EHR) for tracking patient histories across medical institutions.\nFacilitates Telemedicine, enabling remote patient diagnosis, online consultations, and monitoring.\nPowers diagnostic imaging equipment, laboratory analysis tools, and computer-assisted surgical hardware.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a3608a0-321d-4870-8eeb-ff0410d14e26",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Role in Governance (E-Governance)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "86fcff1b-9c47-4a04-abea-7445e4561e83",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Automates public administrative services, allowing online applications for identity cards, passports, and utility payments.\nEnhances public sector transparency, accelerates document verification, and minimizes administrative delays.\nProvides public portals for direct citizen feedback, tax filing, and digital document repositories.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c6bc0255-fe6c-4c91-9ca6-dac679798fe4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Role in Business",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "04bca864-9a31-4918-b4fd-ebe1523f115f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Integrates Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Supply Chain Management (SCM) systems to automate operational workflows.\nExpands market reach through global e-commerce channels, digital advertising, and targeted analytics.\nStreamlines financial operations, digital accounting, point-of-sale processing, and inventory tracking.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1c9489f9-c730-4fa8-a4a9-379f5c421fda",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Role in Design and Manufacturing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8174b605-859f-45cb-8208-e7c0ac144296",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Design & Manufacturing Systems",
      "nodes": [
        "Design & Manufacturing",
        "CAD",
        "CAM",
        "CAD\/CAM Integration"
      ],
      "rawContent": "[Design & Manufacturing]\n  \/          |          \\\n[CAD]      [CAM]     [CAD\/CAM Integration]"
    },
    {
      "id": "8c00e1a4-c882-4dcb-939e-b3e02957fda9",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "CAD (Computer-Aided Design)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "854dfb76-0f1d-47b7-b224-a2ded13eb670",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Software tools used by engineers and architects to draft, modify, analyze, and render precise 2D schematics and 3D product models.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bfd2056e-2d2b-49f5-9fdc-5e85b8f06072",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "CAM (Computer-Aided Manufacturing)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0ce2013d-2e5c-4d95-8445-4a85dd62af3e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Uses specialized computer software and automation platforms to control machine tools and robotic equipment in physical production environments.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a2258a9a-8ce1-4fd0-a2b4-d0f206c41819",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "CAD\/CAM Integration",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "42bd039b-413d-4253-9884-7e93298e0163",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Connects CAD modeling directly to CAM production pathways, using design geometries as direct input programs for automated computer numerical control (CNC) machinery.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3c31088d-00ae-4d9c-bb3d-663e8680b3d2",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Benefits in Manufacturing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9e3795b8-7690-407a-9751-e5c0ebb56cbb",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Minimizes engineering design errors and production flaws.\nIncreases manufacturing precision, repeatability, and structural quality.\nDecreases raw material waste and lowers scrap rates.\nAutomates repetitive heavy assembly line procedures.\nEnhances overall plant operational safety and resource efficiency.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
