{
  "chapterId": "chap_00dada6b",
  "title": "Computer Security",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "ff7be6bc-09c5-4a39-a61a-1737d11a9324",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "CHAPTER 7: COMPUTER SECURITY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2b70464c-2b0b-4bd1-9a30-2ef5edcd0c42",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "1. Definition of Computer Security",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3c567990-2e73-46d5-b145-c30a6a445563",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Computer Security",
      "content": "Computer Security, also referred to as Cyber Security or IT Security, is the branch of technology dedicated to protecting computer systems, hardware devices, software programs, networks, and digital data from unauthorized access, theft, alteration, damage, or disruption."
    },
    {
      "id": "bf463da6-930f-47f4-99dd-890231b6861b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "It includes the security policies, tools, safeguards, and operational practices used to keep computer systems and digital information safe and protect them from digital threats.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6ed00c38-4a80-48e7-aa9e-05775a5e30d1",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "2. Objectives of Computer Security (CIA Triad)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "142ed527-662e-42be-a6ff-be78cb9c9a85",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The primary objectives of computer security are based on three foundational principles, commonly known as the CIA Triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7f9161b1-f7f0-4a58-af97-9b894f1a66f7",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "The CIA Triad",
      "nodes": [
        "CIA Triad",
        "Confidentiality",
        "Integrity",
        "Availability"
      ],
      "rawContent": "     [CIA Triad]\n    \/     |     \\\n[Conf] [Integ] [Avail]"
    },
    {
      "id": "6e5d6986-d812-46ba-b7e8-21edd59e0367",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Confidentiality",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "68c69db2-79b5-4334-9994-b62c2a6ad8a5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Confidentiality ensures that sensitive data and system resources are accessible only to authorized individuals, applications, or entities. It prevents unauthorized viewing or disclosure of information.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9b5de633-81af-4e06-8434-0ee7cfce972e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Data Confidentiality: Protects stored, processed, or transmitted data from being intercepted or read by unauthorized users through measures such as encryption and access controls.\nPrivacy: Ensures that individuals retain personal control over what information is collected about them, who can access it, and how it is shared or used.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a462d4da-b98c-438c-91a3-739747fe7dff",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Integrity",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bdadc1e6-5986-4b70-83d0-2ab332ffc86d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Integrity ensures that digital information and computer systems remain accurate, complete, unaltered, and trustworthy throughout their lifecycle.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fb3e44ed-3206-4e08-b485-add01b3959b4",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Data Integrity: Ensures that files, messages, and databases cannot be edited, tampered with, deleted, or forged by unauthorized parties without detection.\nSystem Integrity: Ensures that a computer system performs its intended operations correctly and remains free from unauthorized manipulation or malicious code execution.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "04362050-124e-4864-9213-bf5310724184",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Availability",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "433e055c-d597-4e85-aa3a-182581a89758",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Availability ensures that computer systems, applications, data repositories, and network communication channels remain operational, responsive, and accessible to authorized users whenever required.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2dac798a-23fd-4b80-8f0d-855aa30841e9",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "3. Malware & Threats to Computer Security",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "50f14727-0134-487e-9037-c03a093207b2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Malware, short for Malicious Software, refers to any program or code intentionally developed to exploit system vulnerabilities, damage hardware, steal information, or disrupt normal computer operations.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5b22508f-4889-4fa5-842b-e5c438f7b9e9",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Computer Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4feff58b-fb6f-47e9-84e3-ef09034090b8",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Computer Virus",
      "content": "A Computer Virus (Vital Information Resources Under Seize) is a type of malicious executable code that attaches itself to legitimate host files or programs. When the host file is executed, the virus activates, replicates itself by infecting other clean files on the system, and delivers its malicious payload."
    },
    {
      "id": "77a77149-086b-4525-949b-39c12402cfe3",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Types of Viruses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "920450dc-bf65-482c-b0da-588f6a54909d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Resident Virus\nDirect Action Virus\nOverwrite Virus\nBoot Sector Virus\nMacro Virus\nFile System Virus (Cluster Virus)\nPolymorphic Virus\nFAT (File Allocation Table) Virus\nMultipartite Virus\nWeb Scripting Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8abf1799-9d87-4cdd-9f9f-5160c1ddb491",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Resident Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "559d1a26-b34a-4666-90f4-cf03a935fb8e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Resident Virus loads into the computer's RAM memory upon execution and remains active in the background, infecting new files whenever they are opened or modified by the operating system.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7749e34f-57c6-475e-93a3-7dfef7afdbf4",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Direct Action Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4eaa62b8-ccb6-44e2-9421-7029c367ee21",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Direct Action Virus activates only when the specific file containing the virus is executed, infects files in targeted directory locations, and then immediately terminates itself.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "290fa24d-cff0-42ab-b500-c016194be12c",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Overwrite Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "260038e7-1e02-4eb3-97c5-250e6b7804bd",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Overwrite Virus destroys file contents by replacing the original code and data with its own malicious code, rendering the host files permanently damaged and unusable.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "39500a2b-2ca3-423c-8590-7de75815b86a",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Boot Sector Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0451a5d9-5e84-4ebb-89e9-e89d2339a78d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Boot Sector Virus targets and infects the Master Boot Record (MBR) or hard-drive boot sector and executes automatically before the operating system boots.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f56e7036-d388-4ba9-9aa9-aca0b764dc98",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Macro Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5ca707e3-bb0d-4690-9987-40da5912089d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Macro Virus is written in macro programming languages such as VBA and embedded inside applications like word processors and spreadsheets. It executes when the infected document is opened.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "35d381eb-5553-46fa-8cef-ae3eeedff4b4",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "File System Virus (Cluster Virus)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "49e5beff-8205-4817-9f2a-399c5555cbcf",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "File System Virus (Cluster Virus) alters directory table entries so that the operating system points to the virus code instead of the legitimate program path when the program is launched.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4531bcb3-74e6-4bca-984e-3ff33bca5e19",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Polymorphic Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "263963a9-dc97-4974-8f77-4c67b7f0819b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Polymorphic Virus encrypts and modifies its underlying signature code whenever it infects a new system, making standard pattern-based antivirus detection more difficult.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f8f8fba7-9f92-465d-a961-4e471fde6cc4",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "FAT (File Allocation Table) Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0eae0194-fd4b-4411-b039-3050e72ddfa6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "FAT (File Allocation Table) Virus specifically attacks the File Allocation Table of a storage drive, corrupting file-mapping pointers and potentially causing loss of information about file locations.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0dce2e42-cb6f-4c4f-a26c-1bb9bb04cff3",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Multipartite Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9be51d5a-0e07-4b6a-8961-03c48c969420",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Multipartite Virus is a dual-action virus that simultaneously infects executable files and the storage boot sector, allowing it to spread rapidly across the system.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e11fb6ef-676a-4ab4-a720-ccf0699aa808",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Web Scripting Virus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3f87961e-0284-4322-94eb-eaddac959355",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Web Scripting Virus exploits vulnerabilities in web browser client-side scripts, such as JavaScript, on compromised websites to execute malicious code on a user's device.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a3faad7-09a7-430b-aa2e-8af79bd7f8bc",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Effects of Viruses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e8f19329-c00a-45e3-9777-a47fa0f9a7eb",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Performance Slowdown: Reduces processing speed by consuming hardware resources such as CPU power and RAM.\nData Corruption & Erasure: Alters, encrypts, or deletes critical system documents, software files, and personal user data.\nOperating System Instability: Causes frequent application crashes, system freezes, unexpected errors, or Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) errors.\nBoot Failures: Prevents the computer operating system from booting correctly by damaging boot files or disk structures.\nStorage Depletion: Fills hard drives with unnecessary temporary files, hidden directories, or replicated malicious code, reducing available storage space.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9cd961ff-5437-4c08-8ce4-b8ed5a9f80b1",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "4. Worms",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "586f62bc-ed2a-4119-9ae8-07355cbbc270",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Computer Worm",
      "content": "A Computer Worm is a standalone, self-replicating malware program that automatically spreads across local networks and the Internet without requiring a host file or direct human action."
    },
    {
      "id": "a1491e3b-e44b-4643-b8f6-9b47d97103e2",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Key Features of Worms",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e4e3fac0-1cce-4972-aa01-1e8445b0a862",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Independent Operation: Operates as a completely self-contained program without needing to attach itself to an existing executable host file.\nExploit Attacks: Actively scans local networks and the Internet to locate unpatched system security vulnerabilities and automatically breach vulnerable remote devices.\nComplexity: May employ advanced encryption, network-evasion techniques, and payload-delivery mechanisms to bypass basic detection barriers.\nContagious Spread: Replicates rapidly across network nodes, consuming network bandwidth and potentially causing server overloads.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4947a063-e56d-4b53-a2d0-11170725f133",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Worm Protection",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4e3e5abf-3d6a-42ef-b31c-71e24ab6644d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Keep operating systems and network applications updated with current security patches to close known software vulnerabilities.\nMaintain active network firewalls.\nDisable unnecessary network ports.\nUtilize Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS).\nRestrict unauthorized remote connections.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "28a055b3-c5e8-4745-81ca-4cd84ddeafb8",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "5. Trojans (Trojan Horse)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2046d0fa-bc14-4866-9b4d-5568234e87d5",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Trojan Horse",
      "content": "A Trojan Horse is a non-self-replicating malicious application that deceives users by disguising itself as legitimate or safe software, such as system utilities, games, media players, or software cracks."
    },
    {
      "id": "08b20bb2-ac09-4163-84da-605975d54ef2",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Deceptive Delivery: Appears harmless and tricks users into downloading and installing it manually.\nNo Self-Replication: Unlike viruses and worms, Trojans do not replicate themselves or infect other files on the system.\nBackdoor Access: Opens an unauthorized communication channel, known as a backdoor, on the target machine, allowing remote attackers to control the system.\nData Harvesting: Can log keystrokes, steal passwords, gather personal banking credentials, and capture screen displays.\nBotnet Integration: Can convert infected devices into remotely controlled 'zombies' that may be used to launch Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks or generate spam.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "30773fb5-1713-4530-a6a4-97ef43379742",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "6. Spyware",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4bc91d8c-948c-4b78-83ae-c7b5cd429d90",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Spyware",
      "content": "Spyware is a specialized category of malicious software designed to secretly monitor user activity, collect private data, and report user habits to unauthorized third parties without permission."
    },
    {
      "id": "fb88ef11-a783-409b-ab8b-befec657b488",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Detailed Breakdown & Infection Vectors",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f7a19a37-735c-46f9-b5b7-1a48cb907870",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Spyware operates silently in the system background and may conceal its processes to evade detection. Once active, it can continuously record computer interactions such as: Keystrokes through keyloggers, Web browsing history, Login credentials, and Personal communications. The collected information may be encrypted and transmitted to remote command servers operated by cybercriminals. Spyware can affect more than user privacy. By consuming processing resources and running background tasks, it may degrade system stability, alter browser settings, insert unwanted homepages, and cause frequent system lag.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2006a94f-fead-40b0-a7c5-aad3537151ee",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Common Spyware Infection Methods",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "57ce427d-195e-4b61-8f47-dba544632b95",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Misleading Marketing: Users may be tricked into installing software advertised as system-optimization tools, free security scanners, or media codecs that secretly contain spyware.\nPhishing & Spoofing: Deceptive emails containing malicious hyperlinks or attached files may execute background scripts that install spyware when opened.\nTrojans & Drive-By Downloads: Trojan horses may drop spyware onto target systems during secondary payload execution, while drive-by downloads can trigger silent installations when users visit compromised websites.\nSoftware Bundling: Free third-party applications or file-sharing utilities may bundle spyware components within their installation wizards.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8f810b7-f585-4302-a4b8-b31e3a750a58",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "7. Symptoms of Malware Attack",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b23d65bd-8e3c-4fa7-800a-fb28ada4b905",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Severe Performance Lag: Operating system speed drops noticeably, applications take longer to load, and programs may freeze frequently.\nUnexplained System Crashes: The system experiences unexpected reboots, crashes, or repeated BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) errors.\nHigh Disk & Network Activity: Hard-drive activity may remain high even when the system is idle, accompanied by unusually high background Internet data usage.\nBrowser Hijacking & Pop-ups: Browser homepages, search engines, or settings may change automatically, and unwanted pop-up advertisements may appear.\nDisabled Security Tools: Antivirus programs, system firewalls, or operating-system update services may turn off automatically and become difficult to re-enable.\nLocked or Missing Files: Personal files may become corrupted, inaccessible, renamed, or encrypted with ransom demands.\nUnusual Outbound Messages: Emails or social-network messages may be sent automatically to contact lists without the user's authorization.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3de06337-e6cb-4230-a4be-1e14e88bc9e6",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "8. Some Other Threats to Computer Security",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "db3ab89e-7401-4c03-908a-3209d4261e23",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Spoofing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3e1a25f7-86a7-4ca2-806f-faf4172e5e79",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Spoofing is the act of masquerading as a trusted entity, legitimate IP address, valid email sender, or genuine server domain in order to trick systems or users into granting access.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "58be1307-ca23-4c35-9ad0-b7a770e1b408",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Salami Technique",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a20bb6d-92cc-4bea-8d80-42c8a22e483b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Salami Technique is a financial cybercrime method in which microscopic amounts of money, such as fractions of a cent, are repeatedly redirected from transactions into an attacker's account. These small amounts can accumulate over time without immediately raising suspicion.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a6bf2948-fb7e-4d88-a722-87ee483a1353",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Hacking",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c9859f13-f6ce-4592-bfa1-c75fd8de58ac",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Hacking is the practice of accessing and exploring computer systems, networks, or digital infrastructure.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8f0c345f-b14d-43d6-b067-a3a1b3919ff9",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Types of Hackers",
      "nodes": [
        "Types of Hackers",
        "White Hat Hackers",
        "Black Hat Hackers"
      ],
      "rawContent": "     [Types of Hackers]\n        \/          \\\n[White Hat]      [Black Hat]"
    },
    {
      "id": "26c5f8d0-8505-4d78-8c6d-2d7cc93c3823",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "White Hat Hackers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "91d2c747-d431-4169-b73d-805a76f4ba18",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "White Hat Hackers are ethical security researchers who identify vulnerabilities in order to strengthen system defenses.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "43dc70ac-60db-4d27-89ec-365dbee10c04",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Black Hat Hackers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d1de2e99-3e10-4f36-9d48-c4f63b871c6b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Black Hat Hackers are malicious actors who exploit vulnerabilities for illegal activities or personal gain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6b523b9a-2089-4105-be85-fa86888c0135",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Cracking",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d10cd92-7f55-4d9f-8e13-bd5541de9c2a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Cracking is the unauthorized breaking of software locks, registration keys, digital passwords, or system-security measures, particularly for illegal or destructive purposes.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "70282a41-62fe-453c-87c6-24435b166e13",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Phishing",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a1239e46-5521-4020-a297-8f91a6473b82",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Phishing is a social-engineering attack in which fraudulent emails, messages, or fake websites impersonate reputable organizations, such as banks, to deceive users into revealing credentials or credit-card information.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a6058566-5997-47ac-ba3f-108e5e6906aa",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Spam",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b246a3f5-1f58-4b6a-a41a-19896479dcc6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Spam refers to the mass sending of unsolicited junk emails or messages across communication platforms. These messages may contain advertisements, scams, or malicious links.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bc9af5e0-82aa-46ed-b8c1-3081303131e6",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Adware",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5f166973-3cee-473e-a061-56444cc98e42",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Adware is software that automatically displays or downloads advertising materials, such as banner advertisements or pop-ups, on a user's screen. It is frequently bundled with free application downloads.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "60893f1f-748d-42d2-9e4e-7a6960b42fb8",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Rootkit",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e184f5a6-294c-4cc6-9b44-abf5436d3181",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Rootkit is a collection of administrative malware tools designed to provide deep or root-level system access while hiding its presence from operating-system monitoring processes and antivirus software.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8326d9a-9c86-472f-a0d2-821514f4e0b2",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "9. Security Solutions & Safeguards",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9feda605-f01d-469a-83a4-ceb0e00eff53",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Computer security can be strengthened through multiple security solutions and safeguards, including: Antivirus Software, Digital Certificates, Digital Signatures, Firewalls, Password Controls, and File Access Permissions.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b72f5921-62eb-459f-844a-13b5df851840",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Antivirus Solution",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a1de78f-3df4-48c2-8821-369b61ce8a9c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Antivirus software is a core security application designed to detect, prevent, isolate, and remove malicious programs from a computer system.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "97e927b5-53ba-465e-ae9a-5dbd59970e95",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Main Antivirus Techniques",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "15a63d9f-aa77-4c75-9edd-89711b8b690d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Signature Matching: Compares file code against a database of known malware patterns.\nHeuristic Analysis: Analyzes software behavior to detect previously unknown or suspicious threats.\nReal-time Protection: Scans running files, downloads, and web traffic in real time.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "01e6f922-3d47-4620-9605-d5cc1e0e70aa",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Popular Antivirus Programs",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6c188545-a554-49ac-b528-1217918fa8a3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Windows Defender (Microsoft Defender)\nBitdefender Total Security\nNorton 360\nKaspersky Cyber Security\nMcAfee Total Protection\nAvast Free Antivirus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5a36b30c-9ec7-4118-8195-1dcc0c5ca78f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Digital Certificate",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "41f9e680-7377-4105-8f82-4b2b0cf5b784",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Digital Certificate is an electronic file issued by a trusted Certification Authority (CA) that verifies the identity of a website, individual, or server. Built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), it binds an entity's identity to a public cryptographic key and helps establish secure encrypted communication through technologies such as HTTPS, SSL, and TLS.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a43816d-3cbd-49e3-9e93-7841d842ba76",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Digital Signature",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5538596b-d7ec-4fcb-959c-1230086ba8b3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Digital Signature is a cryptographic mechanism used to verify the authenticity, integrity, and origin of a digital document or message. It is created using the sender's private key and validated using their public key. It helps ensure that the document has not been altered during transmission and provides non-repudiation, meaning the sender cannot easily deny having created or signed it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "681ff21b-e6fc-4dc2-bc13-2e559e824094",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Firewall",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a4fa30c1-c361-47f6-8e76-c57403a7b144",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Firewall is a network-security system implemented in hardware, software, or both. It monitors and filters incoming and outgoing network traffic according to established security rules. It acts as a protective barrier between a trusted internal network and untrusted external networks such as the Internet.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2ffbef11-66f1-4a32-9b54-f935c0601d74",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Password",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "99896dea-7cfb-4b56-a03c-190a84083879",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Password is a secret string of characters used to authenticate a user's identity and grant authorized access to a system or account.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "210098de-99d1-42da-a773-b8e91555f327",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Password Types",
      "nodes": [
        "Password Types",
        "Weak Passwords",
        "Strong Passwords"
      ],
      "rawContent": "     [Password Types]\n       \/          \\\n[Weak Passwords] [Strong Passwords]"
    },
    {
      "id": "df53c21e-af86-42bd-8e0f-86003fdf2570",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Weak Passwords",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "15c78372-bed2-4802-8ad2-baea66f360b1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Short passwords, simple words, or predictable sequences such as '123456' or 'password'. They can be easily targeted by brute-force or dictionary attacks.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a5ee186b-7c1a-492d-a295-fc9dbb0dd250",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Strong Passwords",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "294431d0-0091-4175-a140-ac520cf816e1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Long passwords, preferably 12 or more characters, combining uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. They should be unique for each account and resistant to automated attacks.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "57f9258a-b066-49a6-8180-a70825672fca",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "File Access Permissions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "35174d3e-5672-46c8-bae3-6a50db5cd970",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "File Access Permissions are operating-system-level controls that determine which users or groups can view, modify, or execute specific files and directories.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3ca0af99-369e-4786-a1ae-16cd541768bb",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Permission Types",
      "nodes": [
        "Permission Types",
        "Read (r)",
        "Write (w)",
        "Execute (x)"
      ],
      "rawContent": "       [Permission Types]\n      \/        |        \\\n[Read (r)] [Write (w)] [Execute (x)]"
    },
    {
      "id": "229d258e-add4-4267-ab28-b7d8935c9f7f",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Read (r)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e1f8c1dd-bfd0-4343-a3c8-1b14782c3f4d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Allows opening and viewing file contents or directories.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9ea22b95-257c-46cd-8960-d105691e704b",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Write (w)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2bf4da72-bfa6-4c3f-b70e-a6b4ac351b02",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Allows editing, modifying, appending, or deleting files.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4c43a4ff-5576-4f24-a08f-000be99a3cd4",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Execute (x)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6dd7163a-b996-4d04-b800-e59cf1a089a3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Allows running file code as executable programs or scripts.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8c47826b-c7a8-4196-9728-3b7451a1f53b",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "User Categories",
      "nodes": [
        "User Categories",
        "Owner",
        "Group",
        "Others"
      ],
      "rawContent": "     [User Categories]\n      \/      |      \\\n[Owner]   [Group]  [Others]"
    },
    {
      "id": "b2afa5f3-0bcb-4713-b55c-af739b283b74",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Owner",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e68cdc9a-6ef0-4be6-885e-ce9f6143502e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The creator or primary user of the file.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3962372c-8803-4785-af74-ae286a6558b1",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Group",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a665751d-1a58-4a52-86fb-7f1e57fda642",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A defined group of users who share specific permissions.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7483b633-eda8-41d2-a675-34ba625c4894",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Others",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2eacec6f-67be-42e0-aeaa-c8b2ace58683",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Other users or public users who are not the owner or part of the group.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "665c04ef-8c80-42de-a6d7-ebc19b3b5993",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Revision",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "60db5260-f449-45e5-816c-6d3d9ea04120",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "CIA Triad: Confidentiality protects privacy, Integrity maintains accuracy and trustworthiness, and Availability ensures authorized access.\nVirus: Malware that needs a host file; it attaches to the host, replicates, and infects other files.\nWorm: Standalone network malware that can replicate and spread automatically without requiring a host file.\nTrojan Horse: Malware disguised as legitimate or safe software that can create unauthorized backdoor access.\nSpyware: Malware that secretly monitors user activity and may record keystrokes or steal private data.\nSpoofing: Impersonating a trusted system, IP address, sender, server, or user identity.\nPhishing: Fake emails, messages, or websites designed to deceive users into revealing sensitive information such as login credentials.\nSalami Technique: Repeatedly stealing very small financial amounts that can accumulate over time.\nRootkit: Stealth malware designed to provide hidden or deep system-level control.\nFirewall: A security system that monitors and filters network traffic to block unauthorized access.\nDigital Signature: A cryptographic mechanism used to verify the origin, authenticity, and integrity of digital information.\nFile Permissions: Controls that determine whether users can Read (r), Write (w), or Execute (x) files and directories.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "chapterId": "chap_085a4e83",
  "title": "Analogy",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "748ef808-f508-4045-bccb-178c742803b8",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "CHAPTER 10: ANALOGY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9015ecfe-e3fe-4233-a564-08890b7f23c2",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "INTRODUCTION TO ANALOGY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9ec499b9-fe46-425f-933b-25afbfa4e770",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "What is an Analogy?",
      "content": "An analogy is a comparison between two things that are generally thought to be different, but share something in common. In analogy questions, you are given two words (or pairs of words) and must identify the identical relationship that connects them."
    },
    {
      "id": "44172255-26ea-4c79-af44-b7904e39d556",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In simple terms, solving an analogy is not just about knowing the dictionary definitions of the words; it is about understanding the precise logical relationship between them.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "82cc13ef-981c-4f27-bce2-656d02d92e5f",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "HOW ANALOGY QUESTIONS WORK",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f6ed55e2-661b-478c-8e3b-a69a8d4566bb",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Analogy questions follow a standard logical pattern:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2f716c3e-7c67-457c-8bd0-8167232a8f72",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "FORMULA",
      "title": "The Basic Analogy Pattern",
      "content": "A : B :: C : D\n(This is read as: 'A is to B as C is to D')"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a378a59-54c5-40c7-b3f8-9ed0f691c590",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "This formula dictates that whatever relationship exists between the first pair (A and B) must be exactly replicated in the second pair (C and D).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "da76da61-25fa-4768-a25f-3fb40b574d21",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Analogy Solving Workflow",
      "nodes": [
        "Analyze Pair 1 (A : B)",
        "Identify the Exact Relationship",
        "Apply Relationship to Pair 2 (C : D)",
        "Select the Correct Option"
      ],
      "rawContent": "A : B -> Identify Relationship -> Apply to C -> Find D"
    },
    {
      "id": "c3bca225-a647-4223-8b71-04294e9cc121",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "IMPORTANT TYPES OF RELATIONSHIPS IN ANALOGY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5df0cf4f-ba78-447d-8387-d1999809f275",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "1. Opposite \/ Antonym Relationship",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d1382768-88bb-4d77-8b80-fb0976c96f5e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The words in the pair express opposite meanings.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9925f157-a7c3-41ea-8303-dba93616f98a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Advance : Retreat (Advance means to move forward; Retreat means to move backward)\nAppear : Vanish (Appear means to become visible; Vanish means to disappear)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b451f83e-f8f7-4e42-bbbb-c8a0eed1b203",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "2. Object : Tool Relationship",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ea465a2f-cba7-4d67-ad0d-a52dcdde21c4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "One word represents an object or material, and the other represents the specific tool used to work on or cut that object.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5dfd295e-95ab-4396-8b3d-89d9a382e709",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Wood : Saw (A saw is a tool specifically used to cut wood)\nButter : Knife (A knife is a tool used to cut or spread butter)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "869de8e9-d944-44b5-9fdc-9aa0f8b97f15",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3. Synonym \/ Similar Meaning Relationship",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2b8dd6e7-ecc2-4a33-9a04-d3d016af3e15",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The words in the pair share similar or closely related meanings.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "91bc47f7-5af1-43e2-9bec-4da1b6bee4fc",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Nascent : Germinal (Both words relate to the beginning or early development stage)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bfc50372-4514-487e-b729-e74d25229bf5",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4. Degree \/ Intensity Relationship",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5f08a812-5e6b-4f74-8841-c6ca30ce19c6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "One word represents an action that reduces or alters a certain quality represented by the other word.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7b2e5962-070a-41c1-8002-00715e226c41",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Slacken : Tension (Slackening reduces tension)\nBlunt : Sharpness (Blunting reduces sharpness)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f32327be-8aa0-4284-9757-1a1ae9b01f0f",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "STEP-BY-STEP SOLVING STRATEGY",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7c2747bf-d27a-49e8-92de-4e5db27fa3b5",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Step 1 — Read the First Pair Carefully: Identify the exact relationship between the first two words.\nStep 2 — Express the Relationship in Simple Words: Formulate a simple sentence describing how the first word relates to the second (e.g., 'Pure is the opposite of contaminated').\nStep 3 — Apply the Same Relationship to the Second Pair: Use the formulated relationship to predict the missing word.\nStep 4 — Eliminate Incorrect Options: Reject options that are related in meaning but do not share the exact relationship.\nStep 5 — Verify Meaning and Relationship: Ensure the selected option fits both the meaning and the precise logical structure.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "854e5ad2-ecee-47ac-be7d-2a828233b178",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "SOLVED EXAMPLES",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "90f2af41-50bc-4511-9a41-db62ea1d5769",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example 1",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b2dbef3e-1159-4020-8366-ce048e5d1a53",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Advance : Retreat :: Appear : ?\n(a) Withdraw\n(b) Live\n(c) Vanish\n(d) Advance",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1cfcca2c-a036-486b-9e93-6e111aad4bf1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Answer: (c) Vanish\nExplanation: Advance and retreat are opposites. Similarly, appear and vanish are opposites.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "365db85e-8d7b-461b-ad95-35a95554690c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example 2",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7dda025b-c77d-4709-9b47-f3e536cd3fa1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "WOOD : SAW :: ?\n(a) Ice : Igloo\n(b) Metal : Chisel\n(c) Butter : Knife\n(d) Paper : Clip",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3965eb36-fd46-4c13-8ec4-aa7a7d6643a7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Answer: (c) Butter : Knife\nExplanation: A saw is a tool used for cutting wood. Similarly, a knife is a tool used for cutting\/spreading butter. The relationship is material\/object : tool used with it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2e14d5a7-84b9-4f05-ae2d-0ddbd14ae1ad",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example 3",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8217ca1-d6fa-4051-a2c3-0285e5dcab38",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Misunderstood : Clarify :: Erroneous : ?\n(a) Correct\n(b) Right\n(c) Retract\n(d) Contract",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2456bd5a-185a-4b17-a6b4-1936299eb489",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Answer: (c) Retract\nExplanation: Something misunderstood can be clarified. Similarly, something erroneous can be retracted or corrected.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3c093201-3590-4a17-b22e-bd5a4550cc4f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example 4",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "356c97fd-5200-443a-9d40-6a4bfe0029ae",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "NASCENT : MORIBUND :: ?\n(a) Sophomoric : Puerile\n(b) Covetous : Greedy\n(c) Sycophantic : Servile\n(d) Germinal : Senescent",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c88eb6d2-7cf5-4314-b612-53a1855ccfe7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Answer: (d) Germinal : Senescent\nExplanation: Nascent means beginning or developing, while moribund means approaching death. Germinal relates to beginning\/development, while senescent means ageing or approaching old age. The relationship is therefore parallel (antonyms).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eb539ef8-e417-44b5-951b-76aab62ed17d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example 5",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eef81475-2c76-4ebc-80b8-448cdc07409d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Slacken : Tension :: Blunt : ?\n(a) Thickness\n(b) Sharpness\n(c) Shape\n(d) Careful",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7bcf8190-84a2-4b5f-8854-53cc172ccfe9",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Answer: (b) Sharpness\nExplanation: To slacken is to reduce tension. To blunt is to reduce sharpness. The relationship is action -> quality reduced by that action.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "07df7dd2-0bda-47fe-8d35-5845e813408e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example 6",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e376a2ec-d3f4-4535-8d6c-8f5ba11618cc",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "UNWITTING : AWARENESS :: ?\n(a) Alone : Companionship\n(b) Clandestine : Complicity\n(c) Egregious : Oblivion\n(d) Dormant : Torpor",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b1772451-e9cd-4838-88d6-c6a3a2098eff",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Answer: (a) Alone : Companionship\nExplanation: Unwitting means lacking awareness. Similarly, alone is associated with the absence of companionship. The relationship is based on the absence\/lack of the corresponding quality.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "50568217-32a9-44a6-bd50-ea251984a274",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eeb936ee-12f8-4fd2-aab7-79f5a9ceda1c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Meaning Match But Relationship Wrong: Do not choose an option just because the words are related. The relationship must match the first pair exactly.\nWord-to-Word Translation Pitfall: Relying solely on direct translation without analyzing the logical connection can lead to errors.\nBroad Relationship Acceptance: Avoid defining the relationship too broadly. For example, in 'Wood : Saw', defining it simply as 'related objects' is too broad; it must be 'material and its specific cutting tool'.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d0bc62c4-f6a7-4b97-a5d9-b00d72cbf120",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Exam Shortcut",
      "content": "ANALOGY = MEANING + RELATIONSHIP. First understand the meaning, then identify the exact relationship, and finally find the option that mirrors this relationship."
    }
  ]
}

{
  "chapterId": "chap_0e6c76e5",

  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "a0d258d7-8205-4b57-ad61-bcfde86bb5db",

      "text": "CHAPTER 9: IDIOMS AND PHRASES",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d2457537-0d97-4dbd-87c7-3551eedb8346",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Introduction to Idioms and Phrases",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65483a51-84f5-41dd-b5bb-b3af00c348a7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Understanding idioms and phrases is essential for mastering the English language. These expressions add color, depth, and cultural nuance to communication, allowing speakers to convey complex ideas succinctly.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c44241a9-341e-47a4-86af-61ed31cfceec",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "What is an Idiom?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b48b8f9b-7eae-45da-831e-f523803b3d67",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Idiom",
      "content": "An idiom is a commonly used expression whose meaning does not relate directly to the literal meaning of its individual words."
    },
    {
      "id": "ccb1f045-d469-46e4-bf87-54a0e76bea5f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "An early bird: Someone who wakes up early in the morning.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9cb13f2d-3904-412c-a8ce-b4d2d8257409",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Snake in the grass: A hidden enemy.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f2dedb9e-b896-4104-92ef-fd96a4d8b614",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "What is a Phrase \/ Phrasal Verb?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "08c51970-2176-43e8-acfd-3219ccc76610",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Phrase \/ Phrasal Verb",
      "content": "A phrase or phrasal verb is a small group of words that functions together as an idiomatic expression. It is often formed from a verb combined with a preposition or another word."
    },
    {
      "id": "1cf29e46-53fe-4c74-8434-557ff1b730bf",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Fall out: To quarrel.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bdecb0a9-9f24-4a00-90e8-08d8b3e026fd",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Take off: To remove.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c3a1873d-cc70-4c0d-ade7-cc9ba0132f0f",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Comprehensive List of Idioms and Phrases",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1846c9aa-9707-425e-bbd5-b569d0a771f7",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Idioms and Phrases (Part 1: 1 - 30)",
      "headers": [
        "Idiom \/ Phrase",
        "Hinglish Meaning",
        "English Meaning",
        "Example"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "Heart and soul",
          "Kisi cheez ka central ya sabse important hissa",
          "It means the central core or most important part of something.",
          "Now, we are getting to the heart and soul of the matter."
        ],
        [
          "Helter skelter",
          "Bina kisi order ke, idhar-udhar aur afra-tafri mein",
          "It means in a disorderly, confused or hurried manner.",
          "On arrival of the police, the strikers ran helter skelter."
        ],
        [
          "First and foremost",
          "Sabse pehle aur sabse important roop se",
          "It means first of all; something that should receive the highest priority.",
          "To be sincere and devoted is the first and foremost requirement for this job."
        ],
        [
          "Might and main",
          "Apni poori taqat aur poori koshish se",
          "It means with as much effort or strength as one can muster.",
          "She attacked the punching bag with might and main."
        ],

      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A preposition is a fundamental part of speech used to connect nouns, pronouns, or phrases to other words within a sentence. By establishing these connections, prepositions clarify spatial, temporal, and logical relationships between different elements.",

      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "What is a Preposition?",
      "content": "A preposition is a word used to link a noun, pronoun, or phrase with another word or part of a sentence. It shows the relationship of a person, place, thing, or idea with something else."
