      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4e2991a0-5354-4797-aa09-476c2636e4d7",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "The food is on the table. (Here, 'on' shows the spatial relationship between 'food' and 'table'.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1af29280-8e6e-4218-8ca1-e23e90e2dd0e",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "I am fond of chocolates. (Here, 'of' connects the adjective 'fond' with the noun 'chocolates'.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2d56f029-c28c-4dfe-a278-003a4fdc9540",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "KINDS OF PREPOSITIONS",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "25912463-f022-44ab-bd35-a495f6aa982a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Prepositions can be classified into three primary categories based on their structure and formation.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7cdfd989-2ff8-49d7-8d9c-8dbb1cdf4f93",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "1. Simple Prepositions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "83b777bd-b34a-42c7-a1e8-4166c9100ec0",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "These are short, single-word, and highly common prepositions used in everyday language.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b39e119b-976e-4d75-a387-cf23eac5e007",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Examples: at, by, for, in, of, off, on, out, through, till, to, up, with",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "38be37d7-23dc-4a36-9744-dfea403adccd",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: He is at home.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b030836f-61ee-4ab4-b8d4-96f1b167cb28",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: She came from school.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b906924f-0172-4292-b77e-f923f83df6c6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: He went through the tunnel.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "62979ed5-42b1-4265-a1a9-17f0783673f1",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "2. Compound Prepositions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c7d28f9b-c7ac-413b-a6af-1917960ed9ff",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "These are generally formed by prefixing a preposition (usually 'a-' meaning 'on' or 'be-' meaning 'by') to a noun, adjective, or adverb.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fc855510-77a1-423c-ad19-8f6e3a36527e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Examples: about, above, across, along, amidst, among, amongst, around, before, behind, beneath, beside",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3c60804f-859c-4f4e-b440-242358e6f835",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: He stood behind the door.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0f7fdaef-5190-4bde-be6e-3b6777caada4",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: The road runs along the river.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "44e799e3-8721-4055-a19d-7f3dce710ecd",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: The child sat beside his mother.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "14797672-10a3-4181-b783-7bc88068434c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3. Phrase \/ Group Prepositions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8cefcff3-c8d8-4d33-ac4b-f3534f29292d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "These consist of groups of words that function together as a single, cohesive prepositional unit.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "734c0097-a911-449e-a2ef-3552e7367e45",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Examples: according to, in accordance with, in place of, agreeable to, in addition to, in reference to, along with, on behalf of",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8ed20c81-584e-4502-ade0-3e9ac287bef1",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: According to the teacher, the test will be difficult.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1640972b-31c2-4d11-b2b5-f3fb854ca8ac",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: He acted in accordance with the rules.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2c297a73-fc17-4c75-a503-38d8652dd6a7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Example: She spoke on behalf of the students.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dd0da35d-419a-4128-bde2-3d06ffc7f2a5",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Multi-Word Prepositional Units",
      "content": "Do not treat every multi-word expression as separate words while solving a sentence. A phrase such as 'according to' functions as one single prepositional unit."
    },
    {
      "id": "c4876092-41a9-402e-be06-b1cb575bdc01",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "IMPORTANT USES OF INDIVIDUAL PREPOSITIONS",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9398afd1-dd70-48c8-9b73-bfe758a18c5d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'At'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bc74a406-6c9d-42b9-b2b9-c23dd515b097",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The preposition 'at' is primarily used to denote precise points in time, specific locations, and smaller geographical areas.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c1960bbc-0707-4285-b748-e6c6856c91fe",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "At for Precise Time",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cf255943-0965-4036-b24c-6d299695b1e8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'at' when referring to a specific, exact point on the clock or a distinct time of day.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a57b47aa-f8e5-4ec2-96fa-2a4312eb2f5a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "at 3 o'clock \/ at 5 pm",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8c7be3e2-337a-45a5-8361-8891e690fb00",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "at noon \/ at midnight",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7f88d8db-472e-4761-a5b8-4446818114ad",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "at bedtime \/ at sunrise",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f386b8a1-00aa-48e8-b965-f5fa3da26c4b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: That shop closes at midnight.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ee52ffdc-963e-4d1f-98c2-b02197bfe0ff",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "At for a Particular Point",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "27e42ba0-0268-4d12-84e6-d985f743335f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'at' to indicate a specific point, position, or target location.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f9f847a7-0c7e-4640-af64-f93faefba366",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "at the corner",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "38339e17-0629-4dbb-89b4-b1a500356718",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "at the door",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "317faebd-7aad-4810-a145-1e3ed8e21298",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "at the entrance",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "188a5368-f1cf-4284-8637-1961e3f0119d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: The shop is at the end of the lane.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "46e645b2-7189-4342-a543-24f106969e9a",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "At for Small Places or Towns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ed9ef44b-081f-4ac7-a9ef-9d1dcadd0189",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'at' when referring to a small town, village, or a specific locality within a larger region.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "aa80ab78-5832-4c0a-aced-513901afbe63",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: He lives at Alwar in Rajasthan. (Here, 'at' is used for the smaller town Alwar, while 'in' is used for the larger state Rajasthan.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "658f3ed0-a525-47c6-801c-20dc6a761bd2",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'In'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65920b1b-3dd1-4d77-be60-5ba042b59223",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The preposition 'in' is used for longer periods of time, enclosed spaces, and larger geographical areas.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a73aa5b6-b9ac-48b7-a3a7-ba4bd30304f0",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "In for Months, Years, Centuries, and Long Periods",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cf54cdfc-1d9a-4a83-846d-ab7e9d244609",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Months: in May, in December",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5c1e4f43-7742-40e0-8a7b-771673fd2f70",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Seasons: in summer, in winter",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ae7277e5-07ec-4534-84df-b6ec7b7b1e34",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Years: in 1990, in 2001",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "500c7ca9-1e6d-4afd-8a85-31eb2e79dcd3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Centuries & Eras: in the next century, in the Ice Age",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "558cb1a1-cae0-4a36-a8c4-8d21327b6e40",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: There should be a lot of progress in the next century.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "959fc0fd-3fd6-4cf1-8979-ba2bbefd2097",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "In for Enclosed Spaces",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3b0ba983-82fd-4415-ada7-83a1bd2930db",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'in' when an object is inside a bounded, three-dimensional, or enclosed space.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e7acd694-5a1f-4562-b3c4-6ecc4601aaf3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "in the garden",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "15982f5d-fc77-42ab-97eb-94a1e5c7784c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "in a building \/ in a room",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2b17760d-eb32-4f89-86c2-54591b712f69",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "in a box \/ in a bag",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9009e073-34c4-4b0b-a40c-d73f759e2be1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: Do you work in a company?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "95ad5ddd-f7f1-4369-bd53-aeec736d1b9a",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "In for Big Places",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "05e5f26d-b38c-4d42-9930-d17163e8b96d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'in' for larger geographical entities such as cities, states, countries, and continents.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",

      "id": "8d665825-9912-4a9c-8955-20209b4eef43",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",

      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Prefer X to Y",
      "content": "In exams, watch out for the incorrect usage of 'than' with 'prefer'. Always use 'to'.\n\nCorrect: prefer hockey to soccer\nIncorrect: prefer hockey than soccer"
    },
    {
      "id": "4aa8a193-cbe5-4aeb-af9d-ae1f5c9758e2",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'From'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,

      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "490d412f-ef62-4234-b573-aa1701d9e430",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'From' is used to indicate the starting point of a physical journey, a time range, or the origin\/source of something.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "824b903c-a66a-489f-aa18-8fd3a65291d7",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "From for Time Ranges",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c13fd92d-74d9-4075-bb38-9a2ad114442b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "When expressing a range of time, 'from' is paired with 'to' or 'till\/until'.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6e5c3a3d-0355-4df8-aec7-417d0d905842",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: The guest lecture is from 2 pm to 3 pm.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7899d399-3c6b-4ca4-9cea-76177c9bed5d",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "From for Place of Origin",

      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "91f03a73-a065-4d73-90ad-a93e2c64881a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'from' to show where a person, train, or object originates.",

      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"

    {
      "id": "0f951020-68a6-4b84-9efa-5506f5cc2c49",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "No Preposition with Last \/ Next \/ This",
      "content": "No preposition is normally used before a time expression when it is preceded by 'last', 'next', or 'this'.\n\nCorrect: last week, next year, this month\nIncorrect: in last week, in next year"
    },
    {
      "id": "57e863f6-a95c-4c98-94ca-f126555966f4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Since' and 'For'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "af095f4c-a0e1-466d-b98e-b37c957a61d4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Both 'since' and 'for' are commonly used with Perfect and Perfect Continuous tenses, but they serve different functions.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "499293ef-7acc-4042-8e40-52036375ad62",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Since for Point of Time",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e32b7355-550a-4458-b7d0-ae59fab69839",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'since' to refer to a specific starting point in the past when an action began. It answers the question: 'When did it start?'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b6c01fa0-d3b1-4aaf-89ee-3f80143ed958",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "since Monday \/ since 2002",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d3cf3fcd-412c-4349-b453-9ae5ead6de03",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "since morning \/ since 9 o'clock \/ since childhood",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "02fba51f-c356-4f74-9e9c-23a9f2525fe4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: Annie has been waiting for the bus since 9 o'clock.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d26acf6d-d587-4176-91d4-ffdc69add965",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "For for Duration",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "318d1da6-397b-463c-a65b-4244dcdbd5d3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'for' to refer to a period or duration of time. It answers the question: 'How long?'",

      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9a47a142-048a-4fbc-bc97-dca15d6c0be6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "for two hours \/ for five years",

      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c9421467-6c0a-4531-8279-428888d28f4b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "for half an hour \/ for 13 years \/ for several days",

      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8266666-b847-47d7-bc69-5bbffd1f1f3e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: Annie has been waiting for the bus for half an hour.",

      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e889ffb1-4306-42e7-91ea-e99ae8b45aa1",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Since vs For Concept Map",
      "nodes": [
        "SINCE: Specific Starting Point (e.g., Monday) -> Time Continues -> NOW",
        "FOR: Duration\/Period (e.g., 2 Weeks) -> Measures length of time from Start to End"
      ],
      "rawContent": "SINCE: [Monday (Starting Point)] ---> [Time Continues] ---> [Now]\nFOR:   [Start] === (2-Week Duration) ===> [End]"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6e14ec1-36fd-44d0-a827-6fa398ae1471",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'By'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "11becb83-f1eb-4a2e-95ae-5df76a4dc4e4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The preposition 'by' has several distinct uses, including expressing deadlines, identifying agents in passive voice, and indicating means of transport.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0dc48747-fc31-4986-b4c8-32f9e1a97509",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "By for Deadlines",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d66021fc-fd16-4de1-8998-0eac1fdf09d2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'by' to express a deadline, meaning 'not later than' the specified time.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eb3f273a-fb3c-42d3-8d5e-0ad718ec863a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: You must complete your work by this evening. (on or before this evening)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8923abc4-6217-4660-989f-fa16b158ef2e",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "By for Agent \/ Doer",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "64991c96-723a-4abd-85cf-a56ff708e7d4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'by' to identify the person or thing performing an action, particularly in passive voice constructions.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a30e6422-01b3-44fd-8893-4d29c8806f6e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: The letter was written by Suresh.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a881e4f7-7be8-448d-a365-cb57242de5d5",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "By for Vehicles \/ Means of Transport",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "328797e7-5662-4ab8-b049-6181841cbe5c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'by' when describing the method or vehicle used for travel.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fca93401-0448-4d56-b21f-371d5145c713",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "by bus \/ by train \/ by car \/ by air \/ by taxi",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1c062053-5112-43bc-85d2-d17d6cb0811f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: I usually go to office by bus.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "01b56f1c-2cbb-4710-ab3c-ae19bbd31617",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Into' and 'Upon'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "61c11167-763e-4115-90b8-c8f206bf5423",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Into for Inside Movement",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e84d5371-5168-4225-8abb-8a8cc096e2b0",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'Into' expresses active movement from an outside position towards the inside of an enclosed space.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dc5b37d1-0eb4-4dac-876c-b0433dd8b558",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: The boy jumped into the river.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8b406d4b-c790-431d-ad10-31649346358a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: Sara is keeping her mobile into the bag.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d1c160bb-48a0-425e-bef0-5a524e062c4d",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Upon for Placing on a Surface",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "314d69ad-0ce5-43fe-a6ba-85e107925b9c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'Upon' is used to show the action of placing something on a surface, or an action occurring on a surface.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dca85ca8-aa6a-4f8f-a5e8-ecd9e6ccebd5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: A dog jumped upon me.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b0db39c0-a920-4f0b-a874-d678cd409ef1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: Sanu was keeping the bottle upon the table, when I saw her.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "975ce262-0b66-42cc-8946-5d5f4f8bc418",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Over' and 'Above'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c14dde21-40fb-4968-be22-c7dffcdef6cd",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Over for Directly Upwards (No Contact)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d42ea472-8f41-468d-8f87-c1c7ce66246e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'over' when an object is directly upwards from another object, without touching it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "61cfea6e-d644-48e6-b619-14aa7b84b07e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: There is a bridge over the river.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7e118933-054f-4d90-98a1-b225f31b1a55",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Above for Higher Levels",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4b8b013c-ebd8-4de7-8f9a-4622835e849a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'above' when something is at a higher level or position relative to another object, without necessarily being directly over it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ac5c47d1-2ea3-45f0-8b8e-a593396c8fb7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: We were flying above the clouds.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c5883913-067c-4c18-b49c-40907c7871e0",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Under', 'Beneath', and 'Below'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7a30ba57-0b7b-4015-a7da-4d33ee34b7d2",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Under for Directly Below (No Contact)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "55258089-54d3-4300-82a9-4d57f5eff5dd",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'under' when something is directly below another object, and the two objects are not touching.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ebaffa25-0164-4bec-bb17-e9eeec8cf816",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: The man sat under the tree.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2060dfe3-f51d-4ddd-832e-9418f80e65fc",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Beneath for Directly Underneath (With Contact)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7c1108e2-44a6-44b3-9481-13ae5543f18a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'beneath' when something is directly under another object and is touching its surface or covered by it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "228f4923-a000-4364-a4db-d3436303c441",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: There are many minerals beneath the Earth.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "55ac2ad0-4608-4973-a4c4-36b455b66d55",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Below for Lower Levels",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "155ed09a-2ac0-41c9-8a90-d3cb10d1d349",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use 'below' when something is simply at a lower level or position relative to another object.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "735791eb-4046-4c12-8420-19ade317f14b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: Their office is located below our office.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "900d8614-8190-4bd8-aa3d-cfc6d04d8bdf",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Towards' and 'Across'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "faaee1e4-b770-4ed0-b76e-0b72469e66bf",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Towards for Direction of Movement",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "35b31d05-5a37-4bb0-bf08-11fda2c82ae3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'Towards' indicates movement or orientation in the direction of something, without necessarily implying that the destination is reached.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8672fdfa-5c93-4bc7-92b8-c2a6a1d81518",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: This road goes towards his home.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4c9abe4f-2124-41ea-9af6-7fa837dcf4cb",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Across for Side-to-Side or Throughout",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ae8be6de-0983-4ea7-abb5-5b3de12879ea",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'Across' denotes movement from one side to another, or extension throughout a wide area.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f1ab5341-a161-430f-bd40-9175a7ea99ff",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Side to side: He walked across the road.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "48cedf87-ea19-4175-b28e-c77e40385195",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Throughout an area: Their business is spread across the country.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "504c85f7-7067-47f6-a35d-15860f5044a6",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Behind' and 'In Front Of'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e44eca30-fadf-4fe2-bb3a-3812c26fd251",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "These prepositions express opposite spatial relationships.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "437429df-9e7e-42a4-b8be-8e803f59e81e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Behind: Positioned at or towards the back of something. (e.g., He is sitting behind me.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "64f60574-07af-4c55-9737-a9322b66a3bf",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "In Front Of: Positioned at the front side or face of something. (e.g., He parked the car in front of the hotel.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f9bbc335-d919-486e-b2bb-0ee966443bf9",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'Between' and 'Among'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b9e8aff0-e799-48db-8bec-ca1f80ae3d44",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The choice between 'between' and 'among' depends on the number of entities involved.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "517fded7-af1b-4e38-ba00-572eba256df7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Between: Used when referring to two distinct persons, objects, or groups. (e.g., Chintu is sitting between Vibhuti and Pushkar.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e2bb1f13-3e7a-4bd3-b8ee-85c876ad803c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Among: Used when referring to more than two persons, objects, or a collective group. (e.g., Saniya is the tallest among all girls.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7f76dc3b-3159-4a66-8a93-5e5e2ea1298e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Use of 'With'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d00337fc-9ff1-4113-8dba-51ddbc79b599",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'With' is primarily used to show the relationship between an action and the instrument or tool used to perform it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d1a2213-94cc-450a-92aa-5fa5ecbe42a2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: She cuts clothes with scissors.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "930aa4ba-7c69-4a26-9498-ee9fc36459af",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: He is writing a letter with a pen.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "70e94f21-421a-4af9-b8ba-e6fdbc264a67",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "By vs With",
      "content": "In passive sentences, do not confuse the agent (the doer) with the instrument (the tool).\n\nUse 'By' for the Agent: The letter was written by Suresh.\nUse 'With' for the Instrument: The letter was written with a pen.\nCombined: The letter was written by Suresh with a pen."
    },
    {
      "id": "6bfec0ff-c8fb-494f-92ba-a528f3c2abb4",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "SPECIAL GRAMMAR RULES & EXAM STRATEGIES",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c400d32d-ac78-4dc3-b8b1-c6a869fac69a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Verbs that Do Not Take Prepositions",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e53a4baf-12e7-4a7c-a974-5e1fce900a5d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Certain transitive verbs are followed directly by their object. Adding a preposition after these verbs is a common grammatical error tested in competitive exams.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {

{

  "title": "Punctuation",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "864a4f84-170b-4239-9a8e-9b0e916b7931",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "CHAPTER 6: PUNCTUATION",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "696717a2-2294-40dd-969f-4e1cc3c62e9d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The word 'Punctuation' is derived from the Latin word 'punctum', which means a point or stop.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6a895021-118d-4b33-aa6a-eb7a75cecc06",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Punctuation",
      "content": "Punctuation means to insert the right points, marks, or stops in writing to make the meaning of a sentence clear, readable, and precise."
    },
    {
      "id": "5f132e40-1c2b-4e81-b04c-6ce2289ee67d",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Overview Table of Punctuation Marks",
      "headers": [
        "Punctuation Mark",
        "Symbol",
        "Primary Function",
        "Example"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "Capitalisation",
          "A, B, C",
          "Starting sentences, proper nouns, and acronyms",
          "Her Majesty, Mr President, CBI"
        ],
        [
          "Period \/ Full Stop",
          ".",
          "Ending declarative or imperative statements",
          "The food was delicious."
        ],
        [
          "Question Mark",
          "?",
          "Marking direct inquiries or questions",
          "What time is it?"
        ],
        [
          "Exclamation Mark",
          "!",
          "Expressing strong emotion, surprise, or emphasis",
          "Watch out for that truck!"
        ],
        [
          "Comma",
          ",",
          "Indicating short pauses, separating list items\/clauses",
          "Please buy eggs, milk, butter and bread."
        ],
        [
          "Semicolon",
          ";",
          "Linking closely related independent clauses",
          "My father never goes to bed early; he's afraid to miss his favourite TV serial."
        ],
        [
          "Colon",
          ":",
          "Introducing lists, concepts, explanations, or quotes",
          "For Diwali, I want the following presents: a video game, a mobile phone and a cricket bat."
        ],
        [
          "Hyphen",
          "-",
          "Joining compound words, prefixes, or written numbers",
          "Trans-Atlantic flights are costly."
        ],
        [
          "Dash",
          "– \/ —",
          "Marking an unexpected pause or interruption",
          "Salim asked me—with a straight face, I might go—if he could borrow my bike for the day."
        ],
        [
          "Quotation Marks",
          "\" \"",
          "Enclosing exact direct spoken or quoted text",
          "\"Silence in the class,\" said the teacher."
        ],
        [
          "Apostrophe",
          "'",
          "Showing ownership\/possession or contraction",
          "I believe that is Allen's pen."
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "7cca22d1-3073-40f8-af61-a4367928204b",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Detailed Rules and Uses of Punctuation Marks",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ad1578a9-dec5-4f6b-b8b7-1c8453d923ad",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "1. Capitalisation of Letters",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f6afcc31-3265-4682-a72e-06933d3d8e38",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Capital letters (upper-case letters) are used to signal the beginning of new thoughts and to identify specific, named entities.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "62ee4842-cc58-4052-a0f2-f13a7a2b348f",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "A. Beginning of a Sentence",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a728c865-75b4-451d-9d5e-333129fa6415",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Always start the very first word of every sentence with a capital letter.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bcdcc0df-03a7-4e30-82dc-15542183e15b",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Example",
      "content": "He had high fever."
    },
    {
      "id": "f91beb52-dca5-4ed1-9e27-110f28e51e2c",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "B. Proper Nouns and Titles",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "611735c9-1e43-40d4-a605-361f1a50ce6d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Use capital letters for specific names of people, places, days, months, religions, official titles, and honorifics.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eb09a05c-3bd9-4855-9f69-2e7562574437",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Example",
      "content": "Her Majesty, Mr President, Ashok, Delhi."
    },
    {
      "id": "acf1b51f-1a67-4c73-b180-e01e0cfff205",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "C. Acronyms",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8592bcc3-e602-4acd-a166-d832b993df6f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An acronym is formed from the initial letters of a series of words representing a title or proper entity. All letters in an acronym are written in capital letters.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "58e598ee-741e-4d79-bcae-6e1ed31cdb82",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Example",
      "content": "CBI (Central Bureau of Investigation), BSF (Border Security Force)."
    },
    {
      "id": "456d569d-432a-415c-9d79-4f58cdf46d17",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "2. Period \/ Full Stop (.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "478c09c6-b514-4f9a-90f9-4851416846c1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The period (full stop) represents the longest pause and completes a declarative statement or imperative sentence.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a74a92d-5186-4b2d-b210-f603f66f86da",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sentence Termination: End every standard statement or request with a period. (e.g., The food was delicious.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "23d7a7e1-669f-428e-bb62-c2652d005b9b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Abbreviations: Often used after short forms of words (e.g., Dr., Mr., e.g., i.e.).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9f16f790-550c-40e1-9f75-14ec88ccebd7",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3. Question Mark (?)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "92974a89-6ecf-401d-ae2e-14e43cbb8678",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The question mark is placed at the end of a sentence to show a direct inquiry or interrogation.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5900acab-387f-434b-b9fd-f2ce6b9499c6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Direct Enquiry: Used at the end of direct question sentences (Interrogative Sentences). (e.g., What time is it?)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fcff3ff1-731e-4762-93f8-3b669469efa9",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Note: Do not use a question mark for indirect questions (e.g., He asked me what time it was.).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9d2a1cd0-9eda-4cd5-98f6-a4492505d03d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4. Exclamation Mark (!)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bb26a943-a979-4f4f-ac14-59f9f71faa5c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The exclamation mark is used after interjections, phrases, or full sentences to convey strong emotion, excitement, urgency, or sudden emphasis.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cffda72c-deb1-4dec-8d04-f966d402e036",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Expressing Emotion \/ Emphasis: Place at the end of exclamatory sentences or strong commands.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6381502-b465-48e8-96f7-07e833456fd7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Example: Watch out for that truck!",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8294b835-5108-49fa-b448-0ee147a43eb0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Example: What a wonderful surprise!",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f61491fc-be05-4538-bbb4-da6c920105d0",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5. Comma (,)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f29b483d-5b9b-4123-819d-b7c766f6c4e6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The comma creates a minor break or brief pause within a sentence to keep elements organized and clear.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8e2ee9f2-5610-4f89-a9d6-984cc393662d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Pause \/ Break: Indicates a short pause within a sentence structure. (e.g., Malvika, listen to me.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "59d2bd27-d5bb-4b88-8de8-d38f4448d587",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Listing Items in a Series: Used to separate three or more words, phrases, or items in a list. (e.g., Please buy eggs, milk, butter and bread.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "91a4738d-c766-4385-967a-6484b4c0bd2a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Separating Multiple Adjectives: Separates two or more coordinate adjectives that describe the same noun. (e.g., He is a charming, attentive listener.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b30821d1-e7a0-4959-86b9-a63f504b38ac",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Introductory Phrases: Separates an introductory clause or prepositional phrase from the main sentence clause. (e.g., After the show, Ashok and I went out to dinner.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f28cde2a-c0e5-497d-bf67-053d962ce8ae",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Dependent and Independent Clauses: Used after dependent clauses that lead into an independent clause. (e.g., Unless you work hard, you won't succeed.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f5efd400-d649-4a8d-833f-d51d8852c433",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Direct Address: Separates the name of the person being spoken to directly. (e.g., Arvind, could you come here for a moment?)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a9b9e24-f40a-476c-9e72-80eeb18b2077",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Direct Quotes: Separates direct speech quotes from the reporting clause\/verb. (e.g., \"Silence in the class\", said the teacher.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a82b4611-6a1a-464e-b01b-63e9ea25f14e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "6. Semicolon (;)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1ff50845-8a7a-44b2-8b28-d27bb08d0d94",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A semicolon represents a pause stronger than a comma but weaker than a full stop.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2c54b09c-6bc1-4951-8be8-609288a28e4f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Connecting Related Independent Clauses: Connects two independent clauses (complete sentences) that are closely linked in thought without using a conjunction like and, but, or so.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "48557d97-6548-4402-83fe-336e854b4825",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Example: My father never goes to bed early; he's afraid to miss his favourite TV serial.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5257dd20-35df-4470-8fc2-6fe412c88ccd",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7. Colon (:)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a38f956a-9f45-45f9-9ac5-a102ca3ca0d6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A colon is used to direct the reader's attention forward to what follows it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8acf0518-0187-4ee7-bbdc-01e96c89ec90",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Introducing a List: Used after a complete clause to introduce an enumerated list. (e.g., For Diwali, I want the following presents: a video game, a mobile phone and a cricket bat.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2fcadeae-32e1-4d83-908e-9cdd8475d8a7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Introducing a Concept or Example: Highlights a specific example, core idea, or new topic. (e.g., There's only one person old enough to remember that wedding: grandma.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "669f32d7-83a3-4007-9761-359cf64b1f5d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Expanding an Explanation: Connects two clauses when the second clause explains, illustrates, or expands upon the first. (e.g., And so, my fellow countrymen: ask not what your country can do for you-ask what you can do for your country.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "df98b7e6-087c-49a8-b2a4-205dbf2bfc9f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "8. Hyphen (-)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ce4094b7-bfea-4072-b872-625892a0504c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A hyphen is a short horizontal line used to join words or parts of words together.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f69c0d5c-c421-42e8-8e34-a3d2d3c9f50e",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "A. Adding Prefixes",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7ed1e4ee-4b93-43a7-aa49-4bb549191eb8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Used between certain prefixes and root words, particularly when the root word is capitalized or to avoid awkward letter combinations.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "45ecfe6f-a4f9-451f-be5c-94f3a30690c4",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Example",
      "content": "Trans-Atlantic flights are costly."
    },
    {
      "id": "4c771ae6-6dbf-478c-ad82-444d50deaa56",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "B. Written Compound Numbers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0a8380f7-f305-4df7-ac0f-67bc20557335",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Used when writing out compound numbers from twenty-one to ninety-nine as words.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1dd2db4a-ab03-40db-ae0a-c690b7cad3d5",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Example",
      "content": "I have lived in this house for thirty-three years."
    },
    {
      "id": "8d303f8e-2216-498b-b85a-62d15ef6b588",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "9. Dash (– or —)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "caa059d6-fda7-4e21-b963-02c8cd14ad19",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A dash (en-dash or em-dash) is longer than a hyphen and is used to create emphasis or signal a sudden shift in thought.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ea45a8de-48d4-4a90-8d94-4d90d7cedbb7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Brief Interruption: Marks an abrupt break, sudden pause, or parenthetical thought within a statement.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e32e1adf-11f1-435d-9546-17d1834562d1",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Example: Salim asked me—with a straight face, I might go—if he could borrow my bike for the day.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2f7bcd41-aff8-4729-a07f-4b8e11b35198",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "10. Quotation Marks (\" \")",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "91ee879d-ba3f-437e-b8f8-c75ca8156aa3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Quotation marks (also called speech marks or inverted commas) enclose spoken dialogue or exact words extracted from a text.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ec411881-cbe3-4c47-962a-91390a75a4f5",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Direct Speech \/ Quotes: Encloses exact words spoken by a speaker or quoted directly from a source.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "580187f4-cdd6-4f4e-a4b2-905b6717a096",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Example: \"If you pick up a starving dog and make him prosperous, he will not bite you,\" John said.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c7be7c31-eadb-428b-a894-d0c20a9490e8",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "11. Apostrophe (')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d7b26d32-1598-468a-9d39-a919f64648c2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An apostrophe is a punctuation mark used to indicate ownership or to form contractions.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "28167db7-b617-4110-81b9-24c0e29e19ba",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Possession \/ Ownership: Combined with the letter 's' (or placed after an 's') to show ownership or relationship. (e.g., I believe that is Allen's pen.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d55a905b-0e9e-4705-babe-ff5a904fe933",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Contractions (Short Forms): Replaces missing letters when combining words (e.g., do not -> don't, it is -> it's).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "chapterId": "chap_0c7d0458",
  "title": "Synonyms and Antonyms",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "e2db9ffd-970d-41cc-a969-782d3446a884",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "CHAPTER 7: SYNONYMS AND ANTONYMS",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bbb6a9a1-206b-4be9-9695-d29bca935a9e",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "PART A: SYNONYMS",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8ad2eb1a-91d8-4851-aa09-7215b321c93e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Synonyms are words that have the same or nearly the same meaning as another word in the same language. Developing a strong command of synonyms is essential for enhancing reading comprehension, writing precision, and verbal ability in competitive examinations.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2bf43257-adf9-4e7f-bb95-29c4e819416a",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Synonym",
      "content": "A synonym is a word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language. For example, 'Abridge' is a synonym of 'Shorten' or 'Curtail', and 'Brave' is a synonym of 'Courageous' or 'Daring'."
    },
    {
      "id": "e48bd834-718e-4944-9633-6bbe2486e855",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Comprehensive Synonyms Reference Table",

      "alignment": "LEFT"

    {

      "title": "Antonym",
      "content": "An antonym is a word that expresses a meaning opposed to the meaning of another word, in which case the two words are antonyms of each other. For example, 'Accord' is the antonym of 'Discord' or 'Disagreement', and 'Deference' is the antonym of 'Disrespect' or 'Irreverence'."

    },
    {
      "id": "7f275cd3-4067-4f69-9c55-5a66270382be",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Speed: The distance travelled or covered by a person or an object in unit time. (Units: m\/s or km\/h)",
