    },
    {
      "id": "5f5c0ab8-ede3-4d45-bf73-b161c2ae2aea",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "1. Introduction to Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f1e2af41-e7a1-4670-9250-20d77ae20bd3",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "What is a Clause?",
      "content": "A Clause is a group of words that contains a subject and a finite verb (predicate). A clause may express a complete thought and stand independently, or it may depend on another clause to complete its meaning."
    },
    {
      "id": "f07cee25-9bee-466b-8aa2-9342a979522a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Clause Examples",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6525d258-a945-4b0a-8a8c-e61635fbad32",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "He works hard. This contains a subject 'He' and a finite verb 'works'. It is an independent clause.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b4e5681d-4466-41c1-9c33-bf119d25b540",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "because he works hard. This also contains a subject 'he' and a finite verb 'works', but it does not express a complete thought by itself. It is a dependent\/subordinate clause.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d325824e-4420-4d7e-9886-5e8dc10096c4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Clause vs. Phrase",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "df387f16-04f8-4a69-8bd9-e07554580fdc",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The most important difference between a clause and a phrase is:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3ab23d51-0b1b-4029-93c6-ea12a7f40268",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Clause: Contains a subject + finite verb.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5504dc52-9cbc-4b99-9da6-a8feb153b066",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Phrase: Does not contain a complete subject-verb combination.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5fbabddd-0a29-46fd-b79f-f6abfc1a2ee9",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Examples of Clauses and Phrases",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d8b449ec-60a5-4f14-aae4-4706f3fd2da3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "in the morning — Phrase",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0794cf59-89c0-4feb-bee5-66da0f8bdac7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "when the morning came — Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3831da1d-840f-4bcb-99b2-cd63501eeedb",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "after the examination — Phrase",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "57b35e5c-b871-47b0-a199-4856b514f87d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "after the examination ended — Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9e413674-9b30-4d34-a093-2665d01611fe",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Clause Independence",
      "content": "A clause may be classified as either: 1. Independent (can stand alone as a complete sentence) or 2. Dependent (cannot stand alone and depends on another clause to complete its meaning)."
    },
    {
      "id": "53360741-d23c-4b9e-abf3-b9cf48b5c9b7",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "2. Kinds of Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "50445f40-b364-41bf-a7a0-dcd4bf450520",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Clauses can broadly be classified into three major categories:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "96c3a312-7724-41e5-9c8d-0fa994d56659",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Principal Clause \/ Main Clause \/ Independent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "abf6eada-16da-498b-9667-ddedd282e4e9",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Coordinate Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a88ae8eb-ea08-4056-8515-042642c8211d",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Subordinate Clause \/ Dependent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "058e85b4-469f-4f05-98a0-9a3cb52a4763",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "2.1 Principal Clause \/ Main Clause \/ Independent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cb9d61e7-d93d-462d-af10-0783e009b0ca",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Principal Clause, also called a Main Clause or Independent Clause, is a clause that makes complete sense by itself and does not depend on another clause. It can stand alone as a complete grammatical sentence.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0a5a6fbd-ca0b-43b2-a261-2a5d6174ec8d",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "FORMULA",
      "title": "Principal Clause Structure",
      "content": "Subject + Finite Verb + Complete Thought"
    },
    {
      "id": "93a00dfe-6dfc-4db8-b83f-04d260ee3ff8",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Examples of Principal Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "16f53bcb-45a7-4011-a7fb-ae261a42b892",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 1: He knows that I am innocent.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fc7ac792-35e1-4385-b8f0-07d9cbef4d22",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "He = Subject",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1c81942a-4c36-4e00-ae84-8ee56a5ae1c1",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "knows = Finite Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "75b2561f-4403-4985-b5a1-1bdaa5a03304",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "He knows = Principal Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "898d3cff-2f30-43db-a822-d7ad3506db26",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "that I am innocent = Subordinate Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a76006d9-aa44-4f84-a438-3f0df043223e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 2: I went home because I was tired.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1dd2a114-3d78-4901-9e57-6bb7e7a77272",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I went home = Principal Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "929da9f5-1819-4772-8aff-6876e8831b65",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "because I was tired = Subordinate Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "827ffc6a-6d75-4ae8-bb61-13c20ba4c798",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Independence Rule",
      "content": "A principal clause can stand independently, but a subordinate clause cannot normally stand alone. For example, 'That I am innocent' is incorrect as an independent sentence, whereas 'He knows that I am innocent' is correct."
    },
    {
      "id": "8eaf11aa-6dfe-42f7-95b0-730b278d7386",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "3. Coordinate Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0ff38bd9-5e2e-4b4b-8576-03a38ae21c6d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Coordinate Clause is an independent clause that has the same grammatical rank as another independent clause. Coordinate clauses are generally joined by coordinating conjunctions.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "26342f31-8ceb-45a7-bc37-1c0307798300",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Coordinating Conjunctions (FANBOYS)",
      "content": "The commonly remembered coordinating conjunctions are FANBOYS: F = For, A = And, N = Nor, B = But, O = Or, Y = Yet, S = So."
    },
    {
      "id": "24bec33e-c895-4be0-a21a-26b3ed9d5bc3",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Examples of Coordinate Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ae7268a4-ce0b-4b38-8fef-86758d1a067d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 1: He worked hard, and he passed the exam.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "886f1c1d-ec05-48a0-b12b-8544464c128f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "He worked hard = Independent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b4f9859f-8232-4fa8-99de-25345ebdd0ba",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "he passed the exam = Independent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "79a4316a-af64-4625-a66b-fb11dd839623",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "and = Coordinating Conjunction",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7bad77fc-a6f3-47c9-9352-0554813d4003",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Both clauses can stand alone as independent sentences ('He worked hard.' and 'He passed the exam.'). Therefore, they are coordinate clauses.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c0039a65-14e8-472a-bfe6-721e4cb5a65b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 2: I wanted to go, but it was raining.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c95c2207-5546-4d55-acd7-64f2ba41f578",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I wanted to go = Independent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c624af92-b6d7-47b7-9e56-ba692e72a631",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "it was raining = Independent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ab93ab21-5570-4603-a584-76a34c63bbb5",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "but = Coordinating Conjunction",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2a28e075-d2fc-4c0b-b516-3badcabd2d9f",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Coordinating vs. Subordinating Conjunctions",
      "content": "A coordinating conjunction joins clauses of equal grammatical rank. For example, in 'He worked hard, and he passed', 'and' joins coordinate clauses. However, in 'He worked hard because he wanted to succeed', 'because' introduces a subordinate clause, not a coordinate clause."
    },
    {
      "id": "bde2249f-6ae8-4706-be1f-542b6c1a326a",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "4. Subordinate Clause \/ Dependent Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "46693a6d-f44c-458e-ac97-c024f922a6fd",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Subordinate Clause, also called a Dependent Clause, is a clause that cannot normally stand alone and depends on a principal clause to complete its meaning. A subordinate clause contains a subject and a finite verb, but it does not express a complete independent thought.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c36ed18f-96e2-46d0-b7a5-547fac29528c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Example of Subordinate Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1084bab5-2739-4c3c-bd08-534074fbd54b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: I know where he lives.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5d699ccc-cb11-4d7c-9c08-c9fb67715b27",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I know = Principal Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "eb349480-6939-4e24-8723-d8cf101e588e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "where he lives = Subordinate Clause (contains subject 'he' and finite verb 'lives', but cannot stand alone)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a5b39494-5d57-4b98-8300-8ec8a3a55327",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Main Functions of Subordinate Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1cf15d8e-a32e-400d-94d8-5f39375f3894",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A subordinate clause can perform the work of a noun, an adjective, or an adverb. Accordingly, they are classified into:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "db7107f7-ed15-43b9-8dda-09280941b489",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Noun Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "19d40ff7-bd68-469a-8214-1283f394edef",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Adjective \/ Relative Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8e946d4c-edd9-47bd-86b1-86698b3d9958",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Adverb Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ff650754-bfa7-408d-8591-b75fdbb4e3f5",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "5. Noun Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "25fda96f-8f69-4b83-8e21-69e989d3ecc9",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Noun Clause",
      "content": "A Noun Clause is a dependent\/subordinate clause that performs the function of a noun in a sentence. It can occupy positions where a noun or noun phrase could normally occur. It commonly answers questions such as What?, Who?, or Whom?."
    },
    {
      "id": "4b6eb65d-c793-4bdb-b035-cdfbcd401cb5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Noun clauses can be introduced by words such as: that, if, whether, what, who, whom, whose, which, where, when, why, how.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c4b3dcc8-82b3-44ba-8a84-fa4cd5db6387",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5.1 Noun Clause as the Subject of a Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7ae66fec-519c-42c4-8a3c-4cacc56af0a0",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A noun clause can act as the subject of the main verb.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f59b5a38-e6de-4e35-a4d0-ed2529c2ec84",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example: What you said is true.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4b693e28-8b21-4f18-be6f-38b802b732b3",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "What you said = Noun Clause (Subject)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a0319c83-cc62-4bc5-b662-08d7d39abc8d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "is = Main Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e55774ba-cf37-45f1-b49e-84fb9711f73b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Another Example: That he will come is certain. (Here, 'That he will come' is the subject of 'is'.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "62831cde-34f4-4495-83a6-8d6e89aa04a2",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "The 'What' Test",
      "content": "To identify a subject noun clause, ask 'What is [verb]?'. For example, 'What is true?' -> 'What you said'. Therefore, 'What you said' functions as a noun clause."
    },
    {
      "id": "e2837a52-48c1-48ad-b683-7713fa411103",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5.2 Noun Clause as Object of a Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d78a0766-8085-4148-9460-4067e5e0e956",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A noun clause can function as the direct object of the main verb.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a820bb5-8701-4e04-87b7-cc2093da8077",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 1: I know what you did last summer.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b315685d-5407-4fd1-b4f8-5018527a8c8f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I = Subject",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e1ee09b1-aa93-45b3-84af-4b6b207e43fd",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "know = Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7fa8c93b-b8e5-49fb-9bd7-dd98f1bfb65b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "what you did last summer = Object \/ Noun Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f16fae6e-f4fe-4372-be18-bcb8e80e1871",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 2: She asked if I liked coffee.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0251e0dc-e97c-4b31-8034-ebd3453d2638",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "She = Subject",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bf190aae-2fdd-442b-9693-53aa31213243",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "asked = Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e18d2752-f6a5-42a6-b499-f4366bdb4648",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "if I liked coffee = Object \/ Noun Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c36baa94-6364-4713-a0d0-362619679b9d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Other Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fe420f7f-8e8c-4e35-8c1e-a6b9c0fb9487",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I know where he lives.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2daee7e3-aa9a-479e-a8f6-122b47b0ed4d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Tell me what you want.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f0c0d5af-96ff-436c-96ea-7df18becae35",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I understand why she left.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "74831bd1-0cd0-480e-ba9d-53eb3045be85",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "She explained how the machine works.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "da5ae0a3-7eeb-45ea-8d44-065681efe57a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5.3 Noun Clause as Object of a Preposition",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a036a94d-c307-4cff-9639-7d142b18a5c1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A noun clause can function as the object of a preposition.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e0776336-f57d-463b-8f00-842fb469b2f5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 1: Pay attention to what I am saying.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2d4aeba9-6735-41d3-9fbd-c6cfb72b6201",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "to = Preposition",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a317ef7-834b-41ab-90e6-89094e66168f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "what I am saying = Noun Clause (Object of preposition)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2adb0766-4ee2-4cef-98d4-450b12563fba",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 2: Success depends on how hard you work.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d1269d2-c313-49c7-9d84-2aa324e69c6f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "on = Preposition",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a6a1f6f2-afb2-4a40-8974-f28258e2a40f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "how hard you work = Noun Clause (Object of preposition)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8de709a-77b2-4d67-9219-2c2128fc3a47",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Other Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0e9c4612-926a-4867-93e1-4fe9a4d1427d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "We talked about what happened.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "987b7cb5-21f7-4b4b-bb8f-87ae4aa22daa",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "It depends on whether he agrees.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dd75d52d-3e6d-4d32-a510-768a5a70a59a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Think about what I told you.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a071500e-434c-4a83-ba62-2639b58b0020",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5.4 Noun Clause as a Predicative Nominative \/ Subject Complement",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "717136c1-f80f-49e1-9488-dae297f5929d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A noun clause can follow a linking verb (such as is, was, become, seems) and explain or rename the subject.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "66936575-b8f3-4ba5-8457-801f416ddf64",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 1: Life is what we make it.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e005730f-0da0-4e87-88dc-1f3395d537ba",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Life = Subject",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "15549bd8-7b24-4b8a-a3d0-201cfa6d4d9c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "is = Linking Verb",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f98991f6-9191-4154-bad0-0e5a73e60858",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "what we make it = Noun Clause (Subject Complement)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "175bef24-bf35-4eac-a2c2-be5b370e412f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 2: The truth is that he missed the train. (Here, 'that he missed the train' explains what the truth is.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "270e22bc-a7d3-4cc1-ab5f-b7cf6f03c5f4",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "6. Adjective Clause \/ Relative Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e009e6cd-8b7e-4166-a179-3046ad24b215",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Adjective Clause",
      "content": "An Adjective Clause, also called a Relative Clause, is a subordinate clause that qualifies, describes, or gives additional information about a noun or pronoun in the main clause. It performs the same basic function as an adjective."
    },
    {
      "id": "1d750722-81ac-4e58-9013-23eb01ec0456",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Adjective clauses are introduced by relative pronouns or relative adverbs:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ab6d24e2-0089-446e-a80e-74a30f1ac7f0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Relative Pronouns: who, whom, whose, which, that",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3d207035-866e-498e-b012-e6bd55e0464b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Relative Adverbs: where, when, why",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fc48193f-00f2-4a71-8488-5b7c429ecdb6",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Examples of Adjective Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3f302f49-851f-4150-8ca8-40e22c697bd8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 1: I met the man who helped me yesterday.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f9db0d49-6f15-4dcf-8bb7-3e632e4fb8a6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "the man = Noun",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "695ad2d0-8e14-4121-8a38-1b5820c07ad1",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "who helped me yesterday = Adjective\/Relative Clause (describes 'the man')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3ff5980e-fd2c-440d-bd0f-202ef0c72a76",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example 2: This is the house where I was born. (Here, 'where I was born' describes or identifies 'the house'.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0303839e-5850-4f12-a866-2a4d66eca5d2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Other Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "714cd77a-5f53-41d6-a69a-305211290e7d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The boy who won the race is my friend.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9a01e3e2-18f2-4b2c-a156-57597ff76ce0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The book that you gave me is useful.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b8fc1314-d41c-4360-b54b-42c883b6de03",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The girl whose phone was lost came to the office.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8e90e547-5056-48a4-9802-8d727c006e43",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Placement Rule",
      "content": "An adjective clause normally comes immediately after, or closely follows, the noun or pronoun it modifies."
    },
    {
      "id": "eb861fe4-e179-4826-b7b6-df484ad56592",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "7. Adverb Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9e2fa889-5523-40e6-b51e-04e54eb1588a",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Adverb Clause",
      "content": "An Adverb Clause is a subordinate clause that performs the function of an adverb. It can modify a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or the entire main clause. It commonly answers questions such as When?, Where?, Why?, Under what condition?, or For what purpose?."
    },
    {
      "id": "39939ae1-bc66-4930-8e95-f3d2b1bd9ae1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Adverb clauses are introduced by subordinating conjunctions such as: when, while, before, after, since, if, unless, because, although, so that, wherever, lest.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "560fe338-ae4f-4b06-bb51-e50a2a803aeb",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.1 Adverb Clause of Time",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b8442a34-92e0-46a4-aba9-601b40633a22",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Adverb Clause of Time tells us when an action takes place.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "02b7276c-9828-49f4-847b-63032e301558",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common conjunctions: when, whenever, while, before, after, since, as long as, till",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0e417fd8-870f-4489-a6e2-71b6e4c867a7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "00803b9d-1a21-41ed-89cf-1f728ea4117a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Do not speak while the teacher is teaching.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "61c28b73-94a6-4ebd-a795-8af3e91d152c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I met him when I was in Delhi. (tells when I met him)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dabc478a-1f22-4e81-8c73-18184f048c43",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Call me when you reach home.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b4d41a5e-8b68-41c9-897f-b3d8bc3aa991",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Wait here until I return.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "56b725c2-525f-4d76-aa2e-695139c719e0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I will leave after the meeting ends.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b5e253d6-af07-4f68-b49a-9f58c156efe8",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.2 Adverb Clause of Condition",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "db42e968-41fc-4edd-8773-77538a338a5e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Adverb Clause of Condition tells us the condition under which the action of the main clause will or may happen.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "55363b4c-b422-4026-ace0-6aa83b507ec6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common conjunctions: if, unless, provided that, whether",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bc4d31dc-bfc6-4106-be5d-9e75f0c8c4e1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6cc3819c-5bf6-44aa-b7b5-9093e03b6648",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "If you work hard, you will succeed.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "34ec1e4e-d43d-42fa-ba74-8c4ce0f1db8c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "You will fail unless you study.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3d0da2ca-3335-4490-937e-74d3d845f6ba",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "You can go if you finish your work.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1e89a15e-cf0d-49d1-8974-b2080b397a4f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "You may attend provided that you follow the rules.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6216f114-5bf6-46c6-8742-d7c50c5eba16",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Understanding 'Unless'",
      "content": "'Unless' generally means 'if not'. For example, 'You will fail unless you study' means 'You will fail if you do not study'. The condition and the result must make logical sense."
    },
    {
      "id": "7509a1ea-7293-41ef-9954-67a2f80e82d7",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.3 Adverb Clause of Purpose",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b25b9c70-ffaf-4f6b-80e7-2f01263d6ace",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Adverb Clause of Purpose tells us why an action is performed or what purpose it is intended to achieve.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6593207d-8700-4cf9-9ba5-39e42340ab96",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common expressions: so that, in order that, lest",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "72c010a6-195d-4e52-8a94-fb7665d3247d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4458ee9c-867f-408a-9c7d-add393d0aa12",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "He reads hard so that he may top the exam.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ed979fbb-7e63-40f4-813a-be137d6afd8b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "He saved money so that he could buy a laptop.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "13f56547-6ac2-4d20-81e5-cc7dadca9435",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "He worked carefully in order that he might avoid mistakes.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a4ab86c-cd35-4d2c-a07b-95913465aee3",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "The Use of 'Lest'",
      "content": "'Lest' expresses a purpose involving prevention or fear of an unwanted result. It is strictly followed by 'should'. Example: 'Walk carefully lest you should fall' (meaning: Walk carefully so that you do not fall)."
    },
    {
      "id": "1085b837-e503-43dc-ad18-5a30acf32645",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.4 Adverb Clause of Place",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d14e91c3-ccec-420e-9a60-2059c3dee626",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Adverb Clause of Place tells us where an action takes place.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ff0f92a5-6540-4d21-a197-c49c46434415",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common conjunctions: where, wherever",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8cce5e83-1267-430c-8ca6-32eb1256ad38",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dd858659-fee7-4222-b0e9-e17e5db42a52",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Sit where you like. (tells where to sit)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "14556875-2b86-4ee6-b7e9-09a7c9c225fa",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "You can park your car wherever you find space.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fe351807-6b4b-4a3b-927e-12b0c94d6aad",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Stay where you are.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5132fda2-ca5c-49e5-a702-a21e501fe852",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "I will follow you wherever you go.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a4f29edf-a56d-40d6-8748-fa7e29812293",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "8. Defining vs. Non-Defining Relative Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "56834b5f-5f75-4196-8262-4d2381d59f06",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Relative\/Adjective Clauses can be divided into two important categories based on whether the information is essential for identifying the noun or is merely extra information.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "aa1f5592-fc64-44cd-bde4-79c16ae4d120",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "8.1 Defining Relative Clause \/ Restrictive Relative Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "09d11145-42ac-4016-8b2d-a6721d33b236",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Defining Relative Clause gives information that is essential to identify the particular person or thing being discussed. Without the clause, the exact identity may become unclear.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "00ea67c1-51e9-43de-8144-ccccde7018eb",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Defining Clause Punctuation",
      "content": "A defining relative clause is NOT separated by commas."
    },
    {
      "id": "11fb931e-49af-4dea-a3e5-e0c128ae5bf5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6917afdf-bcff-45f1-96ab-adf8b3e5cf07",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The student who stole the book was punished. (identifies which student)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "564d2638-ba95-4dbe-95f6-e0b1acbc039b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Bring me the file that is on the table. (identifies which file)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b5961a1b-cfcc-4966-88e5-a1efffdf73ba",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The man who lives next door is a doctor.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "105a8392-72a6-4706-8190-362099af57b6",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The book that you gave me is useful.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cede433b-d26d-49ed-9cf5-8be6444204ec",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "The car which is parked outside belongs to my brother.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8c7ab181-1a89-420b-ad3f-367351dd7d07",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Defining Relative Clause Rule",
      "nodes": [
        "Essential information",
        "Defining",
        "No commas"
      ],
      "rawContent": "Essential information -> Defining -> No commas."
    },
    {
      "id": "adaa72aa-8cf2-4e80-9908-723c7a9f42ee",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "8.2 Non-Defining Relative Clause \/ Non-Restrictive Relative Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f641fb67-81db-41b1-8411-289ee61e9597",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Non-Defining Relative Clause gives extra or additional information about a noun that is already clearly identified. The information is useful but is not essential for identifying the noun.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b6d4f31e-e602-400b-bd62-ef8e4d6441e8",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Non-Defining Clause Punctuation",
      "content": "A non-defining relative clause MUST be separated from the main sentence by commas."
    },
    {
      "id": "c351ed29-137d-495b-b8e0-21d43196adaa",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Examples:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ba051791-2001-4257-8565-c66adb5086ca",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "My elder brother, who lives in London, is an engineer. (The phrase 'my elder brother' already identifies the person; 'who lives in London' is extra information and can be removed: 'My elder brother is an engineer.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a3c4fef8-e612-4039-b544-a1bd3249492d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Jaipur, which is known as the Pink City, attracts many tourists. ('Jaipur' is already clearly identified; the clause only adds information.)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "733d4101-c726-4552-9378-f88f17eadb1f",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Non-Defining Relative Clause Rule",
      "nodes": [
        "Extra information",
        "Non-defining",
        "Commas"
      ],
      "rawContent": "Extra information -> Non-defining -> Commas."
    },
    {
      "id": "50b00e44-5a2a-4e4b-a864-f666a6f15a11",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Defining vs. Non-Defining Relative Clause Comparison",
      "headers": [
        "Feature",
        "Defining Relative Clause",
        "Non-Defining Relative Clause"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "Purpose",
          "Identifies the noun",
          "Gives extra information"
        ],
        [
          "Importance",
          "Essential",
          "Additional"
        ],
        [
          "Commas",
          "No commas",
          "Commas are used"
        ],
        [
          "Can clause be removed?",
          "Meaning\/identification may change",
          "Main meaning remains complete"
        ],
        [
          "Example",
          "The boy who won the race is my friend.",
          "Rahul, who won the race, is my friend."
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "0429c354-4201-4670-8abc-6ac2eab2f431",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "9. How to Identify Different Types of Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e5c32957-1eda-4900-a67f-8cf7e4d9d91a",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Step 1: Find the Subject and Finite Verb. If there is no subject-verb combination, it is generally a phrase rather than a clause.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "025f46f7-b9d7-4a31-8c79-42c4e1c1ee83",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Step 2: Check Whether It Can Stand Alone. If it can make complete sense independently -> Principal\/Independent Clause. If it cannot -> Subordinate\/Dependent Clause.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0236b389-2e4a-4ab4-8e89-72e2b40ea1a8",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Step 3: Identify Its Function. If the subordinate clause works like a Noun -> Noun Clause; Adjective -> Adjective\/Relative Clause; Adverb -> Adverb Clause.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1cf53990-7c3d-4f16-b328-8497e181f58f",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Step 4: For an Adverb Clause, Ask What It Expresses. When? -> Time; Under what condition? -> Condition; For what purpose? -> Purpose; Where? -> Place.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "aaea9734-9170-4234-8726-b055ee0fd6d2",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "Step 5: For a Relative Clause, Check the Commas. Essential information -> Defining (No commas); Extra information -> Non-Defining (Commas).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "efd6279d-0910-438c-aaca-401cd956ec95",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Quick Comparison of Clause Types",
      "headers": [
        "Clause Type",
        "Main Function",
        "Example"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "Principal Clause",
          "Complete independent thought",
          "He works hard."
        ],
        [
          "Coordinate Clause",
          "Independent clause of equal rank",
          "He worked hard, and he passed."
        ],
        [
          "Subordinate Clause",
          "Depends on another clause",
          "I know where he lives."
        ],
        [
          "Noun Clause",
          "Works like a noun",
          "What you said is true."
        ],
        [
          "Adjective Clause",
          "Describes a noun\/pronoun",
          "The man who helped me is kind."
        ],
        [
          "Adverb Clause",
          "Modifies the main clause",
          "I left when the rain stopped."
        ],
        [
          "Time Clause",
          "Shows time",
          "Call me when you arrive."
        ],
        [
          "Condition Clause",
          "Shows condition",
          "If you study, you will pass."
        ],
        [
          "Purpose Clause",
          "Shows purpose",
          "He worked hard so that he could succeed."
        ],
        [
          "Place Clause",
          "Shows place",
          "Sit where you like."
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "7e9e2ea9-ee72-4aab-986c-59ce4778de9f",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "10. Important Conjunctions and Clause Markers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ee155a92-0abb-4ce3-8e7e-f28ea63fa4db",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Coordinating Conjunctions (FANBOYS): For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "35f91a7e-1566-478b-a2e8-49ba3981ebd2",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Noun-Clause Introducers: that, if, whether, what, who, whom, whose, which, where, when, why, how",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "359eeb84-a3e8-4b12-b19e-2fd871831f38",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Relative Words: who, whom, whose, which, that, where, when, why",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dc24e8bc-a7f6-49b7-8656-c79e06fcba31",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Time Conjunctions: when, whenever, while, before, after, since, as long as, till",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ca9ffd7c-4f2c-45d0-a6f0-ef8beb18de8d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Condition Conjunctions: if, unless, provided that, whether",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4dbbcc04-7a7a-46c1-8d11-7cdfbcc1f652",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Purpose Expressions: so that, in order that, lest",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a2b6d5a6-1e42-4dba-a30e-2a602e57948a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Common Place Words: where, wherever",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bf5f1434-215d-4e1d-9311-42e9c382eba5",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "11. Common Mistakes",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cd2f205d-24c1-4027-bfa4-c278dcbe79e6",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Mistake 1: Confusing a Phrase with a Clause",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7c295cdb-79f2-4a01-912a-2f36d9770ea8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'In the morning' is a phrase, whereas 'When the morning came' is a clause because it contains a subject ('the morning') and a finite verb ('came').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "093f5d96-edb2-433d-831d-f1e816baacab",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Mistake 2: Treating Every Clause as Independent",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c9febbca-a648-4b5a-8745-db25741c376a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "'Where he lives' is not normally an independent sentence. It must be attached to a main clause, e.g., 'I know where he lives.'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c67bb839-5f8a-4436-b8b7-e3f4aa9cb1ff",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Mistake 3: Confusing Noun and Adjective Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "47103f93-a9ae-456c-986a-6a6835008dea",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Compare: 'I know where he lives.' (Noun Clause: functions as the object of 'know') vs. 'This is the house where he lives.' (Adjective\/Relative Clause: describes 'house'). The same word 'where' can introduce different types of clauses depending on its function.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6d125713-e18a-4776-9f4b-57c6516a6630",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Mistake 4: Forgetting Commas in Non-Defining Relative Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8bdbd13-8852-4d5d-86dc-2de392d4c58a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Compare: Defining: 'The student who won the competition is my friend.' (No commas; identifies the student) vs. Non-defining: 'Rahul, who won the competition, is my friend.' (Commas; adds extra info about Rahul).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0667f9e5-8227-4bb9-b7f2-c3d122d68987",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Mistake 5: Confusing Coordinate and Subordinate Clauses",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3944e700-72ba-40d2-b826-c48f17f76598",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Compare: Coordinate: 'He worked hard, and he passed.' (Both clauses are independent) vs. Subordinate: 'He passed because he worked hard.' ('because he worked hard' depends on the main clause).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "09533530-f556-4598-accf-0dfbaeb497be",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Key Revision Points",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "97ba6546-6467-4461-8f3b-6dee9e9c397a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Clause is a group of words containing a subject and a finite verb.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7123a4cf-771a-48b9-984b-30ab035fe62c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Phrase does not contain a complete subject-verb combination.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b66e9396-66d5-49eb-ab42-be62e4f52a13",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Principal\/Main\/Independent Clause can stand alone and makes complete sense.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cf7f2ac8-1363-4e9d-9150-cc832527b1ba",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Coordinate Clause is an independent clause of equal rank joined with another independent clause (FANBOYS).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6cce6d52-feee-45a8-877b-93298980f636",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Subordinate\/Dependent Clause cannot normally stand alone and depends on a principal clause.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "84a0055f-bc0d-4816-a672-c960cb084061",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A subordinate clause can function as a Noun, Adjective, or Adverb.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b1c4db1c-477e-4e8f-be20-a667c5f0b299",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Noun Clause performs the work of a noun (subject, object, object of preposition, or subject complement).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6ff9141-ab92-415a-ac4e-1000a0702201",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "An Adjective Clause\/Relative Clause describes or qualifies a noun or pronoun.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b807ddf2-43be-4910-b464-d5512eba273a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "An Adverb Clause modifies a verb, adjective, adverb, or the main clause (Time, Condition, Purpose, Place).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2487a5bc-c308-4be3-b4d8-7d9c6c5b417f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Lest is followed by should.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "22bdc318-657d-4dc3-bc8c-1b8fdf81034c",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Unless means if not.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c074324a-996d-4e2c-9cfc-cd676d0b943b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Defining Relative Clause is essential for identifying the noun and has no commas.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ad5d54bc-ff40-44f4-9935-36004a0e189b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "A Non-Defining Relative Clause gives extra information about an already identified noun and is separated by commas.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    }
  ]
}

  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "0473f474-a8d4-4258-8b5d-b772b9399e40",
      "type": "HEADING_1",

    {
      "id": "929c13b6-0999-4a84-bff2-9efc28ae97af",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "INTRODUCTION TO RATIO AND PROPORTION",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
