        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "607878d6-03ee-4c6d-8e23-fcb6282fdabc",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Understanding the Cases",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a512797-060d-494c-9f68-82ed28d9dc95",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Subjective Case: Used when the pronoun performs the action (e.g., 'I work hard', 'He is reading').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ae2c684a-0a2c-417a-8cd6-e7463613ddea",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Objective Case: Used when the pronoun receives the action or follows a preposition (e.g., 'She called me', 'I spoke to him').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "759c2dc3-8dbd-4047-9d84-75b5c919bd48",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Possessive Pronoun: Shows ownership and can stand independently (e.g., 'This book is mine', 'That house is theirs').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "27ba3ff5-3d94-42fa-92a1-5bd341632024",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Possessive Adjective: Shows possession but comes before a noun (e.g., 'This is my book', 'That is their house').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "56f9a1a4-e1b1-478b-9731-1b02e7969f5f",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "3. Rules of Personal Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5df68007-9307-4b14-a0f8-5e43a30bfe26",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3.1 Order of Pronouns in Normal or Positive Statements",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f52a5a27-ebe3-4607-b0be-de61d7528c50",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "When pronouns of different persons are used together in a normal, positive, or general statement, the traditional examination rule is Second Person -> Third Person -> First Person (2 -> 3 -> 1).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "adaa9859-9e80-4717-a917-1af1927ad0f9",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Normal\/Positive Order Rule",
      "content": "Always follow the 2-3-1 order for positive statements: You, He and I."
    },
    {
      "id": "b8ceb837-1555-47d6-b7a3-6104fc37671d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: I, you and he will study together.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "60ab256e-7814-43f1-9fd1-42dbd0296b3a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: You, he and I will study together.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "05af3d56-5c56-44b3-8540-99a8666b94a1",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3.2 Order of Pronouns in Confession, Mistake, or Fault",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6a5c5828-b3f6-4859-9e6c-6dd74e82a7bf",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "When the sentence expresses a mistake, fault, crime, blame, or confession, the traditional rule reverses the order to First Person -> Second Person -> Third Person (1 -> 2 -> 3).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "419d0692-f093-484a-8508-5e4761385e01",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Confession\/Mistake Order Rule",
      "content": "Always follow the 1-2-3 order for negative contexts or confessions: I, You and He."
    },
    {
      "id": "9984fa42-9d1f-4eb9-a833-2ecdefd42953",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: You, he and I made a blunder.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3fd9eb3d-bf05-434d-97e1-f06a63df2310",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: I, you and he made a blunder. (The speaker takes responsibility first).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8f661804-5745-4c38-9abe-af737800d46a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3.3 Order When All Pronouns Are Plural",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dc663d93-9908-4585-8fd1-322a8fef9758",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "When all the pronouns used together are plural, the traditional sequence is First Person -> Second Person -> Third Person (1 -> 2 -> 3).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "783845c8-6192-4fc7-bd01-90b8ec8086b8",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: You, they and we should complete the task.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "efc0b714-f6d2-401c-b83a-74edd0beca63",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: We, you and they should complete the task.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a3a6ebe3-5570-4d10-bffc-b6b9363b09de",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3.4 Objective Case After Prepositions, Let, Like, Between, Except, and But",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e351d36b-db48-4c91-a9b2-59538c2f557d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Pronouns following prepositions must be used in the Objective Case. The same examination rule applies after words such as Let, Like, Between, Except, and But.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dd72e095-2cab-4224-add3-07d89204ffea",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Preposition + Objective Pronoun",
      "content": "Always use objective pronouns (me, him, her, us, them) after prepositions and words like 'let' and 'between'."
    },
    {
      "id": "d5e986fe-064c-4595-90eb-d29b2303fbb1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: Let you and I go to the market.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ad5577a6-2d59-4ed0-8e69-242bd8acceb7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: Let you and me go to the market.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "11adfee1-44a6-4179-9dc0-f1aed121ff65",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: There is no conflict between he and I.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0400c87b-c015-423f-8a80-41eac62e799f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: There is no conflict between him and me.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5e5d9911-af82-4ca4-a8b2-76c494684440",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3.5 Pronoun Case After 'Than' and 'As'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fca4c29e-7c47-4872-8ffe-fe9ce9454229",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "When making comparisons using 'than' or 'as', the pronoun should match the grammatical case of the person or thing with which it is being compared.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f836c4c8-8cd6-4969-92b7-3f5217b8a134",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Subject-to-Subject Comparison",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f92150b6-9cd5-4bfb-ab31-f95ee2630e3c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: He is taller than me.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6eb7809f-64b9-405b-b764-04c1b06b5513",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct (Formal): He is taller than I. (Implied: He is taller than I am).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "00733715-a41a-4129-8acf-31319c47e7d0",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Object-to-Object Comparison",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "610db5b4-d0ee-4332-80c1-f8b524c94b35",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: She respects you more than I.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4f7f4501-7fba-43de-8cf8-be4ac1c988e4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: She respects you more than me. (Implied: She respects you more than she respects me).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4be1beb7-51c5-4fef-950e-f768a0dea54d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "3.6 Special Uses of 'It'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e41dc912-460d-4e26-9757-5a347b7df3aa",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The pronoun 'it' is generally used for:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f40ff800-b928-4f5b-900c-1e8998791a67",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Non-living things (e.g., 'It is a beautiful house.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "038b9cfa-d1c1-423d-90d0-dc8ddfe27068",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Small animals when their sex is unknown",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fedba2d7-a454-4806-adf5-cf0b212ac53b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Young children when gender is unknown (e.g., 'The baby dropped its toy.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8e24a6de-c64b-4809-86a8-b76bd041df72",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Time, Weather, and Distance (e.g., 'It is raining', 'It is five o'clock', 'It is five kilometres from here.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9fb2d274-dbb5-47be-b700-b22619e22509",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "4. Reflexive Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c1550aee-ba15-4a4d-961d-4e01f5b93469",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Reflexive Pronouns are pronouns that refer back to the subject of the sentence. They are formed using '-self' for singular forms and '-selves' for plural forms.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b3479778-2c1f-4bd4-bb5e-63fc75bdede0",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Singular: Myself, Yourself, Himself, Herself, Itself",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "96cacd97-1c2f-4111-acac-5e3ed9d71a04",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Plural: Ourselves, Yourselves, Themselves",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "96a07a03-bd36-4b33-be0a-ee5c589b5d86",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4.1 Verbs That Require Reflexive Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2df44c59-3144-420d-87a7-1e4a97e3dc38",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Certain verbs require a reflexive pronoun when no other direct object is supplied. Key verbs include: Enjoy, Avail, Absent, Adapt, Adjust, Resign, Apply, Exert, Acquit, Introduce.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6da2d7e-f3a9-42bb-bc5d-7427990d416d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: He absented from the office yesterday.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "59380e7f-e0bb-4623-a952-294db0a18de3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: He absented himself from the office yesterday.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b5ffa945-8812-42de-bc44-f4c7cea31d9d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: I enjoyed at the party last night.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "37a7f0f4-5a11-4c4d-9797-04e70266de40",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: I enjoyed myself at the party last night.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2dad6f44-e5c7-4718-9538-157d01395878",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4.2 Verbs That Do Not Require Reflexive Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3d5f4a45-cb6b-4236-ab66-1e6b539c51bb",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Reflexive pronouns should not be used unnecessarily with verbs such as: Keep, Stop, Turn, Qualify, Bathe, Move, Rest, Hide.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dec61725-7a69-45fd-b0de-fa746262de3b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: He hid himself behind the curtain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "38cee234-aa45-413e-8fba-c6c413ca02cd",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: He hid behind the curtain.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ed5b2df2-35f0-496c-bc7e-a62f2060063a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "4.3 Reflexive Pronoun Cannot Be Used as an Independent Subject",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "343a4bb5-6cd4-4ba1-b567-9e2eacd8c946",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A reflexive pronoun cannot normally act as the independent subject of a sentence.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "68a973c5-2078-4ac1-a9fd-e985a4abc9db",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: Myself am Rahul from Delhi.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6a4d39b2-465b-47d7-ab6a-a3854478b109",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: I am Rahul from Delhi. OR I myself am Rahul from Delhi (where 'myself' is used for emphasis).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "30fbccb7-daf3-496a-877e-5be8080fb90e",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "5. Demonstrative Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "96e7ae2b-3f8c-438f-a3e7-c0253401633a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Demonstrative Pronouns are used to point out specific persons or things. The main demonstrative pronouns are: This, That, These, Those, Such, The same.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "20322dbb-1076-4753-b51a-e11a58bde2c5",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5.1 This, That, These, and Those",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "25b0365c-308e-4f4d-88a7-8688261de463",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Demonstrative Pronoun Usage Matrix",
      "headers": [
        "Number",
        "Near in Distance\/Time",
        "Far in Distance\/Time"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "Singular",
          "This (e.g., 'This is my book.')",
          "That (e.g., 'That is your house.')"
        ],
        [
          "Plural",
          "These (e.g., 'These are my books.')",
          "Those (e.g., 'Those are your houses.')"
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "54dec5ac-ab8c-4186-875a-b9f20f58b603",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "5.2 'That of' and 'Those of' in Comparisons",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6f2a45aa-d820-45be-b095-655b74681311",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Demonstrative pronouns are used to prevent unnecessary repetition when comparing similar nouns.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d58927de-5d7d-4539-beb8-da381844d687",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Use 'that of' when replacing a singular noun.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ad6c3f3a-c9c0-4ab6-842f-638ed06b2dc1",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Use 'those of' when replacing a plural noun.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "59eee1d0-9cb4-4f52-9e93-877f8510ce60",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: The climate of Shimla is cooler than Delhi. (This incorrectly compares climate to a city).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "94154997-2ebb-4cba-92d4-c338123dc18d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: The climate of Shimla is cooler than that of Delhi. (Here, 'that' represents 'climate').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "00e19077-2682-4df9-ad87-b575446abbe0",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: The roads of Mumbai are wider than Patna.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "04dc4a52-98c5-4aed-9824-7cdb5eee41ec",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: The roads of Mumbai are wider than those of Patna. (Here, 'those' represents 'roads').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "38ddc98e-34c8-44a4-bd1b-52a4a166026e",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "6. Indefinite Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ebcdb7b1-8e1c-4397-b31c-79c5f5e14152",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Indefinite Pronouns refer to people or things in a general, non-specific way. Examples include: One, Someone, Somebody, Anyone, Anybody, Nobody, No one, Everyone, Everybody, All, Both, Many, Few, Several, None.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "184f1971-0127-447a-b867-cc52bdb2dabe",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "6.1 Consistency with 'One'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "d9c3d85e-cb25-4f2e-b328-3a9c8f00844c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "When 'one' is used as an indefinite pronoun, its possessive form must remain 'one's' throughout the sentence.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e7c70ce0-9fa6-48b8-b0f7-4f24f36b6a0d",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "One's Rule",
      "content": "Do not mix 'one' with 'his' or 'her'. Keep it consistent: One -> one's."
    },
    {
      "id": "059c486f-4db6-4ce6-9f91-2ba0e00909ed",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: One must do his duty honestly.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "42de9a88-b600-4c5b-b328-c07ed08ba7c6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: One must do one's duty honestly.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "32dc4fc9-e2be-4dad-82c2-f38a53c94aad",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "6.2 Singular Agreement with Compound Indefinite Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "34581b8e-878a-4f41-b943-ebb98aade022",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Compound indefinite pronouns (Everyone, Everybody, Someone, Somebody, Nobody, No one, Anyone, Anybody) are grammatically singular and take a singular verb and singular pronoun.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a505b862-1302-404a-bc14-a68ec3f63215",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: Everyone should bring their own notebook.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bbf49a50-938a-444b-9ca4-ca430eb5163f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct (Traditional): Everyone should bring his own notebook.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "619bbab0-ff03-4f33-8c1b-0b88e1928f1c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "6.3 Either \/ Neither vs. Any \/ None",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e01ec6bf-52c7-441f-a228-29dea991ea30",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Either \/ Neither: Used strictly for two persons or things.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a0534e80-496e-4196-852f-ade6cdf80182",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Any \/ One \/ None: Used when dealing with more than two persons or things.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "42ba795a-a30d-4fc2-a56c-09ea1a53314e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: Either of these five candidates will be selected.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0ac66459-6eae-4e0e-8016-93030d5700b3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: Any of these five candidates will be selected. (Or 'One of these five...')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "36ad93a9-7387-433d-affc-01949d090ca3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: Neither of the three books was helpful.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0d197500-40f4-4b69-acc9-35fd5b515e7e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: None of the three books was helpful.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "18f809fe-77ae-46c7-b117-ae13dad27e38",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "7. Relative Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e458dbaf-c4b9-4883-9129-9ee62ad215a4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Relative Pronouns refer back to a noun or pronoun mentioned earlier in the sentence (called the Antecedent) and help connect clauses. Key relative pronouns: Who, Whom, Whose, Which, That.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bd8acb42-5fa5-406a-b19c-532d9077c20c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.1 Who vs. Whom",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a3634482-88f9-442d-b361-e76c2646f005",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Who: Used as a subjective\/nominative pronoun for people (performs the action).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4e72f5c4-17af-4e29-9cff-ce87019e4952",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Whom: Used as an objective pronoun for people (receives the action).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ba817cdd-0197-4c3d-8df7-333e64ec99e6",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "He\/Him Test",
      "content": "If you can substitute the pronoun with 'He', use 'Who'. If you can substitute it with 'Him', use 'Whom'."
    },
    {
      "id": "7af3af22-810d-46ac-8441-43c4df0f6146",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example (Who): The boy who came first in class was rewarded. (He came first -> Who).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2aba3482-0baf-4373-a23b-aaf120c353e7",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Example (Whom): The doctor whom I met yesterday was very experienced. (I met him -> Whom).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a1d153a7-102b-42e8-beda-2f6c526fe73d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.2 Which vs. Who\/Whom",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "094cadc3-66ff-45ed-b4f4-297266c7007e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Which is used for non-living objects, things, ideas, and animals (unless the animal is personified).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "315aefdc-81dd-4ef4-bf0e-2f25fd26ba2b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: The dog who barked at night belonged to my neighbour.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c72d1c37-07f5-46db-84d5-2966434fd499",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: The dog which barked at night belonged to my neighbour.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0a62a786-e26b-48b1-9709-fc0290ebcb19",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.3 Mandatory Use of 'That'",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c7a246a2-0bed-4093-962e-e89426113787",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The relative pronoun 'that' must be used instead of 'who' or 'which' in the following situations:",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1df55e88-8559-4283-aee6-f9d5c02d1749",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "After a superlative degree adjective (e.g., 'This is the best book that I have ever read.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ff8c14c5-a373-4974-a1b1-b22e0cce491b",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "After words such as all, same, only, any, none, nothing, little (e.g., 'Man is the only animal that can talk.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4a66d4b0-516c-4c61-ad30-ef7de3ae4f75",
      "type": "NUMBERED_LIST",
      "text": "When the antecedent contains both a human and a non-human\/animal (e.g., 'The driver and his car that fell into the river could not be saved.')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "59db720e-7e44-4b72-a185-ddfe0f8a692f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "7.4 Agreement of Relative Pronoun with Antecedent",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3b15f9e8-424e-4946-ab4e-c215033443d6",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The verb following a relative pronoun must agree in number and person with its antecedent.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "dbae87d5-e419-4c65-9d4f-1df6200b3465",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Incorrect: It is I who is responsible for this error.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b81c9ee0-9696-462d-98e6-a6233612cfff",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Correct: It is I who am responsible for this error. (Antecedent is 'I', so verb must be 'am').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "030f139f-4ff7-4bb0-91b5-43ebdf7e39b4",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "8. Interrogative Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "45c4c3cc-1abc-4850-99eb-b4f5310a6098",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Interrogative Pronouns are used to ask questions. The main interrogative pronouns are: Who, Whom, Whose, Which, What.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "811b8021-9aba-43f7-b742-8a059e11eb26",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "8.1 Usage of Interrogative Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "64033834-b261-42e1-b64f-b64a71cae402",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Who: Asks about the subject performing an action (e.g., 'Who wrote this poem?')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a3e44024-e431-4065-a373-4edda0cfada5",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Whom: Asks about the object receiving an action (e.g., 'Whom did you meet at the station?')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "bbf3b246-5a39-4e11-ba16-1bd2dc5c4438",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Whose: Asks about possession or ownership (e.g., 'Whose book is this?')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "47ab7e41-bbfe-42f9-9a64-770f3216de5a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Which: Used when choosing from a specific, known, or limited group of persons or things (e.g., 'Which of the two brothers is more intelligent?')",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "719ac3dc-3a50-4198-8b0f-6f65b63fd03c",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "8.2 Position of Prepositions with Interrogative Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1ad37fe7-463c-4a89-80c1-ea7294b97e42",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "In formal grammar, a preposition is placed before 'whom' or 'which'. In informal English, the preposition can move to the end of the sentence.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "621c192a-9468-4f9b-8133-31994ba13dc4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Formal: To whom were you speaking on the phone?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1a18025f-b464-47d0-a4d0-1d172d637cc2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Informal: Who were you speaking to on the phone?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6b8179d8-7d29-4e79-90cb-bf9fcb6bce8b",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "9. Quick Comparison of Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3caa2abc-859f-43d9-9c08-df4332ae9275",
      "type": "TABLE",
      "title": "Pronoun Quick Reference Table",
      "headers": [
        "Pronoun",
        "Main Use",
        "Example"
      ],
      "rows": [
        [
          "I",
          "First-person singular subject",
          "I am ready."
        ],
        [
          "Me",
          "First-person singular object",
          "She called me."
        ],
        [
          "He",
          "Male subject",
          "He works here."
        ],
        [
          "Him",
          "Male object",
          "I met him."
        ],
        [
          "She",
          "Female subject",
          "She is here."
        ],
        [
          "Her",
          "Female object\/possessive adjective",
          "I called her. \/ Her book"
        ],
        [
          "They",
          "Plural subject",
          "They arrived."
        ],
        [
          "Them",
          "Plural object",
          "I saw them."
        ],
        [
          "Myself",
          "Reflexive\/emphatic",
          "I did it myself."
        ],
        [
          "This",
          "Near, singular",
          "This is mine."
        ],
        [
          "These",
          "Near, plural",
          "These are mine."
        ],
        [
          "That",
          "Far, singular \/ replacement",
          "That is yours."
        ],
        [
          "Those",
          "Far, plural \/ replacement",
          "Those are yours."
        ],
        [
          "Who",
          "Human subject",
          "The boy who came."
        ],
        [
          "Whom",
          "Human object",
          "The man whom I met."
        ],
        [
          "Whose",
          "Possession",
          "The girl whose bag was lost."
        ],
        [
          "Which",
          "Things\/animals; limited choice",
          "The book which I bought."
        ],
        [
          "That",
          "Certain relative-clause situations",
          "The best book that I read."
        ],
        [
          "What",
          "Question \/ noun-clause introduction",
          "What do you want?"
        ],
        [
          "One",
          "General person",
          "One should do one's duty."
        ],
        [
          "Everyone",
          "Every person individually",
          "Everyone is ready."
        ],
        [
          "Either",
          "One of two",
          "Either will work."
        ],
        [
          "Neither",
          "Not one of two",
          "Neither is correct."
        ],
        [
          "None",
          "Not one\/any of more than two",
          "None of the books helped."
        ]
      ],
      "hasHeaderRow": true
    },
    {
      "id": "b67d5048-966c-4058-a7b6-72ba8c2e9b1a",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "10. Common Examination Mistakes",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c0db678b-6068-4e28-ad8b-171aa0f6b6fb",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mistake 1: Using 'Myself' instead of 'I' as a subject (e.g., 'Myself Rahul' -> 'I am Rahul').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "56f5bbf0-0274-44a1-8ad0-9fbf6b6a062f",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mistake 2: Using subjective pronouns after prepositions (e.g., 'Between you and I' -> 'Between you and me').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8a3c677b-3f2e-41eb-978d-ffa0bb66ce0e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mistake 3: Confusing 'Who' (Subject) and 'Whom' (Object).",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "280bb104-513c-470b-afd1-a7d37f172014",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mistake 4: Using 'Either\/Neither' for more than two choices (e.g., 'Neither of the five answers' -> 'None of the five answers').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4f743bb3-82a5-47ed-a839-583020bbb001",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mistake 5: Repeating a noun instead of using 'that of\/those of' in comparisons (e.g., 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Delhi' -> 'cooler than that of Delhi').",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9d7471b0-75b1-4670-b437-d2f342b74352",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Mistake 6: Confusing 'Which' and 'That' after superlatives or words like 'only', 'all', 'same'.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "deabc748-2178-428e-b437-4570278d6efc",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Revision — Pronouns",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "15c77106-6bbc-4322-babf-9314a06de5cd",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Pronouns replace nouns to avoid repetition.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c58693ad-57f5-4ce9-9f28-62878717f69a",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Normal pronoun order is 2-3-1; confession\/mistake order is 1-2-3; plural pronoun order is 1-2-3.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f665e744-0d33-4a9b-b1e3-ed9ef4da8f15",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Always use objective case after prepositions, let, like, between, except, and but.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8986923-6a3a-4aed-873b-72d16b33d244",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Reflexive pronouns are required after verbs like enjoy, avail, absent, adapt when no other object is present.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "92a48f14-ce06-489f-928a-bb4995ec605b",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Use 'that of' (singular) and 'those of' (plural) to maintain logical comparisons.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "65d4713f-0485-476c-9fcf-4514731d3027",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "One must always be followed by one's.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4d8e3702-3c8c-4d9b-ae62-f1b891f96689",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Either\/Neither is for 2 items; Any\/None is for more than 2.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5ede6f7a-c826-4839-9cca-94357256418d",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Relative pronoun 'that' is mandatory after superlatives, words like 'only\/same\/all\/none', and human + non-human antecedents.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3007e844-1cfb-497e-9ea3-d30434df1fbb",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "FLOWCHART",
      "title": "Pronoun Order Decision Flowchart",
      "nodes": [
        "Determine Context",
        "Normal\/Positive Statement -> 2-3-1",
        "Confession\/Mistake\/Fault -> 1-2-3",
        "All Plural Pronouns -> 1-2-3"
      ],
      "rawContent": "Determine Context\n  |-- Normal\/Positive Statement -> 2-3-1\n  |-- Confession\/Mistake\/Fault -> 1-2-3\n  |-- All Plural Pronouns -> 1-2-3"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "chapterId": "chap_blood_relation",
  "title": "Blood Relation",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "2bb79260-4641-478a-aac1-c4d773a653c4",

    {
      "id": "8e8f7fad-1280-4853-8fce-0a75efcf938e",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Blood relation questions test logical reasoning by describing kinship chains between individuals. In competitive examinations such as SSC CGL and Bank PO, mastery of the standard Family Tree symbols makes complex puzzles solvable in under 45 seconds.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,

    {
      "id": "e397e5e7-3c2b-4bf5-b45d-bc20f8b6a221",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "IMPORTANT",
      "title": "Standard Notation Rule",
      "content": "• Male: Denoted by (+) or Square [ ]\n• Female: Denoted by (-) or Circle ( )\n• Siblings: Connected by a single horizontal line (—)\n• Married Couple: Connected by a double horizontal line (=)\n• Generation Gap: Connected by a vertical line (|)"
    },
    {
      "id": "8425ac2c-1818-42e8-8fbe-9520f81e33c0",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "1. Generation Hierarchy",

    {
      "id": "fda25bc0-a251-442b-9fa5-f1db4da36bb6",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Practice Example 1 (Decoded Statement)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "edf172cc-8dc9-42e0-a67b-f2d5d208b33b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Pointing to a photograph, Rohit said, \"She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather.\" How is Rohit related to the girl?",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c5f70049-5dc9-4079-a74c-b3782d8994f8",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "EXAM_TIP",
      "title": "Solution Breakdown",
      "content": "1. Grandfather's only son = Rohit's father.\n2. Daughter of Rohit's father = Rohit's sister.\nHence, Rohit is her Brother."
    }
  ]
