{
  "chapterId": "chap_b4aa6a88",
  "title": "Computer Software",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "a5872ecf-52c7-4858-8a8c-33989215bc2e",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "Computer Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "992c8e55-d8eb-4123-a3b3-463ca0593d7b",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Definition of Computer Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "95ac350d-7344-43b1-9851-0a35b769e115",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
      "title": "Computer Software",
      "content": "Computer Software is an intangible (non-physical) collection of programs, operational instructions, algorithms (step-by-step problem-solving procedures), procedures, and documentation that tells the physical hardware what tasks to perform and how to execute them."
    },
    {
      "id": "c088acda-fc8e-4382-a707-ab60c66264e4",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Unlike hardware, software cannot be physically touched; it acts as the logical bridge between the user and the system's electronic components.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "cdcfc6fa-4e5f-4d5f-8ee3-cb0f7d1e2bd0",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "System Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7475e623-dd87-4c83-91fb-9bb34a3f9a7c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "System Software consists of low-level programs designed to directly operate, control, and extend the processing capabilities of computer hardware. It provides a foundational platform upon which application software can execute.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0fc26bd5-dba0-4223-bcc2-5593375fe0ed",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Operating System (OS)\nSystem BIOS (Basic Input\/Output System)\nDevice Drivers\nLanguage Translators",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b5de4196-c2ab-4c83-9306-0ab4669f54e0",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Operating System (OS)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c09b141b-24ed-4020-b39c-a7006515d4a9",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "The Operating System (OS) is the primary master system program that acts as an intermediary interface between the user or application software and the physical hardware. Its core functions include managing memory allocation, process scheduling, storage drives, peripheral input\/output (I\/O) devices, file systems, and system security. Examples include Windows, macOS, Linux, and Unix.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e4f271c5-872a-416f-a579-ad9b2192090b",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "System BIOS (Basic Input\/Output System)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "da8f5a2f-a928-4e4b-aa7d-f641d5682ae2",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "System BIOS (Basic Input\/Output System) is non-volatile (retaining data even when powered off) firmware (permanent software programmed into a hardware device) permanently stored in ROM or Flash memory on the motherboard. Its core functions include performing the POST (Power-On Self-Test) diagnostic check during a cold boot and initializing hardware devices before loading the Operating System bootloader into RAM.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c9960886-8a4c-4e94-94d0-8cbc96784ef4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Device Drivers",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "965f814c-dac2-436d-a654-2ce1acedb6b3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Device Drivers are specialized system control programs written specifically to enable the Operating System to recognize, communicate with, and control specific hardware peripherals. They translate generic Operating System hardware calls into device-specific commands. Examples include Printer Drivers, Graphics Card Drivers, and Sound Drivers.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0ca49201-ab9f-4474-b0bf-3d5d013a897a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Language Translators",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8d8f7e2a-0da7-485f-9449-7912f11e01fe",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Language Translators are system utilities that translate high-level or assembly source code (the human-readable programming instructions) written by programmers into machine-executable binary code consisting of 0s and 1s.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4d5170fc-1d7f-4f85-b3c2-b0a61343743c",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Types of Language Translators",
      "nodes": [
        "Language Translators",
        "Assembler",
        "Compiler",
        "Interpreter"
      ],
      "rawContent": "[Language Translators]\n      \/        |        \\\n     v         v         v\n[Assembler] [Compiler] [Interpreter]"
    },
    {
      "id": "d408d658-c9f5-4733-944c-084a933fc28f",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Assembler",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "5337d91e-2c19-4ae5-95ce-c5099cf0b72c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Assembler translates Assembly Language, which uses mnemonics (memory-assisting abbreviations), into Machine Code.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3a0765f8-11d6-4606-8e3d-bb952f317969",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Compiler",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2a6af5f9-c757-4dcf-8cbf-6e59bd9d285d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Compiler translates High-Level Language source code into Machine Code all at once.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7d21a094-a36f-47e1-b683-f529f3ba6eb0",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Interpreter",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "da26e160-376f-43b5-8a2f-14a6b9afd86f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Interpreter translates High-Level Language source code into Machine Code line-by-line.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "21e40c26-bf5c-4625-8d77-c88a7e686eb6",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Application Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9497fc64-f4cc-4c2c-9df8-49180435b5e1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Application Software comprises high-level programs designed to perform specific user-centric operational, creative, or business tasks. It sits above system software and directly addresses user requirements.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "37e5bde4-de08-47e3-83d1-fbd52338a150",
      "type": "DIAGRAM",
      "diagramType": "TREE",
      "title": "Application Software Categories",
      "nodes": [
        "Application Software",
        "General Purpose",
        "Specific Purpose"
      ],
      "rawContent": "[Application Software]\n              \/          \\\n             v            v\n     [General Purpose]  [Specific Purpose]"
    },
    {
      "id": "181b74d5-3e0f-45ff-b1e4-23b0088f86e7",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "General Purpose Application Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1bf5c46e-b20d-4034-bb46-cfd70350afe1",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "General Purpose Application Software is designed to handle broad, standard tasks required by a wide variety of users without needing customization.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "90ea8618-8f1e-4ca2-bfdf-57dbb397f1f7",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Word Processing Software\nElectronic Spreadsheets\nPresentation Software\nDatabase Management Systems (DBMS)\nDesktop Publishing (DTP) Software\nGraphics Software\nMultimedia Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "48b73f4d-f0a2-473b-a523-a450db70f6ac",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Word Processing Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e5186b67-19d6-43f4-8deb-06edf6fb9a4f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Word Processing Software is used to create, edit, format, store, and print text-heavy documents. Examples include Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and WordPad.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a4c54f50-4ccc-40b7-9a97-2b4ceac40038",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Electronic Spreadsheets",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ac9e7b31-a6ea-45fe-bd84-590e0d54965b",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Electronic Spreadsheet Software organizes data into tabular rows and columns to perform numerical calculations, data analysis, and chart visualization using built-in formulas and functions. Examples include Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and Lotus 1-2-3.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1335c4d4-55a3-4eb2-b82f-dd6a8aa03329",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Presentation Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9e07931c-fc2a-41d8-8f06-ce85003f7cc0",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Presentation Software creates visual slide shows by combining text, graphics, charts, animations, and audio for presenting information to an audience. Examples include Microsoft PowerPoint and Google Slides.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "44edff32-a69e-4b7e-a520-c7d8ec6f16ed",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Database Management Systems (DBMS)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fc3f3178-7045-4cb3-a25b-90302e66ae47",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Database Management Systems (DBMS) are software applications used to create, organize, retrieve, modify, and manage structured databases securely and efficiently. Examples include MySQL, Oracle, and Microsoft Access.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8ed272c-1264-42c2-b03a-812535d5f91b",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Desktop Publishing (DTP) Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7a0b5d98-ea0a-4155-b361-22f258225584",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Desktop Publishing (DTP) Software combines advanced graphic, typography, and layout tools to design professional print publications such as books, magazines, brochures, and newspapers. Examples include Adobe InDesign, CorelDRAW, and PageMaker.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "002cb32a-033d-4a0d-b9ac-ae68973f6184",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Graphics Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0676dcb0-e8e1-4e55-80d6-43399dc1ba91",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Graphics Software enables users to create, manipulate, render, and edit digital vector graphics or bitmap images. Examples include Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Canva.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "1de09f08-01a0-49e7-814b-87a0f515fce0",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Multimedia Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "8f3e2f61-dc68-44b0-b4f6-78b4a4da3720",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Multimedia Software consists of programs capable of playing, recording, editing, and combining audio, video, animation, and interactive media content. Examples include VLC Media Player and Adobe Premiere Pro.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "7915e28e-5e7f-4901-aea7-7f48b1ffd9d4",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Specific Purpose \/ Customized Application Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "44a90783-297a-4b5d-8bd8-86395600ba9c",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Specific Purpose or Customized Application Software is software custom-built or configured explicitly to automate domain-specific operations for a particular industry, business, or organization.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fa1797f8-ed1b-40f2-97cb-d953344e3e92",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Inventory Management System\nPayroll Management System\nHotel Management System\nReservation Management System\nReport Card Generator\nAccounting Software\nBilling Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6bbdd58c-cbc6-4ce0-80c5-bc443bb5a0a1",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Inventory Management System",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ed295d41-0f45-46f1-8213-d639e7ada745",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "An Inventory Management System tracks stock levels, warehouse materials, supplier orders, sales, and supply chain logistics to maintain balanced inventory levels.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e6fbb862-709c-4a61-8eeb-5dfe741e5b9a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Payroll Management System",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ee2871a4-be77-46f7-a0e2-ed061d049daf",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Payroll Management System automates employee compensation structures, attendance records, tax deductions, pay slips, and direct bank deposits.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6c264c16-7b83-4ced-b82d-c3dc72ce233d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Hotel Management System",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fbb64452-5a69-4852-8df6-edae72f217cc",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Hotel Management System manages end-to-end hotel operations, including room booking, guest check-in\/check-out, housekeeping scheduling, and front-desk billing.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3be8ad04-90d5-4e1d-8235-87311b2884a5",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Reservation Management System",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "3b67126c-dc57-4369-8864-658cbca0838d",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Reservation Management System handles seat, space, or ticket bookings and availability tracking for transportation systems such as flights and railways or for event venues.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "82043c89-fdf2-4751-9eea-49e5a126ba1a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Report Card Generator",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "13245ee5-b6d0-4b67-9916-2476fe6321b3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Report Card Generator automates academic performance evaluation, grade point calculations, mark compilation, and report card generation in educational systems.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9454a1ef-c103-4271-986b-29fa95f167b8",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Accounting Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b80070d2-a3d5-4a04-86d7-cdd253d1a40a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Accounting Software tracks organization-wide financial transactions, general ledgers, accounts payable and accounts receivable, balance sheets, and tax compliance. Examples include Tally Prime and QuickBooks.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "961eef1b-c7ea-424a-a903-fc83da405bd8",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Billing Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "018bd586-9d1d-4e43-aa42-7486a1b1a638",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Billing Software automates point-of-sale (POS) invoice generation, customer receipts, itemized price calculations, and payment tracking.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e478fc53-4589-42f2-86b8-6983ca4dcc59",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "System Utilities",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "4074da93-991f-4f78-a765-e4649e24fcb3",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "System Utilities are service programs that perform housekeeping, maintenance, optimization, diagnostic, and protective operations on a computer system to ensure smooth hardware and software functioning.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0418dc8f-edf1-474f-83cc-7c53a3b76fbf",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Disk Compression\nDisk Defragmenter\nBackup Utilities\nDisk Cleaners\nAntivirus\nText Editor",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "33c2da06-804d-4d81-9f06-e340fc61040d",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Disk Compression",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "aa1c1b41-c714-44b3-ac92-de3963ed0f68",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Disk Compression is a utility that shrinks the physical storage size of files and folders using compression algorithms, freeing up hard drive space without losing essential file data.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "fe0ac562-9a0d-4709-9a6a-0c18a391506e",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Disk Defragmenter",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "281c938f-937f-494a-8a12-571758c667fa",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Disk Defragmenter is a maintenance utility that detects fragmented (scattered across different locations) sectors of files stored across a mechanical hard disk and reorganizes them into contiguous (adjacent or continuous) storage blocks, significantly improving read\/write speeds.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "87d06dc0-ebb7-477d-b960-ab3d1025791a",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Backup Utilities",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "16d2bc80-80e9-4bdf-a300-3e49e3e7c4d5",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Backup Utilities are service software that creates exact duplicate copies of critical system files, databases, or whole hard drives onto secondary storage media. These copies can be used to restore data in the event of hardware failure or corruption.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "2a637f58-3c5e-4fab-a083-33b679271c06",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Disk Cleaners",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "a8cf503a-e140-4618-b074-727ba0b2f683",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Disk Cleaners are diagnostic tools that scan storage drives to locate and remove temporary files, browser cache, web cookies, leftover installation packages, and unused system logs to reclaim disk space.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "182b27b5-14d9-41e8-8170-51840b889a51",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Antivirus",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b98ae7b6-9de7-4c68-ac54-d44e1cf8bc7f",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Antivirus is a protective security utility designed to continuously scan, detect, quarantine (isolate to prevent spreading), and eliminate malicious software threats such as computer viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware, and spyware.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "e3c6aa60-2c48-4c91-8e38-0d37eef57c56",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Text Editor",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "6186bb4d-cea2-4164-b86b-477a56bf1b84",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "A Text Editor is a basic system program used to create, edit, open, and view plain text files without rich typographic formatting. Example: Notepad.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },

    },
    {
      "id": "d7e44fbc-6011-44c1-be4f-70f497d59728",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Open Source Software (OSS) is software whose underlying source code (the human-readable programming instructions) is made freely accessible to the general public. Anyone can inspect, modify, enhance, and redistribute it under flexible licensing terms.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "9908983e-a37c-40ae-b568-a69993f5294b",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Key Characteristics of Open Source Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b2582abc-2631-4c9d-a354-aa952ed930dc",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Source code availability\nCommunity-driven development\nLower acquisition cost\nHigh customization options",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b7231cdb-e623-4fb8-a489-9ec80364c7f5",
      "type": "HEADING_4",
      "text": "Examples of Open Source Software",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ce20c622-9224-4c7a-bad2-3287de05777e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Linux Kernel\nUnix\nMySQL Database\nOpenOffice\nVLC Media Player",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "c2589e41-c5c3-445e-af48-91dd1daf3484",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Firmware",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "898141d5-f884-441f-a3c4-a0073e548518",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Firmware is a specific class of software permanently written or flashed into non-volatile (retaining data even when powered off) hardware memory chips, such as Flash ROM or EPROM. Its role is to provide low-level control for system hardware startup and basic operations before the main software loads. Example: System BIOS on motherboards.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "b7268ad1-b0cf-4ad1-992e-8a8991f86f70",
      "type": "HEADING_3",
      "text": "Human-ware (Liveware)",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "ecc166d6-c19b-4300-95ce-b16bb49f371a",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Human-ware, also called Liveware, refers to the human element within a computer ecosystem—the people who design, program, operate, maintain, and interact with computer hardware and software systems. Examples include System Administrators, Software Developers, End-Users, and Network Engineers.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "f9c217fc-07bb-4010-9100-5cece0d93c6e",
      "type": "HEADING_2",
      "text": "Revision",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "0580264d-15ce-48ea-911c-8cf4a84ffe5e",
      "type": "BULLET_LIST",
      "text": "Computer Software: Intangible programs, instructions, algorithms, procedures, and documentation that tell computer hardware what to do.\nSystem Software: Low-level software that operates and controls computer hardware and provides a platform for application software.\nOperating System (OS): Acts as an intermediary between users\/applications and hardware and manages major system resources.\nBIOS: Firmware stored in non-volatile memory that performs POST and initializes hardware before the Operating System loads.\nDevice Driver: Enables the Operating System to recognize, communicate with, and control specific hardware.\nLanguage Translator: Converts programming language code into machine-executable binary code.\nAssembler: Converts Assembly Language into Machine Code.\nCompiler: Converts High-Level Language into Machine Code all at once.\nInterpreter: Converts High-Level Language into Machine Code line-by-line.\nApplication Software: High-level software designed to perform specific user-oriented tasks.\nGeneral Purpose Software: Handles common tasks required by many different users.\nWord Processor: Creates, edits, formats, stores, and prints text documents.\nSpreadsheet Software: Organizes data in rows and columns and performs calculations and analysis.\nPresentation Software: Creates multimedia slide presentations.\nDBMS: Creates, organizes, retrieves, modifies, and manages structured databases.\nDTP Software: Used for professional page layout and print publication design.\nGraphics Software: Creates and edits digital graphics and images.\nMultimedia Software: Plays, records, edits, and combines audio, video, animation, and interactive media.\nSpecific Purpose Software: Customized for a particular business, industry, or organization.\nInventory Management System: Manages stock, warehouse materials, supplier orders, and sales.\nPayroll Management System: Manages employee payments, attendance, deductions, and pay slips.\nHotel Management System: Manages hotel bookings, guests, housekeeping, and billing.\nReservation Management System: Manages bookings and availability.\nReport Card Generator: Automates academic marks, grades, calculations, and report cards.\nAccounting Software: Manages financial transactions, ledgers, accounts, balance sheets, and tax compliance.\nBilling Software: Automates invoices, receipts, price calculations, and payment tracking.\nSystem Utilities: Perform maintenance, optimization, diagnostic, and protective functions.\nDisk Compression: Reduces the storage size of files and folders.\nDisk Defragmenter: Rearranges fragmented files on mechanical hard disks to improve read\/write performance.\nBackup Utility: Creates duplicate copies of important data for recovery.\nDisk Cleaner: Removes unnecessary files to reclaim storage space.\nAntivirus: Detects, isolates, and removes malicious software.\nText Editor: Creates and edits plain text without rich formatting.\nOpen Source Software (OSS): Software whose source code is publicly accessible for inspection, modification, enhancement, and redistribution under its license.\nFirmware: Low-level software stored in non-volatile hardware memory.\nHuman-ware (Liveware): The human element involved in designing, programming, operating, maintaining, and using computer systems.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    }
  ]
}

      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "CPU scheduling is the basis of multi-programmed operating systems. By switching the CPU among processes, the OS increases system responsiveness and CPU utilization.",

{
  "chapterId": "chap_laws_motion",
  "title": "Newton's Laws of Motion",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "cffbeea4-4f0b-463b-8d20-41461ab37eae",
      "type": "HEADING_1",
      "text": "Newton's Fundamental Laws of Motion",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "541fe97e-94c2-4f60-b233-daa69cb41386",
      "type": "PARAGRAPH",
      "text": "Sir Isaac Newton formulated the three laws of motion in 1687 in his famous work 'Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica'. These laws describe the relationship between an object, the forces acting on it, and its resulting motion.",
      "isBold": false,
      "isItalic": false,
      "isUnderline": false,
      "isStrikethrough": false,
      "textColorHex": "",
      "highlightColorHex": "",
      "alignment": "LEFT"
    },
    {
      "id": "531c7751-3552-451e-b971-176532d9e7ac",
      "type": "CALLOUT",
      "calloutType": "DEFINITION",
